196001.description:
The story of how a pair of childhood friends became a couple that's the envy of everyone.

(Source: Dengeki Bunko, translated)

196003.description:
She married to wealthy old men in their death bed to help her family. People called her "Lady Caregiver." She never hoped to be happy herself until...

Cornelia Rosenblatt, eighteen years old, was on her way to Duke Spencer's estate for her third marriage. Although she was a bride, she didn't look happy--she was being forced to marry this old man, almost dying, by her father for the third time. Her father, Baron Rosenblatt, made contract with rich noble men who wished to be cared by a young, beautiful wife. In return, he earned money to pay his debts. Cornelia cared for her first husband and second husband as earnestly as she could. They lived longer than anyone had expected...and people started to call her "Lady Caregiver." She had long since given up on the prospect of a happy marriage. This is a story of a young sweet girl who finds love and happiness at last.

(Source: Kadokawa)
synonyms: I'm Called the 3rd Grade Caretaker's Wife, So Please Throw it Away.

title.english: Don’t Mind Me, I’m Just a Black Widow x 3
title.native: バツ3の看取り夫人と呼ばれていますので捨て置いてくださいませ
title.romaji: Batsu 3 no Mitori Fujin to Yobareteimasu no de Suteoite Kudasaimase

196004.description:
Mirumo, a first-year "new social demon," is known as a "workaholic" who finds joy in working. He goes through his training with gusto, but is discovered to be a demon and gets fired from his job. Now at a loss, Mirumo is invited by a mysterious female company president and is soon offered a job... This is a story about the hard-working life of a demon who gets excited by hard labor.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: あくまで！アットホームな職場です。
title.romaji: Akumade! At Home na Shokuba desu.

196005.description:
High school student Ann Mihara is staying with her host family over the summer at a private library on the outskirts of Sapporo, commonly known as the "Library Mansion." Breaking the rules told to her by the unsociable owner, Sage, Ann ends up getting lost in the library in the middle of the night. There she finds herself in a dilapidated underworld - the Library Labyrinth where "phantoms of stories" wander! Ann, who has been appointed librarian of the labyrinth, is ordered to "have as many people as possible read the library's books and restore the labyrinth"...!?

In an old mansion surrounded by beautiful nature, the story of an unsure girl begins to take shape.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

196006.description:
The biggest crisis for Han-Young, a top employee at a matchmaking company, since joining the company, is to get a gay married?!

Han-Young, a top employee at a matchmaking company 'Marry Me' , is introduced to a client by his manager. Han-Young starts the meeting with high hopes that it could be a chance for promotion if the client gets married, but the client named Beom-Il does not cooperate at all and eventually writes down that he is homosexual in the information field. However, Han-Young cannot give up this opportunity easily and prepares for the next meeting even if he has to work overtime, but Beom-Il pretends not to know and eventually harasses Han-Young. Meanwhile, Beom-Il likes Han-young because he looks half-and-half...

Will Han-Young be able to get Beom-Il married?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

196007.description:
Seo-Ha has spent years losing to genius pharmacy student Soo-Hyuk. Desperate to finally beat him and claim first place, she confesses to him instead—only to discover he’s willing to bargain with her grades in the most dangerous way possible.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Part of Haewadal Studio's Saegya Danpyeonseon (색야 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [색야 단편선] 과탑 남사친을 이기는 야한 방법
[Saegya Danpyeonseon] Gwatam Namsachineul Igineun Yahan Bangbeop
A Dirty Way to Beat a Top Male Friend
[Sexy Anthology] A Naughty Way to Beat the Top Student

196008.description:
Nia, a succubus who only seeks sympathy. One day, she approaches Kwon Dong-Hae, a man who is more sympathetic than anyone else... But for some reason, she, a succubus, is conquered. After that night with Dong-Hae, Nia is not satisfied no matter how many nights she sleeps with, so she eventually goes to see Dong-Hae again...

Will Nia be able to conquer Dong-Hae?

(Source: BookCube, translated)

title.native: 無職マンのゾンビサバイバル生活 欲求に忠実なソロプレイをしたら、現代都市は宝の山でした
title.romaji: Mushoku Man no Zombie Survival Seikatsu Yokkyuu ni Chuujitsu na Solo Play wo Shitara, Gendai Toshi wa Takara no Yamadeshita

196010.description:
Ho Kim, an avid enjoyer of the RPG "Dragon Slayer Academy", is the single most powerful support in the game. After spending countless hours, he eventually manages to reach the major milestone of raising 1,000 heroes to S-rank and is presented with a hidden quest. Tempted by the possibility of raising his S-rank heroes to the more powerful EX-rank, he accepts the quest without a second thought, only to find himself trapped inside the game world...

(Source: WEBTOON)

196011.description:
Joo-Yeon calls off her engagement and is taking back her wedding invitations at work when her ex-boyfriend, Yoo-Hyeon, strolls in and introduces himself as the new director. As if this situation isn't mortifying enough, he tells her no other woman could get him aroused ever since she dumped him and that she should take responsibility. Despite his crude proposal, Joo-Yeon can't help being drawn to her first love and recalling their happy memories together the more their bodies mix. She knows the obstacles that caused their breakup are still there, but could the second time be the charm?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: อยากเปลี่ยนพี่เป็นที่รัก

196013.description:
Yuri, a poor female college student, finds a part-time job with high pay in order to help with her family's finances, and heads to the interview. When she arrives, she meets a handsome man dressed in all black...?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 千早あやかし派遣會社

196014.description:
You must never return to that town.

Alpha with inhuman powers x Ordinary male student Ω.

A rural town hiding a big “secret”.
Third year of high school, his last summer vacation, the omega Hikaru goes on a trip with his classmates. Their destination is the seaside town Hikaru’s grandfather lives in. Hikaru used to live there too, but ever since he moved with his parents to Tokyo, they have forbidden him to go back to the countryside. He must never return—and he will come to understand why.

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

196015.description:
"Now I really want to wipe that bored expression off his face...!"
A pragmatic college student and his handsome but indifferent childhood friend fire each other up in this close-quarters love story!

College student Hayato is constantly strung along by his straight, slightly younger neighbor and childhood friend, Yuki. Yuki even shows up and monopolizes Hayato's bed like he owns the place again right as Hayato is trying to bring another guy home! Hayato decides enough is enough, and isn't going to let the opportunity go to waste, but Yuki continues to read Hayato's comics without batting an eye. He knows Hayato's gay, but his unguarded responses are making Hayato so angry and horny, he's about to explode...! "Go ahead and do it, then," he taunts. That only pushes Hayato further past his breaking point!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Getting a Rise Out of My Moody Childhood Friend
title.native: 無反応な幼馴染を喘がせたい

196016.description:
A delinquent one-shot from Fairy Tail author Hiro Mashima, celebrating Weekly Young Magazine's 45th anniversary, published in Weekly Young Magazine 2025 No. 32.

The story shows Mashima himself as a teenage delinquent with his friend and how they were influenced by reading Weekly Young Magazine back in the 90s.

196018.description:
After spending the night with Zion, a girl from a cult, Hageon finds himself worshiped as the cult’s Messiah—and he fully embraces it.

(Source: Toomics)
synonyms: Believe Me! I Offer You My First

196019.description:
Jihun is pulled into Knight Defense, a game where he must lead the kingdom’s knights against endless waves of monsters. Weighed down by the scars of his real life, Jihun chooses not to fight and turns his back on humanity. But as soon as he does, the system unveils a new path: the Monster Faction. Defense is over. It’s now time for offense.

(Source: WEBTOON)

196020.description:
Go Seunghwan, a former world champion in jiu-jitsu, wakes up to find the world has collapsed into chaos. Civilization is gone. The streets are overrun with zombies. And worst of all—he’s already infected. But that doesn’t matter. He has one goal left. To find and save his daughter, no matter the cost. Even if his body fails, his will won’t. A father’s final fight begins—against the undead, against time, and against himself.

(Source: Naver, translated)

196023.description:
At the end of her tumultuous life, Bok-Hui, a grandmother, receives a terminal diagnosis. She receives an offer: if she becomes a magical girl, she can extend her granddaughter's life until she becomes an adult.

"A magical girl...? That means my granddaughter can live longer...? I'll do it!"

Will Bok-Hui be able to protect the East Village from the mysterious man, "Dok-Su," and the villains he has corrupted? Discovering her true calling at the end of her life! The story of a 78-year-old grandmother's rejuvenated journey to become a magical girl!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

196024.description:
Kaede, a job-hunting student, drowns in a river while trying to save an elementary school student. When he wakes up, he finds himself in an unfamiliar place, meeting Kaeriki, who calls himself the Grim Reaper...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: ご旅行はあの世まで? 死神は上野にいる
title.romaji: Go Ryokou wa Anoyo Made? Shinigami wa Ueno ni Iru

196025.description:
A business that grants people anything they want - a shop that specializes in magic spells. Yomizaka is a young man who runs a hardware store that he inherited from his predecessor, but his side job at the spell shop is more popular, so he leads an unhappy life. One day, Yomizaka meets a emaciated, beautiful young man at a baron's house who has come to him to lift a curse on his son...!?

A mysterious story of exorcism that challenges a bizarre mystery begins.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 金物屋夜見坂少年の怪しい副業
title.romaji: Kanamonoya Yoru Mizaka no Shounen no Ayashii Fukugyou

196026.description:
Chi-Young, whose girlfriend who whispered that she loved him suddenly disappears one day and he is left with a huge debt. He receives a suspicious offer from a mysterious man saying that he will be paid 100 million won if he works for 6 months, and he becomes the home nurse for Ui-Hyeon, who was a classmate from orphanage when he was young. Just as Chi-Young's heart gradually opens up due to Ui-Hyeon's affectionate attitude, Ul-Hyeon barges into his room every night to have sex with him, and it's killing him...

"He pretended to be innocent, but he's a total pervert."

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

196027.description:
After the tragic death of their childhood friend, Kang Chung-Woo, Ha Se-Jun, and Eun Bin decide to grant Myung Yu-Hyeon's last wish by performing a séance so they all can hang out for the final time. Much to their surprise, the séance works, and Yu-Hyeon's spirit comes back. But he wasn't exactly honest about his steamy last wish... Now, he has to possess one of his friends to make it come true. Will fulfilling Yu-Hyeon's last lusty desire send him to nirvana? Or does he have even more wishes?!

(Source: Tapas)

Note:
- Includes eight extra chapters.
- Winner of the 14th Mr.Blue Contest.
synonyms: S'envoyer en l'air pour te sauver
ภารกิจส่งเพื่อนขึ้นสวรรค์
Wie man seinen Freund ins Nirwana bringt

title.english: How To Send a Friend to Nirvana

196028.description:
Utsuro is an unidentified monster whose favorite food is the "nectar" bioenergy that only young girls possess. Iruka Natsumi, a member of Hyakkaen, an organization that fights Utsuro day and night, lives in fear of being eaten by Utsuro. One day, a girl named Sagara Asuka appears before her. Asuka declares, "I will defeat all the Utsuro in this world with my own hands," and tells Natsumi that they will live together until she turns 19, when the nectar disappears from her body. Asuka shows overwhelming strength in her battle with Utsuro, but she has a secret...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 奥藤さんはひっぱりだこ

196031.description:
A man working at a mediocre company with no highs or lows gets into an accident and is reincarnated into another world as Aul, the eldest son of a poor farming family.
He vows to live a slow and carefree life—but the new world is full of things it lacks.
“If it doesn’t exist, I’ll make it!”
Armed with modern knowledge and magic, he dives into a DIY lifestyle in the countryside.

title.native: のんべんだらりな転生者～貧乏農家を満喫す～
title.romaji: Nonbendarari na Tensei-sha: Binbou Nouka wo Mankitsu su

196032.description:
Roy Aveillam, the arrogant son of a notorious duke, is widely feared. But one heated clash with a rival classmate jolt something deep within –his memory of a past life returns, as does a burning desire: to master a craft and become someone extraordinary. Reincarnated at just eight years old, Roy awakens to the world's latent magic and vows to redefine himself –not just by his lineage, but by his will.

(Source: Titan Manga)

title.english: School for Wizards: Old Enough to Learn Magic

196033.description:
Yoon is a broke student working tirelessly to turn his life around and get through medical school. Though they're estranged, Yoon can’t look away when his father’s debts catch up to him. In exchange for his father’s life, Yoon agrees to work for the gang after he graduates, losing all freedom outside of his classes. With all that time together, Yoon can’t help but get to know Tae-Beom. And he hates to admit it, but the attraction he feels for the boss might go beyond just pheromones…

(Source: Tapas)

Note Includes one extra chapter.

196034.description:
Ten-year-old Mia lives with her aunt in the poor, secluded, so-called “Criminals’ Village” where the only way out is to be called by a dragon and carried off to a new life. One day, the unassuming Mia is chosen for this honor and whisked away on dragon-back to the royal palace, a dazzling world filled with witches, dragon-riding knights, and a centuries-long curse she must somehow find a way to lift.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

196035.description:
Drowning in an endless ocean of slippery pleasure!

(Source: Fakku!)

Notes: The first chapter was originally published under the title "DIVE!!" The title was later changed to "Anna-san wa Osamaranai" (杏南さんはおさまらない, Anna-san Can't Get Enough) - Published in Comic Kairakuten 2025-08, 12, 2026-04

196041.description:
When news anchor Eun-Seong Kang meets the enigmatic Woo-Jin Jeong, an unexpected connection pulls them into each other’s orbit. He’s a man trapped in a life that never ends; she chases meaning in fleeting moments. Their encounter feels less like coincidence — and more like fate.

(Source: Manta)

196042.description:
Harriet's sister returns with her stolen fiancé, demanding to stay at the estate. Enter Lennock Diorne, her brother's infuriating best friend.

"You'll really let her win this easily?"

His taunt sparks a reckless game of pretend. Is it pure revenge, or something far more dangerous?

(Source: Manta)

196043.description:
In a kingdom rotting from within, Rey, an Arcanist whose magic serves the city's power players, scrapes by in a dusty bookstore with one-night stands as his only relief. After one intense night with two men, one of them won’t leave. Behind his refined mask lies a decadent hunger — and Rey knows it's poison, but he can't stay away.

(Source: Manta)

196050.description:
Azusa Shirakawa was the star of her judo club all through high school, but now that she's in college, she's decided to move on and look for something new. Her friend Sae has some ideas for activities Azusa might enjoy, and sets her up on a hookup with their mutual friend Takuma—after all, Azusa and Takuma get along well, and they're both serious, straitlaced types who could use a chance to relax and unwind a little. The two of them are nervous at first, but Azusa quickly learns that underneath Takuma's nerdy exterior, he's got an unstoppable cock and boundless stamina. Azusa's used to being the toughest one around, but as she finds herself getting pounded into the mattress and drowning in pleasure, she discovers just how good it feels to lose.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

Notes:
- Released at COMITIA152
- A live-action AV adaptation (RKI-738) was released on April 10th, 2026.

196054.description:
The elixir, a magical drug that instantly heals any wound. What if this elixir of legends and fairy tales were real? Dasha, a female knight who has retired for some reason, and Moimir, a charming pharmacist. After a chance encounter, the two hit it off for the elixir and plunge into the stormy seas of adventure. A retired knight and an active pharmacist are on a quest for the wonder drug! An authentic and royal fantasy adventure tale!

(Source: BookLive, translated)
synonyms: The Tale of the Elixir in the Royal Capital

196055.description:
His lover, his parents, his future—everything was taken from him. A violent suspense story of revenge begins! Daichi Enomoto was an ordinary college student with a girlfriend and friends. Until the day he was framed for murder… Called to a hotel by a part-time job colleague, what he saw there was the shocking sight of the very person who had summoned him…

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

196060.description:
All things in this world have a price. But what if people did too? With the mysterious "Social Coin" app appearing on phones all over the world, people are now "priced" according to their reputation and character. While those worth high prices thrive, those worth low prices are in danger of facing ostracization, discrimination, or even death.

(Source: WEBTOON)

196065.description:
The story of "Bakuchinugi!" begins when the younger sister of the incredibly lucky high school boy Nanase Kiseki loses in a strip gambling game and has her underwear stolen. There is a rumor that the culprit who stole his sister's underwear is targeting beautiful gamblers, so Kiseki cross-dresses and joins the gambling club, which is full of girls.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

196066.description:
The story is set in the near future, where the "NTR" genre has been banned due to the risk of causing brain damage. Akira Inui, an unsuccessful erotic manga artist, happens to encounter NTR and is drawn to its charm... This is the story of the protagonist's passion as he pursues the "ultimate NTR" together with Harumi, a cyborg equipped with a "sexual desire reactor" that converts sexual desire into energy.

(Source: Natalie, translated)
synonyms: The Name of that Flame Is Sexual Preference

title.romaji: Sono Honoo no Na wa Seiheki

196067.description: A story about the unexpected side of a girl who is a 'lone wolf' and doesn't hang out with anyone.
synonyms: A Story About a Lone Wolf Girl Who Caught My Attention

title.native: 一匹狼な女の子が気になる話
title.romaji: Ippiki Ookami na Onnanoko ga Kininaru Hanashi

196068.description:
High school girl Junna Harumi's purpose in life is to support the idol Fuwari Tsukishiro! One day, the idol group Fuwari belongs to disbands. In her despair, Junna learns that Fuwari will be trying out for an idol audition program. There will be a total of 100 participants - in order to lead her idol to the top, Junna decides to take part in the audition herself and work behind the scenes. This idol-otaku girl's lifelong "supporting activity" begins now!

(Source: Weekly Shounen Magazine, Translated)

196069.description:
"Royal Royale in Another World: 18 Candidate Brides" is a "harem marriage battle" set in a world populated only by women. Taiga Shishido is summoned to a world populated only by women at the time of his death, and as the king of that world, he is asked to choose his only marriage partner from among 18 bride candidates. In this country where men are not born, the only way to leave descendants is to summon them from the other world by magic. Taiga must choose a queen from among 18 bride candidates of different status, occupation, and race.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 異世界ロイヤルロワイアル ～１８人の花嫁候補～
title.romaji: Isekai Royal Royale: 18-nin no Hanayome Kouho

196070.description:
Kanda Hajime, a game-loving office worker, collapses from repeated overwork and wakes up as Rid, the villain of the otome game "Tokirera!". Awaiting him in the game is a bad ending of condemnation.
In order to avoid condemnation, he uses his natural intelligence and the knowledge of games he has acquired before his reincarnation to first fix the discord in his family.
A cold-hearted father, a lonely sister, and a sick mother.
The measures Rid takes to save them go beyond the game's scenario and become a huge wave that engulfs the entire continent!

title.native: やり込んだ乙女ゲームの悪役モブですが、断罪は嫌なので真っ当に生きます@COMIC

196072.description:
Mao Endou is known as "The Demoness" of her workplace; she's hyper-competent, strict, and ready to scold! However, she has a secret... she's dating the "angel" of the office, the kind and handsome Seiji Amatsuka! Seiji is the only one who knows that Mao isn't really the strict career woman she seems to be, and after dating in secret for half a year, the two are as in love as ever. But, there's just one small problem...

(Source: Rental!)

title.english: Attention! My Angelic Boyfriend is a Tease!

196074.description:
Orcs and elves have long been at odds with each other, but Iris the elf felt it wouldn't be right not to help an injured orc boy when she came across him years ago. Now he's grown up, he still remembers her after all these years, and he isn't going to let the cultural divide stop them from being together - even if it means he has to steal her from her village.

(Source: FAKKU)

title.english: The Orc's Bride: An Elf Held Captive by Pleasure

196075.description:
Suzu, a mineral researcher, suddenly loses consciousness at work!! When she wakes up, she finds herself in the world of an otome game, reincarnated as the villainess, Mahalia!? If this continues, her life will fall apart just like in the game!! She escapes from the royal palace and makes her way to a coal mine, where she meets Abel, the leader of the mine. In order to survive, Suzu proposes that they make steel using coke, a type of coal that does not yet exist in this world...

(Source: Pocket Magazine, translated)

title.native: 鉱石令嬢〜没落した悪役令嬢が炭鉱で一山当てるまでのお話〜
title.romaji: Kouseki Reijou: Botsuraku shita Akuyaku Reijou ga Tankou de Hitoyama Ateru made no Ohanashi

196076.description:
Mineral researcher Isuzu loses consciousness while working overtime, and when she wakes up, she finds herself reincarnated as Mahalia, the villainess of an otome game she was playing to kill time... and she has just been told by the prince that their engagement is broken off. She can't let her life of downfall follow the game's lead! After fleeing from the royal palace, she ends up in a coal mine deep in the mountains. Picked up by Abel, the leader of the mine, Isuzu abandons her life as Mahalia, opting for a life on the run, and proposes "steel production using coal (coke)," a method that has not yet been established in this world. Using the knowledge from her previous life, she aims to advance civilization and start an industrial revolution!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 鉱石令嬢〜没落した悪役令嬢が炭鉱で一山当てるまでのお話〜
title.romaji: Kouseki Reijou: Botsuraku shita Akuyaku Reijou ga Tankou de Hitoyama Ateru made no Ohanashi

title.romaji: Moto Yuusha, Ima wa Idol no Driver Yattemasu

196078.description:
Hinata, a Heisei gal, died from an incurable illness. When she was reincarnated, it was into a fantasy world where imagination literally becomes magic—known as imagical. While renowned imaginaters (magical artists) are being reborn into this world, Hinata is just an ordinary girl who loves handicrafts… deemed useless and unfit for the task of protecting people from monsters, she’s cast aside. Even so, with her trademark positive attitude, Hinata decides to go out into town to buy some cute clothes―Only to find that not a single stylish outfit exists! This is a world with zero interest in “art” or fashion! However, a chance encounter between this outrageous gal and a cynical artist sets the stage for a bold new stroke of color across the world… a remake fantasy where a wild gal and jaded artists transform a world with zero imagination!

(Source: Corona EX, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes two extras, one from each volume.

196079.description:
Ye-Won Han, a career woman who is honest and takes the lead in company work more than anyone else. In fact, she has a secret that she cannot tell anyone, and it is that she reveals it more than anyone else! Ye-Won, who has fun when she plays and maintains and manages her reputation as a perfect career woman at work, is faced with a crisis. Choi Eun-Ho, who she slept with last night, has joined a different team. Will Ye-Won be able to protect her reputation?

(Source: BookCube, translated)
synonyms: What Are You Doing at Work?

196080.description:
Oh Kyung-Tae, who is gentle and likes children, but is always bullied by the girls around him. One day, Kyung-Tae is chosen as a beta tester for a dating simulation game for pretty girls. However, the joy is short-lived. The game does not run or install properly, so he ends up thinking it is a bad game... All the girls around him start to show favoritism! And he even starts to show favoritism toward Min Ji-Ah, the queen bee of the same university who has bullied him since his school days...

(Source: BookCube, translated)

196081.description:
Yoon-Tae explodes at the noise from the wall that keeps him up every night. He goes to the house next door and knocks on the door, telling them to stop making noise, but the shabby, unemployed man next door, Park Geon, shamelessly touches Yoon-Tae's body and flirts with him. Yoon-Tae punches Geon and attends an important company reception, but who is this? Park Geon, who is so handsome that you can't even imagine he was the unemployed man he met last night, opens the door and comes in?!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

196082.description:
Yuimi, who works at the reception desk at the Tenten Corporation Research Institute, is a big bath lover. One day, she is suddenly approached by a naked beauty at her favorite super public bath. That's how she met Mizuki Kagami, a researcher at the research institute.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

synonyms: Furo Sommelier Tenten Corporation Bath Product Development Room

title.native: 風呂ソムリエ 天天コーポレーション入浴剤開発室

196083.description:
Tsugumi, the granddaughter of successful lawyer Masayoshi Azuma, is a high school girl with the special ability to see distorted faces of people who are lying. The Azuma Law Firm will take on any case as long as they have the money, but they are always faced with difficult cases. Who is really lying? Together with Tsumugi, her eccentric grandfather and their childhood friend, prosecutor Kusajiki, the truth hidden in the lies will now be revealed!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 法律は嘘とお金の味方です。〜京都御所南、吾妻法律事務所の法廷日誌〜
title.romaji: Houritsu wa Uso to Okane no Mikata desu.: Kyoto Gosho Minami, Azuma Houritsu Jimusho no Houtei Nisshi

196084.description:
The devil's job is to make a contract with humans and grant their wishes in exchange for energy. If Kuina can't get a contract in the next year, he will be sent to the bottom of hell. The candidate he reluctantly chooses, Inori, is adamant that she has no desire for anything at all...

A year-long battle between a desperate devil and a selfless girl begins!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.romaji: Aho to Watashi to Akai Ito

196086.description:
Cheol-Yong, who has been struggling to become an idol with his extraordinary talent since he was young. However, after repeated failures, he has come to terms with reality and is now working part-time at a sushi restaurant. He meets famous composer Ruth at a house where he went to deliver fish by chance, and while he thought he would get a chance, he ended up getting entangled in a bad relationship instead. Cheol-Yong is in a situation where he could end up getting sued because Ruth, who was composing music on his clothes, suddenly starts to touch him and hits his head with a trophy. Not only that, Ruth continues to make disparaging remarks, which is really annoying. This is a do-or-die situation. An angry Cheol-Yong hands out a 'Singing Contest' poster. He proposes to Ruth that if he wins, he will not sue him and that he should give him a song. On the day of the final battle, when Cheol-Yong sharpens his sword, goes up on stage, sings, and comes down, Ruth says... "I will sue you." Instead of saying, "I will make you a star. A trot star!" Trot?! Me, who was an idol trainee?!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

196087.description:
Yuki, a completely ordinary high school freshman, one day finds himself suddenly transported to another world, only to discover that he has become a magic mechanical human with a cyborg-like body...

(Source: Young Animal, translated)

196088.description:
The air conditioner broke down in the middle of summer! The person who appeared in front of her drenched in sweat was her son's friend?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

196089.description:
Ai Yuichiro, the face of the news program "Evening Scoop" that starts every Friday at 11:20pm, is not just a newscaster. He is a newscaster detective who uses his investigative skills and deductive reasoning skills as a former journalist to cut through the darkness of society.

This is a broadcast mystery brought to you by the flawless man Ai and his partner (?) the new mystery writer Takenouchi!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: キャスター探偵 金曜23時20分の男

196090.description:
Ju Cheong-Do, the thirty-first heir of the Yusim Ju clan, carries a curse cast on him in childhood. Everyone he grows close to meets an untimely death, and the curse is now threatening his own life as well. Desperate to hold on to the will to live, Cheong-Do seeks out Yu Chan-Ran, a man known for solving any problem for the right price, and places his last hope in him. When Cheong-Do asks what it would cost for Chan-Ran to act as his lover, the answer comes lightly but firmly.

“Hey, how much do you charge? For the boyfriend experience, I mean.”

“I start at 100,000 won per hour."

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: キャスター探偵 セカンドシーズン

196092.description:
Natsuha was raised in a single-parent household without a father since she was born. One day, her mother brings home her new husband. He looks like a yakuza who has just been released from prison...!? Meanwhile, Natsuha's boyfriend, who she just started dating, is preoccupied with their first time having sex...! Natsuha is confused by all the changes...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

She had grown up beautifully and Henmi was left in charge of her training. But the company rules suddenly changed meaning that if he didn't stop smoking in the next 3 months he would be without a job. To momentarily escape this reality, Henmi heads to the smoking area but... Suzuko is there smoking?! Telling her about the new smoking policy, Suzuko's face suddenly turns red. "Well, in exchange for a cigarette, you can suck on these...?" She said while exposing her voluptuous body...?!

A new addiction that began in the smoking area... with a sexy voice and sounds that he had never heard before, Henmi is...

This love is beyond the limit!! Nanamori Yui loves dandy older men like Abe Hiroshi. One cold winter day, Nanamori loses her smartphone, wallet, and skirt, and is left half-naked and freezing when she is saved by an incredibly dandy older man and falls in love at first sight, but he has a special situation...!?

What are the odds of running into an ex-lover at a recycling center? A new story written by two women who reunite as apartment residents.

Hiroka Ishino, who works as a sports instructor, has been in love with her old classmate, Keisuke Nagaoka, who works as a police officer, for years. However, he won't treat her as a woman at all, and they remain as just friends. One day, she's invited to spend Christmas Eve with him, as they're both single. She goes to Keisuke's house in high spirits, but nothing ends up happening and she stays over... While Hiroka fell asleep feeling depressed about if she should give up on her love, when she wakes up, she spots Keisuke's huge morning wood...!! Fuuka Takano works part-time at a bar. One day, when she gets caught up in a fight between customers, Kai, one of the regulars, comes to her rescue. Kai is a playboy who works as a host?not exactly Fuuka's type. But, when she invites him to her place so she can treat his wounds, he makes her allow him to stay there as her kept man until he's healed. Nene's been having trouble getting her boyfriends to stick around, as none of them can keep up with her insatiable sex drive. Her last ex even made up an excuse about her apartment being haunted! Hagoromo has failed in both her job search and love life. By chance, she meets three handsome brothers, Asahi, Hinata, and Mitsuki, who run a bakery called Aurora. Aurora is facing financial difficulties and is on the verge of closing, but Hagoromo is serious about trying to somehow turn it around! What will become of her love with the three brothers?

Shirakawa-san is a tomboyish, hard-working, handsome girl. She is admired by the female employees and highly regarded by the male employees. But what about Sakashita-kun, the new employee who ends up working under Shirakawa-san?

She's more handsome than any man! Super office lady Shirakawa-san is great at both work and love (?)!

title.romaji: Maware! Shirakawa-san: Boku wa Joushi ni Koi wo Suru

Nao is innocent and silly, while Akira is smart and cool. The two are complete opposites in appearance and personality, but they are best friends. A youthful story about school, family, and love, told by high school boys in the midst of puberty!

196104.description:
Tells of the friendship between John and Ref, an Akita Inu, that John met on one of the trips with Hidetoshi to Africa.

Note: The author, Takahashi Yoshihiro, dedicated this story to the Finnish fans as a thank you for being invited as a honorable guest to the country in 2011.

196105.description:
A skilled assassin gets in over her head when she finds out her target is an unkillable monster man, and winds up paying the price by becoming his slave in both mind and body...

(Source: Irodori Comics)

196106.description: A story about two boys sharing a secret in the woods.

196107.description:
Mashiro Katakura, who broke off her engagement just before the wedding, was disowned by her parents and began living alone and poorly while paying off the cancellation fee for the wedding venue. As she faces her own time and starts to become independent little by little, her relationship with her landlord, Mr. Sagiya, deepens...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

title.native: ごちそうは黄昏の帰り道

196109.description: Hayato, a street child, is busy every day trying to save up for his younger sister Himari's medical expenses. One day, after Hayato meets a mysterious boy, Himari is kidnapped by a giant, strange spirit! Hayato's battle to protect his precious sister and the town where he lives begins! A stylish action fantasy featuring modern-day ninjas.

title.native: 東京アヤカシストリート

196112.description:
Risa Sakurai, physically the strongest girl in school, is invited by the beautiful Kayano Jun, who possesses a devilish intellect, to establish the Occult Research Club. The two strongest high school girls take on curses, horrors, and urban legends—!!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title.native: ゆるコワ！～無敵のJKが心霊スポットに凸しまくる～
title.romaji: Yuru Kowa! Muteki no JK ga Shinrei Spot ni Totsu Shimakuru

仕上げ男子のクロモジ

"I'm here to be your plaything".

Even a dump like this feels like heaven when we're together… Lala Kojima's passionate work comes to life! Presenting the world's most endearing omnibus BL!

(Source: Coolmic)

196119.description:
"This is Sparrow Tour, a saltwater fish processing specialist."

One day, Baek Han joins a suspicious company that hunts saltwater fish. Saltwater fish are monsters created by humans in the past, preying on human life. Saltwater fish, preying on human life, are said to lurk throughout the country. This Korean-style fantasy adventure follows Baek Han on a journey across the country, following tales and legends to catch them.

(Source: Naver, translated)

196120.description:
OHis wife has gone missing. His baby daughter is terminally ill. But as Junhu falls to his death, he wakes up in his wife’s unfinished dark fantasy novel--a world infested with vile demons. Armed with knowledge of the story, he allies with powerful demon hunters to avert the tragedies to come. Yet every action rewrites the story in unpredictable ways, and Junhu must seek answers if he hopes to keep his daughter safe.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: A Single Dad in Another World

title.native: 嬢様とメイドと僕〜僕の童貞はお嬢様に買い取られました〜

I’m a total loser at work who’s stuck doing overtime every single day. But after getting drunk at a company party, I ended up having an unexpected threesome with the senior colleague I’ve always admired and the cute junior who has a crush on me!!

I may be useless at work, but I’ve got a huge dick. And those two went absolutely wild for sex with me! At the office… in cosplay… even with creampies! This is a steamy harem sex story where these cute girls drown in pleasure!

Kaori, a rather clumsy guard, was suddenly transferred to a prison notorious for its dangerous inmates. To make things worse, she was assigned to a man who had committed a serious crime… At first, she was on edge but despite his appearance, the prisoner turned out to be serious and hardworking. Then one day, he approached her asking to talk… But the moment she let her guard down, he grabbed her and snapped a handcuff on her!?

(Source: Coolmic)

196128.description:
Kouken was born with a flower birthmark, which shows that she has a special power to use Kasen Mystics, the flower sorcery. She was able to read the memories of flowers and send the poor souls that still linger in this world as wraiths.
However, this sorcery was now hated by the empire. Because Kouken was the only one in the village with the power, she was treated cruelly by everyone.

When an envoy from Shuuyou, the imperial capital, came to the village, Kouken was captured and taken with them. The fourth prince, Shuurei, found out that she has the power he was looking for and took her to the inner palace.
Kouken starts dealing with wraiths and send them to the pure land, which leads to solving mysterious cases inside the inner palace.

(Source: BookWalker)

title.english: A Petal Priestess Blooms at the Inner Palace

196129.description:
"Tsukiaenakute Ii no ni", is a romantic comedy about a woman's unrequited love for a man who has a strange sense of distance. Eriko Shimizu, who has never had a boyfriend, reunites with her middle school classmate Kitayama in a club at the university she enrolled in...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

Includes six extra chapters

title.native: 付き合えなくていいのに

196130.description:
At work, Na-Hee is a quiet woman who hates attracting attention. But at home, she posts selfies in lingerie on an anonymous app and enjoys the thirsty compliments she gets. Unfortunately, these two worlds clash when the new hire at work, Yi-Heon, finds out about Na-Hee's scandalous hobby. Claiming he can only get excited by looking at her naughty pics, he promises to keep her spicy secret if she continues posting them. Although he only acts pervy on the app and keeps things professional at the office, Na-Hee isn't sure if she can separate work from pleasure the same way...

(Source: Tappytoon)

196131.description:
Ji-Won’s track record with men is horrible. It’s so bad that she’s nicknamed “the trash collector” amongst her friends. Unfortunately, the newest addition to the collection is Do-Kyung, her boss. Do-Kyung is rich, handsome, and… incredibly difficult in terms of personality. Ji-Won is very aware that her crush on him will lead to no good, and she’s proven correct after they impulsively spend a heated night together. His selfish and manipulative behavior is a glaring red flag, but she can’t help wanting him. However, even Ji-Won has her limits to how much pain her heart can handle…

(Source: Tappytoon)

196133.description:
In the Colosseum, warriors find desire, despair, and hope as they fight to the death! Baron Ruckel Fautash is a well-known gladiator who has been touted as a hated villain in the ring. But despite the vitriol spewed his way, this nobleman of the Taurus Empire has no plans of backing down and won’t say no to any fight.

Ruckel may be tarnishing his noble name with every fight he takes on, but he’s determined to carve out his own path, with just his sword and strength to guide him.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.native: 帝国貴族の剣闘士生活

196135.description:
Je-Hyun, a beta researcher studying Alpha-Omega gene replication, is given a secret mission: lie low for a while and act as guardian for AP1, a dominant Alpha test subject. Moved by the experiment’s innocent eyes, he grows attached to the young subject and names him “Ian.” But the very next day, Jae-Hyun wakes up to find a towering man waiting for him…a man who turns out to be none other than Ian himself, now suddenly fully grown and overwhelming in stature. In this twisted tale of genetic experiments and forbidden bonds, who’s really taming whom?

(Source: Lezhin US)

196137.description:
Note: contains the following one-shots:
Volume 1: No Sleep ni Kiite Goran (ノースリープに聞いてごらん)
Volume 3: Kingyo no Onegai (金魚のおねがい)

Reborn from the depths, Kyoko will take revenge against those classmates who had bullied her!

Sereniel was once a beautiful princess beloved by her people, until she was struck by a curse that disfigured her face, which led to her becoming known as the “Monster Princess.” Her parents shunned her and isolated her from the public, and the only person who treated her kindly was the knight Cassel.

Sereniel had given up on her love for Cassel because of the curse. But one night at a party, she runs into Cassel, who has been drugged with an aphrodisiac, and they end up spending the night together. Forced by marry by royal decree, Sereniel is haunted by a strong sense of guilt that she had deprived Cassel of a happy future. Sereniel wants to free Cassel, so she asks him for a divorce. However, she received an unexpected answer.

"I have no intention of letting you go."

Sereniel believes that she will never be loved, and Cassel does not want to lose her. What will happen to their painful love affair?

(Source: Comico, translated)

Kanade pushes Yuuma down onto the bed and mounts him... Yuuma's mother suddenly tells him she's remarrying. As if that weren't hard enough, his new dad is his boss! As he heads home from work surprised and confused, Yuuma encounters Kanade, who leads him to a hotel room... Later, his new dad introduces him to his new brother... who turns out to be Kanade! A complicated relationship commences between the two new brothers.

Her hobbies are reading, and she's average at studying and sports. Otobe Murasaki is a high school student who lives a quiet life, thinking she's just a mob character, but she doesn't like Fujimi Akiko, who is always the center of attention in the class.
However, as soon as she becomes a member of the gardening committee like Akiko, she quickly falls in love with her, as she talks to her in a friendly manner.
Just as she is wondering if there's any way she can get closer to her, she happens to come across Akiko crying after a breakup...

A girls' love comedy about a simple mob character and a sparkling girl with a difficult future ahead!

A girls' school, Hibiscus Academy, where only selected young women can attend. At this academy, there is a princess and a prince.

The “Princess of Hibiscus,” student council president Suzuran, and the “Prince of Hibiscus,” vice president Emma.

In public, they both play their roles as prince and princess perfectly, loved by everyone, but when they are alone, they are two trusted friends who joke around and talk naturally.

However, their relationship takes a sudden turn due to a certain event. That event is... Suzuran's heartbreak.

This twisted yuri story begins at an all-girls school!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: たゆたう恋の散り際に

196149.description:
"I'll be your mother."

After losing her biological mother, Mayu Kanda was abused by her guardian uncle every day, and could barely eat properly, but she just laughed it off. Until she met a mysterious beauty, Kamakura Komachi, who suddenly appeared.

Is she, who acts like a mother, a ray of hope for Mayu? Or...?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

196150.description:
Matsumura, a high school student who is a cake and dreams of being eaten by a fork, has the habit of fantasizing, “What if I started bleeding here and a fork assaulted me…?”
One day, he really ends up cutting his wrist by accident and is found by his classmate Igeta…?!

Notes:
- Chapter 1 was previously released as a one-shot in the Kimi wa Boku dake no Dulce: Cakeverse BL Anthology (君は僕だけのドルチェ ケーキバースBLアンソロジー).

196152.description:
Once known as the ultimate killer, "Knife Rabbit" retired and lived a quiet life under the name of chef "Goya." One day, he senses an indescribable, enchanting scent from a girl named "Jin Seo-Nu" who visits his restaurant. Pursuing her are his former colleagues, former killers, and "natural enemies." These enemies, intent on completing their mission, and Goya, the chef, desperate to monopolize the scent, their desires and instincts surrounding the girl become intertwined.

(Source: Naver, translated)

196153.description: Ryoma was once a low class samurai, a ronin without allegiance and a wanted man. But today he is recognized as a person who marshaled a unique strength of personality, diplomacy, and historical vision to help transform his nation, a vision that produced a unified modern Japan out of the rough cloth of a fragmented feudal tradition. Ryoma’s life is a tale of Shakespearian proportions -- a life of daring and personal triumph that helped mold a nation, but also a life lived without regard to personal gain or safety. His life tragically ended prematurely with his brutal assassination.

196156.description:
Kento, a young office worker, became a happy couple with Sora, a construction worker he met at a candy store, and they started living together. Kento was savoring his happy days surrounded by the love and body of Sora, who is extremely sweet and big, but he discovered that his neighbor was Sora's junior from high school. He seems to be in love with Sora, and casts a challenging gaze on Kento...!? A super-rich, sweet love story between a cheerful muscular man and an older office worker, living together!!

196159.description:
Dragged into a host bar by chance, Minkyeong meets Sihyeok, a man whose savage charm awakens desires she never felt with her husband. As she becomes addicted to the thrill he offers, she drains her money, her pride, and herself, only for his demands to grow more dangerous with each encounter. But her fall is only beginning, because Sihyeok is merely a tool, and the true owner watching from the shadows intends to claim her completely.

(Source: Lezhin US)

196160.description:
At a local PC café, the shy owner secretly pines for his drop-dead gorgeous part-timer, Mina. But subtle details about her stir painful memories he can’t ignore, leaving him torn between fear and desire, especially when her bright smile makes his heart race all over again.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: The Girl from the PC Café

196161.description:
While pursuing a case, Detective I-Eum Kim of the Violent Crimes Unit rescues a man collapsed on a mountain trail. Stricken with amnesia, the man believes himself to be a child... Thus begins I-Eum's dangerous cohabitation with a mysterious stranger.

(Source: Manta)

196162.description:
A cat kept at a certain roast pork restaurant in Yokohama is called Chai-nyan. What dish will he (or she?), a cat whose purpose in life is to explore the delicious food of Yokohama, encounter today?

(Source: Champion Cross, translated)

196163.description:
Ra-Yoon, who is dating many men, and So-Ra, who is happy with just her husband. Two completely different people. But one day, something changed?! - So-Ra suddenly has a younger slut, and Ra-Yoon has a pure-hearted husband. This is how it happened...

"Should we switch?"

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

196164.description:
The mercenary Tened gathers information to find his younger brother. One day, he gets a clue that his missing younger brother is related to the Great Chapel. Tened is assigned to escort a carriage to the Great Chapel, and the mission, which he thought would proceed smoothly, falls into chaos due to an attack by heretics. As a result, the carriage he was escorting catches fire, and Tened hurriedly opens the carriage door to take out the holy relic. However, instead of the holy relic, there is a child sitting in the carriage...

Tened rescues the child without hesitation and escapes from the heretics. After that, Tened sets out on a journey to take the child to the Great Chapel, and the child feels strange feelings when he sees Tened being kind to him.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

196165.description:
“Those who responsible for Hyodo’s family death was subdued forever by Fumihiko with his lethal deception skill and a game of money...”

That night, the Hyodo family mansion was mysteriously burned to ashes, taking the souls of the old Master, his son, and the wife. Fumihiko, the grandson survived and is now living a life as Kanzaki, the married young banker who was demoted to an archive department. Little did the people around him know that the ordinary salaryman was a man with many faces who had been scheming the greatest revenge in Osaka for years. One by one, the chess pawn of Hashima, Inc. and Meiwa Bank, those who were responsible for Hyodo’s family death was subdued forever by Fumihiko with his lethal deception skill and a game of money...

(Source: Comikey)

196166.description:
Yae lives like a dead person, putting up with the pressure of work being forced upon her by her colleagues. While she is being used without any expectations of herself, she receives a call from her best friend from high school. What is her "last request" as she is on the brink of death due to illness...?

Nao is convinced to join the cheerleading club by her childhood friend Makoto, who says that he would love to have her cheer him on. Little does she know that all the batons she will be handling from now on are made out of meat.

Takumi, a high school student who lives with his beautiful and doting stepmother, is a typical teenage boy who falls in love with his childhood friend.

One day, Takumi's stepmother shockingly splits into four people! yandere, tsundere, childish... These unique "Mamas" try all sorts of ways to support (and hinder) Takumi's love life... A heartwarming (?) "Mama-less" romantic comedy with four moms begins!

In the early Showa period, Ginza, which had made a spectacular recovery from the Great Kanto Earthquake, had a cutting-edge professional woman called the "Stick Girl." When customers "want to see, buy, or eat," these women act as a "stick" to guide them. One day, Michi, a maid working as a guard for the daughter of a distinguished family, begins working on the street as a "Stick Girl" to protect the daughter. But Ginza is full of thrills!

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

Drunk after her latest heartbreak, lazy game addict Sylvia buys a mysterious game called V-Card Raider. However, before she even gets to play, she dies of alcohol poisoning and finds herself transported into the game world. There, she is told by a god that she is on the fast track to hell unless she sleeps with the main characters, collects the seeds of the World Tree, and saves the game universe! Is there a catch? While he was brainstorming strategies with his friend who calls himself a whistleblower, he starts receiving unknown text messages from the future...

A fierce battle to seize the initiative in power and Seo-Jun's confident rise to fame after obtaining the text messages from the future!

Seo Tae-Ja, a deliveryman for ‘Brother’s Noodle House,’ finds himself transported to another world—where he becomes the first-ever deliveryman in a land of magic and chaos!

Joo Hyun-Tae, who was always alone because of his fierce appearance, thought that his life would change after entering Korea University. 196183.description:

They have their sweet fun and make a pact to meet for Yoo-Hyuk’s cycles, but Woo-Jin wants more. He’s smitten! Yoo-Hyuk can’t believe someone could be serious about a mean, large omega with an unusual trait like himself. Can Woo-Jin convince Yoo-Hyuk of his sincerity, or will their relationship end before it can really get started?

(Source: Tapas)

196184.description:
Hong Zheng, a genius blessed to have the "Ancestral Blood" running in his body, was flamed by his childhood sweetheart and tortured by a friend to death. Ten years later, he resurrects with none of his talents left. Much to his surprise, he later on discovers that he is able to absorb the energy of a dragon skeleton after a spider-like monster enters his body. With the energy growing within him, he is ready to retaliate his old enemies and punish those who wronged him!

(Source: WebComics)

196185.description:
When a newly opened beta game is invaded by a mysterious AI, the once carefree adventure world turns into an inescapable loop. The AI-affected, self-aware Final Boss resolves to protect its game and restore it to its original form!

Mozumi, the chief of the accounting team who is feared by the staff for his intimidating look, has a secret. He loves, loves, loves cute things and sweets! Riku has a secret that he cannot tell anyone. The trauma he has experienced due to the sensitivity of the inside of his mouth has made him afraid of kissing. After traveling into a historical BL novel, the actor Lin Yan gains a special ability: fast-traveling through a skill called [Escape Death]. His first mission? To secretly orchestrate an attack on Prince Qi Zhen, which leads to the prince becoming the villain. Lin Yan’s first identity in this world is none other than Lin Shou Yan, the prince’s foolish fiancé. But as he plays his role, he accidentally captures the prince’s heart, and his fake death turns out to be the key reason Qi Zhen becomes a ruthless tyrant! A cold, overthinking tsundere prince and his scheming, perverted fiancé—chaos ensues!

196209.description:
Plain, ugly, and dull office lady Yumeko has a secret obsession - to check on the social media posts of "AYA", a beautiful and attractive shop clerk who lives in a fancy world entirely different from her own. One day, she finds out that AYA is looking for a new member of staff, so she decides to quit her company and go for the job in order to build her self-confidence and change her life.

Yumeko goes to the interview in high spirits only to be faced with none other than Aya, the person who bullied Yumeko relentlessly when they were students. Is this the real "AYA" she's always dreamed of meeting?! The old Yumeko would have run away out of fear, but thinking that Aya had changed and captivated by her sweet smile, she decides to take the job. Power harassment, public humiliation... Aya bullies Yumeko mercilessly, exposing her true nature for the world to see.

196211.description:
When the villainess comes back to life, she discovers that the prince who once hated her is now madly in love with her?!

In this world, "Predators" are the rulers who wield powerful magic, while those born with the "Mark of Sacrifice" are despised as mere wells of magic for Predators to absorb and tools for bearing offspring. Prince Greg, second in line to the throne, recently rejected a marriage offer from Lady Letishia, a vile Predator. Determined to understand his reasons, she confronts him at the palace—only for both of them to become victims of an assassination attempt, losing their lives in the process. The next moment, Letishia finds herself transported back in time to the day she went to see Greg. Yet, this miraculous second chance comes at a price: she now bears the Mark of Sacrifice. Imprisoned by her family and facing a future of exploitation, Letishia strikes a deal with Greg, offering him her magic in exchange for his protection. Though they wed under the terms of a loveless contract, Greg seems to have fallen deeply in love with Letishia. But is this genuine love, or is it simply the mark’s influence?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

title.english: Once a Predator, Now a Sacrifice

title.romaji: Ikenie Akujo wa Seiteki Oujo no Ban to Naru

196212.description:
Neet van Avadora, the second prince of the great kingdom of Astoria, is a homebody who loves nothing more than staying indoors. After cutting himself off from the outside world for years to devote himself to magical research, he has, without even realizing it, grown into a true prodigy of magic.

One day, however, under orders from his father the king, Neet is forced, much against his will, to enroll in the Magic Academy. There, he gradually begins to enjoy student life, blessed with quirky but kind friends. But because of his overwhelming magical talent, he constantly finds himself caught up in one troublesome incident after another…!

Meanwhile, Alex, the first prince, and the very cause of Neet’s growth into an unknowing genius, sets a certain “plan” into motion. This plan will spark a great incident, one that will change not only Neet’s fate, but also the fate of the entire kingdom of Astoria…

(Source: Alphapolis, translated)

Sophia, the eldest daughter of a duke family, is caught in a nasty trap set by her stepsister Alice and sent to the execution block. At the moment she loses her life with intense regret, time rewinds back to 10 years ago!

"I won't make any more mistakes this time. I'll take everything from Alice!"

Sophia, burning with a desire for revenge, approaches the first prince, Leo, on whom Alice is obsessed. Before time was rewinded, Leo was infamously known as the "cold-blooded prince." However, what she sees there is a puppy-like boy sobbing in the shadows of a fountain...

196220.description:
Nijiho, a third-year junior high school student, is doing well in her studies and has many great friends. However, her world changes suddenly when her father has an accident. The door between the ordinary and extraordinary is surprisingly close by...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

196221.description:
Ushio is the prince of the girls' high school, with her beautiful looks, academic abilities, and athletic talents. Contrary to her appearance, she is a young girl who dreams of marrying her childhood friend and boyfriend, Yuu. One day, her cousin, Souichirou, a high school teacher, appears before her. Souichirou, who has known Ushio since childhood, finds out about her relationship with Yuu and her career aspirations, and takes a certain action...

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: あの子はいつも僕が好き
title.romaji: Ano Ko wa Itsumo Boku ga Suki

196225.description:
A collection of self-published extra stories for Boku no Mii-chan:

1. Hoshi no Sakana (星のさかな, My meteor)
2. Mii-chan Collection (ミーちゃんコレクション)
3. Kimi to Ano Hoshi ga Mitai (君とあの星が見たい, The stars I want to see with you)
synonyms: ミーちゃんコレクション
Kimi to Ano Hoshi ga Mitai
The stars I want to see with you

title.romaji: Beside You: Boku no Mii-chan Doujinshuu

196226.description:
Melon is clumsy and bad at everything - he knows this much about himself, and he's never let it bother him. What does bother him, though, is that he has no money, no place to stay, he's quit school, he's hungry, he's in a city he doesn't know well, and it's raining... And yet, he meets someone who's having an even worse day than him, one Kawai-san, who wastes no time in inviting him up to his apartment for a hot meal and sex.

Melon decides on the spot that he'll be Kawai-san's kept boy! Why not? Kawai-san is rich, and Melon, as it turns out, likes sex with men. But are things between them really that simple...?

Notes:
- Originally serialized under the title "Tako Ball & LOVE (タコボール＆LOVE)."
- Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: よきヒモとよき飼い主

196228.description: A poetic oneshot dealing with love and its loss.

title.native: ちょっと一回つきあってみる？ ～スイートアワー1Rプロローグ～
title.romaji: Chotto Ikkai Tsukiatte Miru?: Sweet Our 1R Prologue

196234.description:
Ours, a small idol group with talent but low recognition, recruits visual member X to enter the music charts. With X's appearance, Ours explodes in popularity! They are truly at the peak of their career. However, X dies in an unexpected accident... The protagonist, Luan, who can control corpses, must use his powers to protect his position as a top idol!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: 奪われ聖女と呪われ騎士団の聖域引き篭もりスローライフ
title.romaji: Ubaware Seijo to Noroware Kishidan no Seiiki Hikikomori Slow Life

196251.description:
I am a wanderer martial artist. I don’t shy away from blood, but I’m ready to retire. Should I take one last job? or not? For many long years, he has roamed as a wandering martial artist's, living as a hired blade to make ends meet. But now, he finds himself utterly penniless, living in poverty with nothing to his name. As a master of martial arts at the peak level, he makes a decision, to take on one final, high-stakes mission, earn a fortune, and put an end to his life as a wanderer. The story follows his journey as he takes on this last assignment and the unexpected twists that unfold along the way.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

196252.description:
What happens when the devil takes a liking to you? That's what happened to one boy, who happened to end up in the devil's seductive gaze. An underworld fantasy BL about an obsessed demon and a pitiful boy just trying to escape!

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: 冥婚―花嫁くんは転生前夜―

196253.description:
The beautiful Kaede is no longer there. A BL between a pheromone-type handsome boy, and his overprotective, ordinary childhood friend!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: My Horny Friend with a Beautiful Face
title.native: ドスケベなアイツの、知らない顔
title.romaji: Dosukebe na Aitsu no, Shiranai Kao

196254.description:
"Let's make a baby and become a family."
A naughty playboy and a gorgeous yet mysterious guy try to start a family together!

Spike is a sociable, street-smart young man who enjoys living life on his own terms. But one day, a handsome guy falls out of a tree and into his life! His name is Yuni, and suddenly, he declares that he wants "lots of Spike's babies"! No matter how attractive Yuni is, Spike insists he's not into guys… or so he thinks. Despite his initial resistance, Yuni's strange charm lures him in. Spike decides to make a move on him, but their chemistry is so undeniable that they end up melting in each others arms!

(Source: Coolmic)

196255.description:
In the a certain Red-Light District there's a certain 15-year-old called Yuugiri Tayuu who happens to run into trouble with the many customers of the district.
This series follows her and some odd people she meets with a punch of action and some intrigue.

196257.description:
The goal is to create an interesting manga!!

Yamanoi is a rookie manga editor who works hard every day with her dream in mind, along with her best friend. One day, she learns that the magazine she is assigned to, "Monthly Trilemma," is in danger of being discontinued. To help turn it around, she is headhunted by a talented editor whose works have sold over 50 million copies!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

196258.description:
"Congratulations! You 25 have been chosen as heroes to save the world!"

Just before summer vacation in their third year of middle school, a class is suddenly transported to another world by the goddess Ashera. The 26 students are given statuses that allow them to use skills and cheat abilities to become heroes in the other world. However, the number of students transported is 25—leaving behind Shuu Iori, the boy who had just transferred and wasn't counted.

While his classmates train in the other world to prepare for their battles as heroes, Shuu remains in peaceful Japan, devoting himself to studying the status he was given. Quietly experimenting with his skills, he occasionally uses them to help those around him. But before he realizes it, Shuu has become a target of various organizations around the world—!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: My Classmates Became Heroes in Another World, But I Was Left Behind in Modern Japan

title.native: クラスメイトは異世界で勇者になったけど、俺だけ現代日本に置き去りにされました
title.romaji: Classmate wa Isekai de Yuusha ni Natta kedo, Ore dake Gendai Nihon ni Okizari ni Narimashita

196262.description:
Werner, a brilliant and hardworking magic tool researcher at the Empire’s top institution, the Sage’s Academy, suddenly finds himself expelled by a jealous chancellor looking to profit off of Werner’s inventions.

But without Werner, the Academy quickly hits a well, and not a single new magic tool could be developed. It turns out Werner’s theories are way too advanced for anyone else to follow!

While the academy flounders, Werner attracts attention from all walks of life—from a maiden dragon to a princess. Armed with the strongest spells and magic tools, he’s ready to enjoy a laid-back life of research...surrounded by cute apprentices to boot!

A stunning comic adaptation of the original light novel by Ezogingitune, author of "I Became a Legend After My 10 Year-Long Last Stand” and "The Strongest Wizard Becomes a Countryside Guard After Taking an Arrow to the Knee!"

(Source: Manga UP! Global)

title.english: Cast-off Magic Tool Researcher is Actually an S-rank Mage
title.native: 非戦闘職の魔道具研究員、実は規格外のＳランク魔導師 ～勤務時間外に無給で成果を上げてきたのに無能と言われて首になりました～
title.romaji: Hi-sentoushoku no Madougu Kenkyuuin, Jitsu wa Kikakugai no S-Rank Madoushi: Kinmu Jikangai ni Mukyuu de Seika wo Agete Kita noni Munou to Iwarete Kubi ni Narimashita

196263.description:
"Saunoa!" is a story that begins when Kageyama Kokage, a high school girl who hates baths, meets Ryudia, an exchange student from Finland, the home of saunas. Ryudia is staying at the Hana no Yu public bathhouse, and Kokage can't refuse her invitations, so she starts going to the bathhouse almost every day, even though she hates baths. Her first experience in a sauna is so hot it feels like torture, and Kokage would rather play games if she had time to relax in the bathtub. However, she is considerate of Ryudia, who believes that "Kokage-san also loves public baths," so she continues to go to the bathhouse every day. She is joined by class president Shimizu Serika, who knows a lot about saunas, and Takano Maki, the daughter of a super public bathhouse owner, and the girls' daily lives in saunas are depicted.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

Initially began as a guest serialization on March 16, 2023. It later began full serialization on June 19, 2023.

196264.description:
"Toshishita no Sake Senpai ga Kawaii" is a four-panel romantic comedy about Yamada, a man who has changed jobs to work as a front-end engineer at a web production company, and his female senior, Miyama Sui, who trains him. Sui is small and cute, but reliable, and although she is younger than Yamada, she sometimes shows a strangely uncle-like side. When the two go to an izakaya after work, Sui happily shares trivia about her favorite sake, and Yamada becomes attracted to her.

(Source: Natalie, translated)
synonyms: The younger sake senior is cute.

title.native: 年下の酒先輩が可愛い
title.romaji: Toshishita no Sake Senpai ga Kawaii

196265.description:
Daniel Kim, who used to be a regular teacher, is visited by a mysterious girl who claims to have came to him to repay his kindness. With that, Daniel's fight against the cosmic beings begin.

(Source: DAYcomics)

196274.description:
Chitose is the youngest daughter of the Totsuki clan, known for their vast lineage. Blessed with good looks and spiritual energy, she receives an unending string of marriage proposals. When her older sister, Kuon, lays a trap for her, Chitose is left cursed and transformed into an old woman. Although Chitose always loved children and hoped to become a mother someday, her dreams have been dashed, and she must spend her days suffering Kuon’s abuse, which she bravely endures… until a mysterious man named Kotaro appears before her and declares that he will grant her wish!

(Source: K MANGA)

title.english: A Thousand Years Behind the Veil

title.native: 夫の不倫相手は私になりたい会社のあの子。
title.romaji: Otto no Furin Aite wa Watashi ni Naritai Kaisha no Ano Ko.

196276.description:
He controls her! He criticizes her cooking! He denies her affection and belittles her! Yuuka is a full-time housewife whose husband is piece of trash. She was already fed up with his emotional abuse, but her husband is also having an affair! He seems to be trying to hide it well, but his new girlfriend, a modern woman, is posting hints on social media. However, contrary to her husband's expectations, who thinks Yuuka is a "naive and dull woman," Yuuka and his girlfriend are from the same generation! Digital natives! In other words, evidence is piling up. In order to live happily with her daughter, she must not take the easy way out by "just getting a divorce without any preparation," but must take revenge and squeeze out child support and alimony!!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.romaji: 100-nichigo ni Otto wo Suteru Tsuma no Hanashi

title.native: 凸凹×コミュニケーション
僕の大好きな赤い薔薇

196280.description:
After I-Han Jeong’s mother and brother died in a car crash when she was just 9 years old, she was raised by Chi-O Han and his parents, who lived next door. Now about to attend university, I-Han suddenly finds herself living with Chi-O under one roof, and she realizes that she feels more than just familial affection for her brother figure. While trying to deal with her trauma and the awkwardness of freshman life, I-Han meets Yu-Jin Seo, a champion judoka at their university who is the spitting image of her late brother. And now he's moving in next door?!

(Source: WEBTOON)

196281.description:
Hongmun was a lowly warrior who secretly mastered the Dan Clan’s forbidden martial arts. In a battle against the Black Flame Sect, he met his death. But when he opened his eyes, he had become Wolbin Dan, the infamous fourth young master of the Dan Clan. Now blessed with a body perfectly suited for the martial arts, he is determined to rewrite the past and prevent the destruction of the Dan Clan with his own hands.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: The Dan Family's Good-For-Nothing Is Too Strong

title.english: The Mighty Delinquent of the Dan Clan

196282.description:
Chimera hunter Number 17 has spent decades hunting monsters. On his latest mission, he’s ordered to ensure the human hunters’ escape and never return to base. In other words, he’s meant to die. As his body dissolves, his life flashes before him: kidnapped as a boy, forced into endless battles, reduced to a mindless weapon. But against all odds, his body reforms into his human form. No longer Chimera Hunter Number 17, he stands before a vast open land on his own two feet as Do-un Cheon, a human, ready to start his life anew, making friends out of monsters and building the family he never had.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: S級獵人的療癒魔界生活
S-Rank Hunter Who Heals with Monsters

It was supposed to be the beginning of a serialization but due to issues in the editorial department of the magazine the series was cancelled and only the first chapter was released.

196289.description:
Ohashi, who is an university student, prides himself with his hot hunk body. One day, Ohashi is taped off by Dr Shibazaki, who is a professor of psychology at his university. But in fact, Shibazaki is also an expert of BDSM, and a skilled Master who trained many slaves in the past. Shibazaki finds that Ohashi has the potential to become a good slave.

196291.description:
"Boku" is an ordinary otaku salaryman. When his roommate suddenly leaves, the person who comes to take their place is a "female armored knight"! Living with such a noble being enriches the life of this otaku. A new urban fantasy begins!

(Source: Comic OGYAAA!!, translated)

196292.description:
Shen Yue is a woman with a powerful nose and talented skill at blending scents. But she has been abused and abandoned as a "ghost" of the land of scents. Saved by Ye Jing, the prince of the kingdom and the young boy Shen Yue once met long ago as children, they embark on a mission to gather the Hundred Scents and return Yue's lost memories.

(Source: K MANGA)

196293.description:
Navin, a 13-year-old girl who lived peacefully in a small village in the mountains, lost everything in an instant. The invasion of Adelea's army led by Prince Lucian saw her village burned, her friends enslaved, and her mother beheaded before her eyes. Burning with hatred, Navin is picked up by Lucian, her mother's enemy, and forced to swear loyalty to him. She serves him in the closest place possible, in order to kill him one day.

A master-servant relationship connected by murderous intent—the beginning of a full-scale fantasy tale of revenge.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

196294.description:
A fiery married couple dives into the streaming world when the wife, a rising VTuber, makes her husband her manager. Between chaotic broadcasts and suspicious fans, his secret past with a top streamer slowly comes to light…

Humans are social animals... But what if they stop bonding all of a sudden?

(Source: DAYcomics)

Gavin and his friends set foot in the land of ghosts. Lured by an evil spirit, they find themselves entering a place they should have never dared to go. There, they witness unimaginable sights. Will they be able to escape from that place unharmed?

196312.description:
The office lady Yuzuru Miyahara broke up with her boyfriend last month. The reason was the same as always: Yuzuru's strong sexual desire and “a certain sexual fetish” caused her to get dumped. That certain fetish is... masturbating with a stuffed animal!

Yuzuru, unable to find a suitable partner, decides to try a dating app recommended by a friend, one that matches people based on their sexual fetishes! Hesitant at first, she begins exchanging messages with a man who went by the name “Fujikuma” on the app and agrees to meet him.

On the day of the meeting, the person who shows up turns out to be her junior colleague, Fujiwara-kun...! Yuzuru tries to brush it off, for the sake of her future at work, but she's swept away by Fujiwara-kun's kind words and ended up going to a hotel with him—?

196322.description:
A young artist informed by the Gekiga masters, this is a book for lovers of Seiichi Hayashi, Yoshiharu Tsuge, Shinichi Abe, Tadao Tsuge, Osamu Kanno: artists mining from an expressive, personal vein.

Collects several self-published works, as well as stories issued in alternative manga magazine Kakuu.

(Source: Glacier Bay Books)

196323.description:
1. Ikyouto no Koiuta (異教徒の恋唄)

3. Yoru wa Fantasy (夜はファンタジー)
