title.romaji: Ikyouto no Koiuta: Pagan Love Song

196324.description:
"I never actually came before..."

Kanae is just your average college student having trouble with her boyfriend in bed. One night staying at her sister's place, her sister's boyfriend, Yukiji, mistakenly gets in bed with her instead! Kanae's got no idea what to do about the whole thing, and when she finally confronts Yukiji... he doubles down and suggests a pact to do this more?! She knows it's wrong... but can't help but think about all these new feelings...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

196326.description:
One day, diehard manboob-lover Komai is hit by the sight of his senior colleague Kushiro's button-bursting cleavage, and instantly falls in love! Troubled over his lust for the soft-spoken Kushiro, Komai attempts to avoid his colleague. However, his efforts are in vain, and his lower half grows ever-closer to going berserk. On the other hand, Kushiro notices that Komai is struggling with a problem, and offers to help with "anything" that's within his ability. The offer is met by Komai's desperate plea, "Please let me fondle your voluptuous chest!" What Komai didn't expect is that Kushiro surprisingly... agrees?!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Please Let Me Fondle Your Voluptuous Chest!
title.native: せんぱい、もませてください！

196327.description:
"I guess we'll start with one box's worth."
Watch sparks fly between an inexpressive retail worker and his regular customer, a nonchalant businessman, in this naughty romantic comedy... about condoms?!

Toma works at a convenience store, and recently, Sakurai, who comes in every Friday like clockwork to buy condoms, has piqued his curiosity. He's just his type, and has been fantasizing about getting with him. Luckily, an opportunity to use those condoms together is about to fall into his lap! While Sakurai seems nice on the surface, he kisses Toma so passionately that he can't help but moan. "You're so cute... I can't help myself," he confesses. Toma's inexpressiveness might just be gone for good... In one night, they use three whole boxes of condoms!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Wanna Use Those Condoms With Me?
title.native: そのゴム、オレと使いませんか？
title.romaji: Sono Gomu, Ore to Tsukaimasen ka?

196329.description:
Dana, a Korean high school senior just days away from her college entrance exam, meets an unlucky end. Hit by the infamous "romance fantasy truck" and reborn in another world, she figures she might as well make the best out of it, but she suddenly stumbles across the Saintess's secret!

"I don't want to die, so I guess I'll keep the cat in the bag, Saintess!"

(Source: WEBTOON)

196330.description:
Jewelry designer Park Eun-Hyeon is looking for someone to help him make a ring when an acquaintance introduces him to a craftsman with quick hands. Eun-Hyeon, who desperately needs help with an urgent deadline, goes to meet him right away... The person who appears in front of her is Kang Yu-Chan, his junior and partner from college. He worries for a moment that Yu-Chan will cling to him like he did back then, but the collaboration between the two seems smooth...

"Senior, it's been a while since you've written something, right?"

Eun-Hyeon is helplessly falling for him who seduces him with his perfect face..! In the meantime, the deadline is approaching!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

196331.description:
As the second son of a shaman family, Su-Ho was born with insufficient yang energy and has been plagued by ghosts since childhood. He was able to be free from ghosts as long as he wore the family heirloom ring he received from his grandmother. However, on the first day of college, he lost the ring. He ran away from the ghosts that had started appearing again and found himself in an alley. There, he encountered a man wearing his ring…

“Give me back the ring.”

“I can’t give you the ring. I have to be with you.”

Su-Ho is flustered by Shin-Woo, who uses the ring as a hostage and manipulates him as he pleases. It seems clear that they shouldn’t get involved any further—but why does he keep getting drawn to Shin-Woo? What will be the end of this strange relationship that started over a single ring?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
synonyms: A God Is Better Than a Ghost

196332.description:
Finally, Go Eun-Woo has been appointed as the first health teacher. His job satisfaction is 100%. Stable, sweet vacation, relatively punctual work hours. 'A neat and handsome health teacher with a sad look.' All the fellow teachers and students look favorably on Eun-Woo. Oh, just one person. Except for the ethics teacher Im Seok-Ju who seems to have come from the Joseon Dynasty.

"What did you teach in sex education? Why are you handing out these things (condoms)?"

"Haven't you ever thought that you'd get complaints from the school administrators?"

"Sexual intercourse. It's a noble act that a man and a woman unite to conceive a life when they truly love each other after marriage."

Im Seok-Ju, who advocates premarital chastity, and Go Eun-Woo, who pursues MAX sexual desire and free sexual relations, were fundamentally mismatched from start to finish. Of course, that was until he saw Im Seok-Ju masturbating in the bathroom.

"Teacher, should I help you?"

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

196334.description:
At the very end of his junior year in high school, Daniel finally decides to confess his feelings to Mia by giving her a heartfelt letter. However, the person who shows up isn't Mia but Jade, the infamous troublemaker known for her rough personality. A chaotic romance begins between two people who couldn't be more different.

"Do you really like me?"

(Source: DAYcomics)

196335.description:
The strongest delivery man saves your stomach, and the other-worldly Uberworld is born!

In another world, the defense city of "City of Dawn" was once the front line against the enemies of humanity.

"True Dragon's Tamagotei" is located there and offers delivery services.

Specialized delivery staff will deliver delicious meals to any location. *However, the contents of the meal cannot be specified.

A new gourmet fantasy created by Natsuya Semikawa, the popular author of "Izakaya in Another World" "Nobu", and talented author Michi Saitou!!

title.native: 異世界最強の出前バイト

196336.description:
"If I had never met you..." Those were the last words Rosa heard from her husband, Claude, on the day he was killed. Although her marriage was politically motivated due to her failure to become a saintess, Rosa truly loved him and believed she was the cause of his death. Overcome with despair, she lost consciousness. When she awakens, she finds herself six years in the past! Determined to save her love, she resolves to avoid their marriage, but fate has other plans for them.

(Source: MangaPlaza)
synonyms: 파멸의 성녀는 운명의 남편의 익애에서 벗어나고 싶다

196341.description:
"Before selling your body to some random guy, isn't there a perfect sales target right in front of you?"

... Such villainous lines are often uttered by the "son of a company president." However, it is only to lend a helping hand to the "person he loves" who is saddled with a huge debt.

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title.native: 悪役令息、好きな人を金で買う
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reisoku, Suki na Hito wo Kane de Kau

196342.description:
"I'll help you with your 'special training'!"

Aspiring actor, Tetsu, spends day after day auditioning for roles, but is turned down due to his delinquent personality, leaving him with little choice but to lodge with his long time friend, Satoshi, who is a popular scriptwriter. Finally, a shot at a lead role presents itself to a disparaged Tetsu, but the offer turns out to be for a "man on man romance" movie. Being attracted to men himself, Satoshi offers Tetsu his guidance to help him get into character, but ends up getting jeered at... Clearly irritated, Satoshi says, "Fine. I'll help you out as an 'experiment'. Why don't we give it a try?" And with that, the two friends cross a line they never thought they would... all because of a movie! A cool-headed, popular writer meets an idiotic delinquent actor in this heart-pounding sensual story!

(Source: Renta!)

Notes:
- Originally serialized under the title "Yatte mo Yaru to wa Itte Nee! (演ってもヤるとは言ってねぇ！)".
- Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: 演ってもヤるとは言ってねぇ！
Yatte mo Yaru to wa Itte Nee!

title.native: ヤンキー俳優、えっちな演技指導されてます。
title.romaji: Yankee Haiyuu, Ecchi na Engi Shidou Saretemasu.

196343.description:
Rough and fierce delinquent Jang Tae-ho gets dragged to a countryside house on the first day of summer vacation due to his parents' scheme(?). What awaits him there is none other than the gangster princess Min Ju-ah! Min Ju-ah points a gun at the bewildered Jang Tae-ho and says... "I kidnapped you here to make you my subordinate." A chaotic summer vacation story of delinquent Jang Tae-ho and gangster princess Min Ju-ah!

(Source: Naver, translated)

196344.description:
Freelance killer (assistant) Joo-Won, in his 8th year, gets caught up in a big problem when he meets a new assistant, K.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: チノトモ 吸血鬼を支配する血の話
title.romaji: Chi no Tomo: Kyuuketsuki wo Shihai Suru Chi no Hanashi

196346.description:
Joo-Hyun Mo, CEO, has a big day ahead, and is awaiting her big break, when she gets into a car accident. She wakes up, but is reborn as the third daughter of the evil emperor, Mezan Nox. Without a clue as to why this has happened, Mo lives as Gloria for seven years before she finally gains a clue into a magic portal that could help her go back to her world. She is determined to play the part of docile sister to evil father and mini-me daughter, Isabelle, while also looking up to her oldest half-sister, Dorothy. With the help of a prince from another country Rubilion's Autus, she finally passes through the portal, only to be met by an even more impossible deal: she must sell her soul and succeed in seeing her father fall to his miserable death, just as the real Gloria wished before she died. She has one shot to succeed, and to go back to her own world.

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

title.english: I Vow to Take the Tyrant's Throne
title.native: 悪女ですが、生まれたついでに皇帝になろうと思います
title.romaji: Akujo desu ga, Umareta Tsuide ni Koutei ni Narou to Omoimasu

196347.description:
It's Fall of their senior year in middle school. Due to her parents' divorce, an emptiness has settled at the bottom of Azusa's heart. Her classmate, Itsuki, has experienced the same with his parents' divorce and sees through Azusa's feelings. Sharing this "something," the two of them promise to be together for the rest of their lives despite all the changes happening around them. What is a bond that lasts forever? What is a real bond like?

This is a story of how the two of them move forward while in doubt and fumbling around for answers.

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

196348.description:
To protect the boss he admires, they made this choice?!

Subordinate Sasahara loves and respects his bright and cheerful superior, Takitani. One day, after discovering that Takitani was being abused by his ex-boyfriend, Sasahara decides to live with him temporarily to keep him safe. Even in private, Takitani's positivity makes Sasahara's heart race. But when Takitani's ex-boyfriend shows up, yelling, "Get out of here!" Sasahara realizes they have to act like a couple in front of him. What started as a way to fend off the ex is quickly turning into something much more complicated…

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: If I Steal You, Can I Love You?
title.native: 奪ったフリして愛でちゃダメ?

196349.description:
Reon Kamei is a gyaru with many interests—so much so that when asked about her future career prospects, she answers, “Everything!” Her life takes a bizarre turn when the ghost of a deceased voice actor possesses and haunts her. As she spends time with him, Reon is drawn to the world of voice acting, a profession where you can truly become everything. But for a high schooler with zero experience, breaking into the industry is a steep climb. Spirited in more ways than one, this ghost and gyaru duo, bound by their love for the craft, are ready to make some noise!

(Source: Manga UP!)

title.english: AGERECO! Getting Into the Voice Acting Spirit!

196350.description:
What do I do? I think my sister is plotting to destroy the world! Recently, my sweet and adorable sister suddenly became strangely irritable and violent. According to my investigations, not only has my sister become involved in a murder, she is also possessed by a witch from a thousand years ago! Now, my sister seems to be plotting to destroy the world! What’s worse, my sister is trying to pin the blame on me. She even told me that the food in prison is delicious and that there is good company in there! What am I supposed to do as an ordinary person?!

(Source: Bilibili Comic)

title.english: My Sister Is Out to Destroy the World

196352.description:
Summer, 1945. Shumushu Island, at the northeastern tip of the Kuril Islands, is the front line of the war against the United States.

On this far northern island, after the Pacific War was supposed to have ended, an unexpected battle is about to begin.

(Source: Gekkan Sunday, translated)

A manga artist on the verge of being canceled is reborn into the world of a "dark manga history" he drew in his junior high school days!

The unconventional manga artist success story begins!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

Note: An extra chapter is included

196360.description:
“What's a happy marriage?”

Kaoru Kirishima, 29 years old, single. Dreaming of becoming a novelist, she dedicates herself to her writing activities alongside her work, but then, she finds out that the theme of her novel is "Happy Marriage." She finds marriage unattractive. It's the most distant topic she could think of, and she's been worried about it for days. In the midst of this, she happens to meet a man named Moroboshi who desperately wants to get married. They become close friends as they talk about their views on marriage. However, Kaoru's thoughts on marriage were painful and sad...

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

title.native: わたし、結婚しないので

196362.description:
Aya Honjo is a model for a fashion magazine for working women. Her appearance and age (26) gives her audience a sense of intimacy, which is the cause of her popularity... but it's all a lie! The real me without make-up is an ugly, gloomy... 16-year-old high school girl!! I already have my hands full with my own life, but then one day, I ended up picking up my classmate, Shuya, in my model appearance... Huh? He's telling me to let him live with me for some reason! On top of that, not realizing that I'm his classmate, he's trying to use his looks to get to me...

"If you wish, I’ll even do things... Like that."

The peculiar double life of Shuya, who's a tengu, and I, who's faking her age and hiding her identity, begins!

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

title.english: Shuya Is My Shallow Tengu Housemate
title.native: 修也くんは同居人で、チャラくて、天狗
title.romaji: Shuuya-kun wa Doukyonin de, Chara kute, Tengu

196363.description:
The abandoned girl is the strongest saint!? She shows no mercy to her enemies! The long-awaited comic adaptation of the popular work from "Let's Become a Novelist"!

Sonia was abused by her aunt's family and abandoned in the forest. Sonia prepares herself for death, but is picked up by the kind-hearted priest Farne and begins to regain her physical and mental health...!? A refreshing story of the abandoned saint!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: 虐待されていた商家の令嬢は聖女の力を手に入れ、無自覚に容赦なく逆襲する
title.romaji: Gyakutai Sareteita Shouka no Reijou wa Seijo no Chikara wo Te ni Ire, Mujikaku ni Youshanaku Gyakushuu suru

196364.description:
Build a powerful house and restore the proud heritage of the vampires! But first, some desserts and shopping! Anne wakes up from her sleep when Eden, the alchemist of time, removes the spear that had put her in a 200-year slumber. The world has changed greatly during that time. Humans have won the war of the races, made great technological advancements, and created a wonderful thing called ice cream. She must now venture through the world of humans with Eden to build a house worthy of her name.

(Source: WEBTOON)

196365.description: Note: Originally released at Comiket 97, was then licensed by CLLENN along with "Midnight Rescue (ミッドナイトレスキュー)".

title.native: ミッドナイトエクスキューズ

196366.description:
"Sleep with the women living in this building- whether through blackmail, seduction, or even force."

Lee Han accepts the sweet but dangerous offer that could turn his miserable life upside down...

"Apartment 301, the married woman Su-Jin Han. I need to find this woman's weakness fast!"

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

ヤリマンションの管理人

196371.description:
"Here, it's yours." With only a key and car left behind by his vanished father, Ikuto - now grown up and licensed to drive - defies his mother's attempts to get rid of the vehicle. He moves his belongings into the car and begins living there, but after a decisive argument one day, he runs away from home. Pressing the pedal to its limit as he races through mountain roads, that's when...!?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

196372.description:
A boy dreams of becoming a novelist. However, he faces a serious problem...! From the rising star author comes a story about a young dreamer's beginning.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

196375.description:
One morning, a boy wakes up to find a ghost that looks exactly like him?! Who or what is this mysterious spirit? Why has it appeared here and now...?

In a world devoid of birds, young Bram toils as a slave until he's ordered to care for Pecou, a child his own age. As their friendship blossoms, the two hatch a daring plan to escape to the vast skies in search of freedom. But what awaits them...?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

196380.description:
Red is a taxi driver who guides the deceased to heaven. One day, he picks up Marie, a young girl who died at an early age. Through their conversations in the taxi, Red helps Marie open up her heart. However, a Demon appears to obstruct their journey to heaven...!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Minato shares a house with Rin, who aspires to be an actor. Minato's heart was shaken by Rin's sudden engagement report... A painful and fragile youth story of young people living their dreams in Tokyo.

196383.description:
Blowing out birthday candles is a very important tradition that protects children from demons. So what happens to those children who never got a birthday cake...?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

196384.description: An online gag manga for the videogame Puella Magi Madoka Magica: Magia Exedra.
synonyms: いまからはじめるエクセドラ

196385.description:
Book presenting two stories:

1. JUNGLE EXPRESS
Burma, 1945... Under the waters of the Indian Ocean, a Japanese submarine glides slowly towards its homeland. But a stopover in the Philippines will change the mission of these men, who are already aware that the war is lost.

2. Ukraine konseiryodan (ウクライナ混成旅団)
1950, the post-war period is harsh for the combatants captured by the Russians. A Japanese prisoner was assigned to dismantle and repair tanks damaged in the fighting. The beginning of a long struggle for survival, in contact with Russians and Ukrainian independence fighters.

title.native: 幻の豹: The panther in Ukraina 1950
title.romaji: Maboroshi no Hyou: The panther in Ukraina 1950

196386.description:
Second Lieutenant Matsumoto, a fighter pilot in the Imperial Japanese Army, battles the Allied air forces in his Kawasaki Ki-61 ‘Hien’ (Tony) over the Solomons, New Guinea and the Philippines. Faced with opponents who always outnumbered him, he survived the fierce fighting thanks to his intelligence and the help of squadron leader Ozawa and his mechanic Hino. His final mission is to escort the Kamikaze planes off the Philippines...

(Source: Paquet, translated)

196387.description:
That man is the strongest agent, "Jupiter." He was an invincible guardian in the devastated parallel world "B-side," but after 15 years of avenging his sister, he retires from being an agent. Hiding his superhuman powers, he lives a peaceful second life in the "A-side" at the age of 33. It was supposed to be peaceful... But with the appearance of a girl with a certain situation, the man's life turns into a "trial"! With a new name and a new family, he lives a strange life "under one roof."

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

196391.description:
The "7G incident" has changed the world, changing places, people, and living things. Four girls set off on a train journey to the outside world, not knowing if they'll return alive, to meet their missing friend. What lies at the end of the train's journey?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Train to the End of the World

title.native: 終末トレインどこへいく？

196392.description:
After her beloved boyfriend broke off her engagement, Lilia was labeled a "villainous princess" by the people. She tried to make a comeback after becoming a recluse and was appointed captain of the Dragoon Corps, but an unexpected challenge awaited her...!

(Source: Young Champion Web, translated)
synonyms: The Villainous Princess as the Dragon Knight

title.native: 悪役王女の竜騎士団生活　～婚約破棄後に溺愛されても困ります！～

Collection of One-shots:

1. Kyuukouka Bakukeki Tai(急降下爆撃隊, Dive Bomber Squadron)
2. Furueten Seikuu Tai (震天制空隊, Shinten Air Control Squadron)
3. Bentai Kuusen Shirei (編隊空戦指令, Formation Air Combat Command)
4. Hien (飛燕, Hien)

196394.description: After Akiko is cheated on by the boyfriend she's living with, she has no choice but to return to her parents' home. At home for the first time in several years none of her family is there, only Tanaka, a handsome but brazen butler! Akiko is hesitant to rely on someone she's met for the first time, but she ends up being taken in by Tanaka, who is surprisingly kind(?). Their life together full of ups and downs now begins!?

title.native: 執事様は出戻り令嬢を甘やかさない
title.romaji: Shitsuji-sama wa Demodori Reijou wo Amayakasanai

196395.description:
A boy who dreams of being "overpowered" in another world finally gets his wish, but what he gets isn't a cheat, but a dud skill!? He gets a skill every time he dies an untimely death, but he always gets a dud. Then, on his fifth reincarnation, he gets lucky!? He won't be reincarnated again...! An "overpowered" story where encounters and experiences from another world blossom!

(Source: Champion Cross, translated)

title.native: ファイナル転生～ハズレスキルを引き続ける俺と各異世界最強の仲間たち～
title.romaji: Final Tensei: Hazure Skill wo Hikitsuzukeru Ore to Kaku Isekai Saikyou no Nakama-tachi

196396.description:
After starting the super-high-quality VRMMO "Meltis Online," Amane Rindou (Rinne) gets so annoyed at the guiding angel that she beats her up. Just when Rinne thinks she's stuck, an extremely cute gothic lolita evil goddess descends and offers her the hidden profession of "Necromancer"! With her servants in tow and leaving a pile of corpses in her wake, she's off to conquer the game as fast as she can! So begins this ultra-speed overpowered VRMMO tale!

(Source: Earth Star Entertainment, translated)

title.english: I Became a Necromancer After Beating Up My Angel Guide and Accidentally Triggered the Apocalypse
title.native: ガイド役の天使を殴り倒したら、死霊術師になりました～激カワゴスロリ魔神様、サイコー！～
title.romaji: Guide-yaku no Tenshi wo Naguri Taoshitara, Shiryoujutsushi ni Narimashita: Gekikawa Goth Loli Majin-sama, Saikou!

196397.description:
A certain general hospital in Tokyo admits cunning and ruthless criminals who have slipped through the fingers of the law. This is the workplace of Reiko Mikazuki—a beautiful and intelligent nurse admired by her patients and coworkers alike. However, behind her angelic face lies another persona: a merciless vigilante who deals out justice to evil-doers. Under the light of the moon, she delivers her judgments, but is she a beautiful angel in white, or a seductive demon with red-stained hands?

(Source: Coamix)

196398.description:
Twenty-year-old Jenna Shin has the ability to read how much others like her. But the more she learns about people's true feelings, the deeper her distrust grows... Until one day, a man appears who shows an unusually high level of affection toward her.

(Source: DAYcomics)

196399.description:
My brother's girlfriend is three years older than me, and she's so in love with me that she comes over to our house all the time, but for some reason, there's something strange about the distance between us...? This is the coming-of-age story of the troubled junior high school boy, Endo Tsukasa!

(Source: Champion Cross, translated)

196400.description:
Based on true accounts, Seiho Takizawa tells the story of wartime aviation. From the testing of new models to surprising confrontations between combat survivors, from Guadalcanal to the Yorktown aircraft carrier, the author takes us to the Pacific front with a historical rigour recognised by all specialists.

(Source: Paquet, translated)
synonyms: Un cri dans le ciel bleu

196401.description:
With his brash personality and muscular physique, and his fierce presence fighting against his country's foes, Salyu is known as the “Winter Bear of Tidros." Until one day when he finds himself engaged to Citron, a young lady whose betrothal was broken off in a neighboring country!

Starting with a kiss on the forehead, he fidgets awkwardly around this unfamiliar woman. Her smile makes his heart race, and glimpses of her cleavage leave him flustered. Salyu's mind runs wild with naughty thoughts, pushing his sanity to the brink! This chaotic, heart-pounding romantic fantasy comedy begins — with his inner thoughts coming through loud and clear!

(Source: Comic Pash, translated)
synonyms: My Wife from the Neighboring Country Is So Cute, I Don't Know What to Do!
鄰國來的新娘太可愛了該怎麼辦？

title.native: 隣国から来た嫁が可愛すぎてどうしよう。
title.romaji: Ringoku kara Kita Yome ga Kawaisugite Doushiyou.

196403.description:
One day, the JK influencer Komomo finds an inexperienced streamer playing guitar in his closet. Even though he was totally new to streaming, she though that his songs might be pretty good. Just to discover that the streamer was her seatmate: the gloomy prince, Irino!

When she told Irino that she was a fan, he asked her to teach him a way to increase his followers... The goal is 100,000 followers?!!

A romcom produced by a gloomy, handsome diamond in the rough!

196404.description:
In a world where monsters appear and the climate changes rapidly, the only place that maintains the form of a nation is the 'Special City'. There is the infamous esper unit 'Baekgun' that is dispatched to kill monsters and absorb the outside population. Baekgun's esper Shin Hwa-Jin lives being ignored because of his origin and weak abilities. Then one day, when he hears that his twin brother, a guide, was exploited and killed by his teammates, he goes on a rampage, kills his team, and jumps off a cliff. However, when he opens his eyes, he is in the 'Library' village where he is hiding from the Special City. Shin Hwa-Jin, who lost his memory due to the shock of the jump, is saved by Tan, a man who leads the library. Tan, who lost his home and family in the Baekgun's attack, dislikes Shin Hwa-Jin who speaks the Special City dialect, but he gradually grows affectionate towards him as he loses his memory and acts innocently, naming him Hima. As he spends time with Tan and deepens his feelings and contact, Hima gradually regains his original abilities...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title.native: 《最強ステータス》を引き継いで人間に転生した聖獣ベヒーモス、勇者の婚約者（お姫様）をうっかり寝取ってしまう
title.romaji: "Saikyou Status" wo Hikitsuide Ningen ni Tensei Shita Seijuu Behemoth, Yuusha no Konyakusha (Ohimesama) wo Ukkari Netotteshimau

196406.description:
Ryu was left behind by his childhood friend's heroic party, who told him that they could not take a trainer with them. He runs a ranch in the village, but he spends his days feeling unworthy. One day, he saves a wolf from a trap in the forest...

The wolf he rescued was actually Fenrir, a legendary demon! The elder of the pack has lost his magical powers and has been looking for someone to help him. No ordinary trainer can heal him, but Ryu has magical powers that exceed even those of his childhood friend, the hero...?

After successfully saving the elder, Ryu learns how to handle the enormous amount of magical power that could destroy him. He is adored by Fenrir pack and becomes an extraordinary trainer!

(Source: Starts Shuppan, translated)

title.native: 調教師は魔物に囲まれて生きていきます。～勇者パーティーに置いていかれたけど、伝説の魔物と出会い最強になってた～
title.romaji: Choukyoushi wa Mamono ni Kakomarete Ikiteikimasu. Yuusha Party ni Oiteikareta kedo, Densetsu no Mamono to Deai Saikyou ni Natteta

196407.description:
Iseo Jang, the Murim Alliance’s prodigy spy, has spent 14 years deep undercover in the Demon Sect, earning the ruthless title of “Rabid Dog” for his work as their counterintelligence agent. But his newest mission is his most absurd yet: make the Sect’s laziest, most notorious delinquent -- Wu Ma -- the next Cheonma. To pull it off, Iseo ditches his post and applies to be Wu Ma’s official aide. In a world of betrayal, martial arts, and political games, can even a talent like Iseo turn a hopeless young master into an heir?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: A Spy's Survival in the Demonic Cult
The Spy’s Life In The Demonic Cult

title.english: The Spy Life in the Demonic Sect

196408.description: Note: A live-action AV adaptation (URE-127) was released on September 9th, 2025.

妻にモザイク 〜愛する妻のNTR動画にモザイク処理させられる俺〜

196409.description:
As an intern at a marine research institute, Hyo-Seo finds himself overworked and overlooked. He's given the job no one else wants: caring for the aggressive orca everyone else fears. Hyo-Seo finds quiet comfort in the beast's presence, but after he starts speaking to it, strange things begin happening at the facility...

(Source: Manta)

At Dowonhyang, a secret luxury retreat for the elite, Cheong-Woo works as a server when he catches the eye of Won-Jae, a man of power and influence who always gets what he wants. Unfortunately for Cheong-Woo, what Won-Jae wants is him. Though Cheong-Woo tries to escape, the trap has already been set, pulling him into a dark, consuming spiral of desire and obsession he never saw coming.

(Source: Manta)

Maximum heart-throbbing innocent school love. ♪

196416.description:
The Second World War. The Pacific Front was the scene of legendary air battles between the American forces and the Imperial Japanese Army. Seiho Takizawa takes us on a tour of the New Guinea Campaign, following in the footsteps of Sergeant Unno, pilot of the Kawasaki Ki-45 and Nakajima Ki-43.

(Source: Paquet, translated)

196418.description:
The Second World War. In 1944, the pressure of the Allies, gathered around the American army, became more and more pressing on the Japanese Empire. Imperial Japanese garrisons and air forces held out on every occupied island in the Pacific, but now Tokyo was under threat...

(Source: Paquet, translated)

196427.description:
From "Moonlight Novels," a popular BL novel label, comes a luxurious comic adaptation by a talented team of artists! An anthology of Another World x Doting BL short stories♪

1. Oni Saishou to no Konyaku ga Kimattarashii (鬼宰相との婚約が決まったらしい) [Sako, Original Story: Taomi]
2. Mob ni Tensei Shita Hazu ka, Oji ni Netsuretsu ni Aisaretaimasu (モブに転生したはずが、推しに熱烈に愛されています) [Kon Arareya, Original Story: Naori)
3. Uchi ni Maou-sama ga Kahogo Sugiru (うちの魔王様が過保護すぎる) [Kurosaki, Original Story: Tatsushi Akiyama]
4. Nakimushi Majutsushi, Clear Go no Isekai Life (泣き虫魔術師、クリア後の異世界ライフ) [Komachi Machi, Original Story: Kanami]
5. Iya, Ore wa Goei Kishi desu ga: Yome Erabi de Ouji ga Eranda no wa, Soko ni Ita Otoko deshita (いや、俺は護衛騎士ですが～嫁選びで王子が選んだのは、そこにいた男でした～) [Shinobu Takayama, Original Story: Seven]

196429.description:
In the summer of her third year of high school, Mii's childhood friend Mayuka dies in a bus accident. She never knew why she got on a bus she didn't usually take... Now a university student, Mii moves into a new house and meets Maki, her neighbor. For some reason, Maki knows a secret about Mayuka...? When Mii and Maki meet, the truth surrounding Mayuka's death begins to unfold.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

196430.description:
Sakurai (33), a single manga artist who is enjoying her single life, suddenly becomes interested in marriage...!? Will she be able to meet her soulmate in the difficult marriage hunt that lies ahead?!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

196431.description:
Shio, the prince of the girls' high school, is beautiful and excels in both academics and sports. Contrary to her unapproachable demeanor, she is a pure-hearted maiden who is devotedly in love with someone... This omnibus presents a heart-wrenching and lovely story woven around Shio.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 愛しの可愛い子ちゃん

196432.description:
Haruki Bandou was born into a family of Judo marital artists and expected to continue the family legacy. But he’s about to trade Judo for... cheerleading?! When his childhood friend Kazuma Hashimoto invites him to join the BREAKERS, a male cheerleading club, Haru finds himself amongst a quirky group of boys. Can this squad of slightly odd and cute members make a breakthrough in college athletics?

(Source: Funimation)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

196433.description:
Arrogant Duke Ixor Malkuth is used to getting absolutely everything he wants... until he meets the beautiful Daon, a slave who refuses to give in to his demands. As the conquerer of Daon's territory, Ixor tries to treat her like his mistress, but when she runs away, he decides to charm her into loving him. Yet with every attempt to seduce her, Ixor finds himself slowly falling for her instead. Will the prideful duke succeed in stealing Daon's affection, or will he find his own heart conquered?

(Source: Tapas)

title.native: タランタランタラン~鳴り響く音にのせて~

196434.description:
A short manga published as a preview prior to the serialization of Dungeon Meshi.

Note: Published in Harta Vol. 10.

196435.description:
Nineteen, a boy who has endured a life worse than hell. In order to seek revenge, he eventually conspires with the evil spirit within him and is reborn as a monster.

(Source: Naver, translated)

196436.description:
In an era of rising status for animals, a cat takes to the stage. The story of Dolly, a cat who starts out as a star and becomes a diva.

(Source: Naver, translated)

196437.description: Well-known mishaps and new encounters await Hayate, Shun, Takayuki and Soma in their colorful everyday life. Moments that are deeply embarrassing to some bear unexpected insights for others.

title.native: 小説　クールドジ男子　Connect It Cool, Guys
title.romaji: Shousetsu Cool Doji Danshi: Connect It Cool, Guys

196438.description:
“Selling my virginity for money.”

Appearing before me were two beautiful men. The outcome being me working for their escort service…?! This is my chance to show off my knowledge, sex appeal, and acting ability! I'll be bringing you your ultimate dream!!

(Source: Renta!)

196439.description:
"When this person touches me, I become strange..."

Nika, who works at the body care store, "Ma chambre nature", doesn't like others touching her hands because she worries about her dry skin. But, one day, the ace of the product proposal and development department, Fumiya, took a liking to her hands! What's more, he asks Nika to help him with product development as a tester. "It can't be anyone else, but you." He says, as Nika falls for him. He affectionately touches not only her hands, but her whole body...!?

This is a story of pure love and fetishism where reason and instinct are at odds!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: The Right Way to Touch Me
title.native: わたしの正しい触り方
碧にとけるジェリーフィッシュ

196441.description:
Unable to fit in at his new school or bring himself to pick up the violin he’s studied for years, Yoshida does his best to simply muddle through life—until the day a curious new girl named Satella simply appears in the middle of music class. No one else, however, seems to notice her arrival, much less find this sudden, unexplained addition to their class roster unusual. Who is this strange new soul, and what does she want? One thing’s for sure: after making first contact, Yoshida’s world will never be the same…

(Source: Kodansha USA)

196443.description:
Taki, 23, is a NEET. Since his mother's death, he has been stuck in a rut... But when his father remarries, his daily life is turned upside down by the arrival of his new stepsister: a bodybuilding enthusiast who forces him to come out of his shell!

(Source: Akata, translated)
synonyms: Never Gonna Win Against My Stepsister

title.native: オレの妹に勝てる気がしねえ
title.romaji: Ore no Imouto ni Kateruki ga Shinee

196444.description:
I, Okamoto Eisuke, am a working adult whose hobby is to go camping in dungeons on weekends while hiding the fact that I am the strongest adventurer. While enjoying my usual camping meal, I encountered a gal, Inami Melody, who was about to be eaten by an SS-class monster and instinctively saved her. Apparently the incident went viral, and suddenly my name was in the trending column!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: ダンジョンキャンパーの俺、ギャル配信者を助けたらバズった上に毎日ギャルが飯を食いにくる
title.romaji: Dungeon Camper no Ore, Gal Haishinsha wa Tasuketara Bazutta Ue ni Mainichi Gal ga Meshi wo Kui ni Kuru

196445.description:
“Hey, editor. I have a scene in my head. Should I try it?”

I tried to keep it dry because it was just a show, but he was too hot. He blurted out that he would be able to write without any problems if he just tried it before penetration before sex and left. In contrast to his plain reaction, Dasulgi’s body got all heated up and she secretly masturbated. Then, when she raised her head because of a strange feeling, she saw him leaning against the wall and looking directly at the scene. She was caught, as an editor, masturbating while calling the writer’s name. He leaned against the wall and quietly watched her, then leisurely asked, “Should I help you?”

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of Metatoon's Dongjeongnam Danpyeonseon (동정남 단편선) Collection.

[Virgin Male Anthology] RE: Author, You're Retiring from Writing? Seriously?
[純情男短篇] RE：作家大人怎能封筆！

196447.description:
The legendary hero who, as the chosen champion of the goddess, defeated the evil dragon and saved the Sanhosu Kingdom. However, what remained for her was neither honor nor wealth, but only dire poverty. In her attempt to earn money to rebuild her ruined village, she falls for the trickery of the disguised Demon Lord and ends up bound by magic handcuffs that seal away her powers…

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

196448.description:
Yeoeul Baek, a humble C-class guide, desires nothing more than a quiet life with a stable income. But her plans are turned upside down when an extraordinary 89% match with Yi-Hyeon Han—the world's most powerful S-class esper—forces her into a full-time role she never expected. Now, Yeoeul must navigate a world where her once ordinary life is anything but…

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: ヤバい奴らに執着されるC級ガイドになった

196449.description:
At 29, Eun-Seong is told she’ll die by autumn. She skips chemo, quits her job, leaves her mother’s house, and dyes her hair for the first time in her life. Then, on a whim, she adds one last thing: a night with a stranger who prefers no-strings-attached encounters. She decides to stay with him until autumn—when her time runs out.

(Source: Manta)

196450.description:
Karina never asked to be a magical girl! In fact, not even a few hours have passed since her dear grandmother's sudden death when a boy meets her in the street and calls on her to transform. But how can a sarcastic teenager from a working-class family juggle her grief, her schoolwork, her waitressing job, and fighting death itself?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

196451.description:
Abandoned by her ex-husband Douglas, Cassia rises to become a wealthy merchant. However, when a penniless Douglas returns begging for forgiveness, she gives him one last chance — only to fall into his trap and lose everything. But just when all seems lost, Cassia is granted a second chance to change her fate.

(Source: Manta)

title.english: I Refuse the Regrets of a Traitor
title.native: 裏切り者の後悔はお断りいたします
title.romaji: Uragirimono no Koukai wa Okotowari Itashimasu

196452.description:
After 13 years of friendship, things take a turn when Tae-Won's pants get pulled down in front of Jae-Kyung. She thought she knew him better than anyone until she saw his wild, dirty side. Now that they've crossed the line, what awaits them?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes four side story chapters.

196453.description:
Kang Hoe-Yoon is the most captivating storyteller in all of Joseon. Wherever he goes, crowds gather to hear his thrilling tales. But he feels self-conscious whenever he notices the handsome Shin Eun-Ro in the audience, an aristocrat he harbors a secret crush on. However, one day, Eun-Ro approaches Hoe-Yoon with a bizarre request. Eun-Ro wants him to teach his future wife the "art of love," fearing she’s too innocent for marriage.

Will this be Hoe-Yoon's chance to get closer to his crush, or will it be a disaster that leaves him heartbroken?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: 전기수 밥 빌어먹는 구멍은 삼천 가지라_떡방아전
[เรื่องสั้นเร้าสวาท] บทรักของนักเล่าเรื่อง

title.native: 전기수 밥 빌어먹는 구멍은 삼천 가지라 떡방아전
title.romaji: Jeongisu Bam Bireomeongneun Gumeongeun Samcheon Gajira Tteokbangajeon

196454.description:
Tanaka, a sales employee, suddenly finds himself on an unfamiliar prairie. He has been transported to ancient China, during the age of two great heroes who would later overthrow the Qin Dynasty and clash with one another.

Their names: Xiang Yu and Liu Bang.

What can Tanaka do in these turbulent times!?

(Source: Manga Mirai)

title.english: Xiang Yu, Liu Bang, and Tanaka

196455.description:
When the empress discovers Ji Cheong's feelings for the emperor, he silences her with his blade, sealing his fate as a traitor. Tortured and prepared to die, he faces the emperor with a final lie-that he tried to violate the empress. But instead of execution, he wakes in an unfamiliar palace, trapped behind walls of thorns…

(Source: Lezhin US)

196456.description:
After an eventful night full of tears and a live concert, Gyeom finds himself tangled up in a hot night with aspiring musician and rising star, Yo-Han. Inspired after a mind-blowing night, Yo-Han decides to look for new band members to join him in producing a new album. But when he once again encounters the mysterious boy who stole his heart with his tears, Yo-Han refuses to let him go and suggests Gyeom join his band as a bassist. Will these two be able to create a new playlist for their lives?

(Source: Tapas)

title.native: かわいくないかわいいあの子

196458.description:
The 9th work in the Grand Cross Universe.

Special agent Transcendent Artemis is on a mission to protect humanity from threats from other Transcendent beings like herself, and as she begins to doubt her own identity and the group she belongs to, this is the story that unfolds.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

196459.description:
Eun-Ha is struggling to balance multiple jobs and drowning in debt when she runs into her ex. It's been years, but Won-Seo drops a bomb: the two never actually ended things. Eun-Ha is shaken by her words, but walks away. When eviction looms, Won-Seo offers a lifeline laced with history. Torn by pride and buried feelings, Eun-Ha takes the bait.

(Source: Manta)

196460.description:
Hye-Jin has always dreamed of being a journalist, but the school newspaper is about to be shut down, and she must find a way to stop it! Her only chance comes in the form of a not-so-friendly but handsome rugby team captain. Will Hye-Jin be able to get an interview with him and save the paper?

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: ロマンチック・ピッチ −Romantic Pitch −

title.native: リトル・バイ・リトル

196462.description:
The setting is Shimokitazawa. Chihoko, who came to Tokyo with her super-selfish cousin Mayo, is trying to attend a vocational school, but gets scammed. Chihoko, who is at a loss as to what to do in her first life in Tokyo, is saved by a mysterious beauty named Michi. Now, Shimokita magic happens!!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.romaji: Boku no Heya e Oide yo

title.native: 追放された最強令嬢は、新たな人生を自由に生きる
title.romaji: Tsuihou Sareta Saikyou Reijou wa, Arata na Jinsei wo Jiyuu ni Ikiru

196465.description:
After centuries of incessant warfare, the world of Tenshou is on the verge of finding peace thanks to the marriage of the heirs of two ruling clans... But not everyone is happy about this prospect, and the newlyweds will have to face many dangers before their people can finally enjoy happy days...

(Source: Black Box, translated)

196466.description:
A pinch of spice can add flavor to life! An omelet vendor who was once a gang member, a retired businessman who has had a lifelong crush on the noodle vendor, an old man who insisted on keeping his grocery store, a grandson with a bright future... Over time, dishes become conveyors of stories and memories. Grocery stores, nostalgia for human contact and the old days... through seven stories, the sweetness and bitterness of life bring us back to the hidden joys in our hearts.

(Source: ASIAN DISTRICT, translated)

196468.description:
Purgatory. Purgatory is a legendary place halfway between heaven and hell, where all sinful souls end up wandering. People doubted its existence until that fateful day fifteen years ago... Judgment Day. That is what it is called. Countless cracks opening the gates of purgatory appeared simultaneously in all four corners of the Earth. Humanity was attacked from all sides by damned souls. All those possessed by them were transformed into monsters called “abominations,” whose sole purpose is to devour the souls of all human beings...

(Source: Reborn, translated)

196469.description:
Rintaro is a very successful man. At just the age of 30, he’s the owner of his very own cafe! And while he appreciates all of his customers, there’s one regular that he’s begun to develop feelings for.

Luna, a 25-year-old office worker, is a cafe regular who’s afraid of men after a traumatic experience, but finds that she can be around Rintaro without any issue. Encouraged by this, she asks if Rintaro would help her get used to being around men. Eager to do anything for Luna, Rintaro agrees but quickly finds himself overwhelmed by just simple handholding! And when Luna begins to make even more ambitious moves, Rintaro isn’t sure his heart can handle the growing feelings he’s keeping to himself.

Can Rintaro maintain his facade to help the oblivious Luna, or will this sweet story end up with bitter feelings?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Originally self-published on Pixiv, was then compiled by Gentosha for commercial release.

title.english: The Oblivious Girl and the Maidenly Man
title.native: 無自覚ちゃんとオトメな男

196470.description:
“You spirits can see us regular people, but most of us have no idea you are even there. It'd be pretty mean if even the few people who could talk to you ignored you anyway— You'd get lonely, right?” So begins the story of a boy in search of a friend and a clumsy poltergeist in need of a little human kindness… The best of friendships come from the most unexpected places!

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Originally self-published on Twitter, was then licensed by Kadokawa for commercial release.

title.native: 追放された最強令嬢は、新たな人生を自由に生きる
title.romaji: Tsuihou Sareta Saikyou Reijou wa, Arata na Jinsei wo Jiyuu ni Ikiru

196472.description: Ten years ago, "Judgment Day" could have been avoided. However, two Terminators are sent to John Connor from the future again. What is the true identity of Skynet? The fate of the future is once again entrusted to John Connor!!

196473.description:
A dick girl, Sakura, wishes to remain friends with the kind, cute, and a little erotic Aoi.
However, Sakura has trouble resisting her sexual urges...
One day, there relationship changes drastically when Aoi catches Sakura masturbating...
synonyms: A Futa Friend In Sexual Need Is A Fuckbuddy Friend Indeed

title.native: ふたなりが友達に性処理してもらう話
title.romaji: Futanari ga Tomodachi ni Seishori Shite Morau Hanashi

196474.description:
Takahara Hairi never expected summer to feel like a dream. Sent to Torishirojima Island to sort through his late grandmother’s belongings, he’s met with endless sea, quiet nostalgia, and mysterious girls, each chasing something just out of reach. As he settles into island life, lost memories begin to surface and he finds what he never knew he’d lost.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title.native: Summer Pockets―なつのたからもの―

196475.description:
Futaba is a girl who suddenly grew a penis out of no where!
She has three of her friends take her to the infirmary, but...
there are no teachers on site, and the girls end up "assisting" Futaba with her cock dilemma.
Futaba's three friends will wring her dry in his dick chick harem themed erotic manga!

196476.description:
A group of three were drinking at the protagonist's home.
He takes his eyes off the other two for but a moment, and the two lesbian girls start making out!
"You might as well join us. How about it?"
Tempted and teased, the protagonist ends up sandwiched between their supple bodies...
Opening the debaucherous doors to forbidden threesome sex with a yuri lezzy couple!?
In the face of their unlimited lust, the protagonist is wrung dry...

196477.description:
Iijima ended up being chosen as a library committee member while he was fast asleep in class.
He works alongside Nemoto, a quiet and gloomy girl of few words, but for some reason things end up heading into a sexy direction...
Thus begin their erotic days in a quiet and secluded library!
How far will their relationship go...? And how far will THEY go!!

(Source: dlsite, translated)
synonyms: With You, Who Is Hard To Read

196478.description:
A shut-in girl was drugged by her sister, turning her into a futanari.
Unable to bear the unfamiliar excitement, she masturbates to try to calm down, but it only increases her desire, until...
The shut-in girl's mind is overcome with lust...!
synonyms: When My Shut-In Sister Grew a Dick

title.native: 引きこもりの姉にちんちんが生えたら
title.romaji: Hikikomori no Ane ni Chinchin ga Haetara

196479.description:
MFG is a street race held in Japan that has gained popularity all over the world. The year after Kanata Rivington, a student of Takumi Fujiwara, dominated MFG, Subaru Satou from Gunma and Subaru Kudou from Kanagawa were fired up to take on the race...

The worlds of "Initial D" and "MF Ghost" come together! The curtain rises on the legend of the fastest true street race, spun by these two "Subarus"!

(Source: Young Magazine, translated)

196480.description:
Noel, an adventurer with the “Tamer” job, is often abused and mistreated by his party due to his lacking combat ability. This culminates in him being left behind in the depths of a deadly dungeon. However, in his darkest hour, he finds opportunity in the form of the Flame Dragon Fran. Noel’s job as a Tamer enables him to unseal Fran and become her new master. Bit by bit, his taming skill grants him more and more of her unparalleled power. Between his newfound strength and the new companions they seek out, it won’t be long before his old party is left in the dust.

(Source: Manga UP!)

title.english: The Abandoned Tamer Signs a Deal With a Devilishly Beautiful Dragon
title.native: 見捨てられた最弱テイマー、封印されていた美少女ドラゴンと契約して最強に至る
title.romaji: Misuterareta Saijaku Tamer, Fuuin Sareteita Bishoujo Dragon to Keiyaku Shite Saikyou ni Itaru

title.native: 送り屋ヴァナルガンド
転生薬師は迷宮都市育ち
title.romaji: Tensei Kusushi wa Meikyuu Toshi Sodachi

title.native: 転生薬師は迷宮都市育ち
title.romaji: Tensei Kusushi wa Meikyuu Toshi Sodachi

title.native: きみと一緒に通いたい

196487.description:
A collection of short stories by Gengoroh Tagame.

1. Juujutsu Kyoushi Remix (柔術教師 リミックス版)
2-7. Kishimu Otoko (軋む男)
8-9. Ore no Sensei (俺の先生)
10. The Dokata
11. Purgatorio (プルガトリオ)
12-13. Hitotsuya Ibun (一つ家異聞)
synonyms: 柔術教師 リミックス版

196488.description:
Notes:
- Originally released at J.GARDEN 53 to 55, was then licensed by Kaiohsha for serialization.
- Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Meet up at somewhere in Scorpio.

title.native: 待ち合わせはさそり座のどこかで
title.romaji: Machiawase wa Sasoriza no Doko ka de

title.native: いや、付き合ってないです

196490.description:
The family of Ddolboki, who started foster care by chance and is now in their 15th year, welcomes a new baby, Bbangsil. She is really cute and lovable, but she is no ordinary girl. Growing faster than her peers, she crawls as soon as she rolls over, walks as soon as she crawls, runs as soon as she walks, and causes accidents wherever she goes! Will the family of Ddolboki be able to raise Bbangsil healthily and happily and say goodbye well?

The story of the daily life, parenting, adoption, and foster care of the family of Ddolboki and Bbangsil.

(Source: Naver, translated)

196492.description:
It's already been three years since Philly and Windsor first met through an app. But as their relationship deepens, they feel like they don't know much about each other. Will their relationship, which is gradually tearing apart, ever be able to completely mend?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

196493.description:
“Freedom at last!”

After fifteen long years of secluded training, he finally descends the mountain, determined to reclaim the youth he feels he wasted. He vows to complete the ten great deeds promised to his master as swiftly as possible, then live the rest of his life in blissful leisure. Brimming with confidence, he takes his first steps into the world—only to find that nothing goes as planned. In a realm where betrayal and tears far outweigh righteousness and laughter, his journey toward becoming the world’s greatest warrior begins. Join him now on his path through this perilous martial world!
synonyms: The World’s Best Sect of Dependency

title.native: 魔法少女山田 〜ある漫画編集者の記録～
title.romaji: Mahou Shoujo Yamada: Aru Manga Henshuusha no Kiroku

196495.description:
Kokoro is a hard-working office lady who seems intimidating to her younger colleagues. She lives alone in the apartment she bought for herself. One day, after getting a little too drunk at a bar, Kokoro impulsively asks Kei — the young, cocky, and handsome bartender, “Why don’t you come live with me?”!! Kei actually moves in, and their free-spirited cohabitation leads to one mishap after another! “There’s no way I could ever fall for a playboy like this” — or so she thought!?

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

196496.description:
As if reincarnating into a whole new world wasn't enough, Lewin was reborn to a father so bent on having a male heir that he used dark magic to disguise her as a boy. Over 20 years later, she finds an unexpected ally in a freshly-transmigrated fellow Korean girl. However, this new friend delivers shocking news: they're in a tragic BL novel in which a love triangle will ultimately lead to the apocalypse! Still, if Lewin can seduce the male lead first, they may just manage to save the world...

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Maniacs Are Obsessed With the Fake
A Verdadeira Obcecada Não Sou Eu

196497.description:
For four years, Karen Prime von Mondreal thought of Erich as nothing but her brilliant disciple. However, all that changed when he turned 19 and suddenly confessed his love! He's persistent, and Karen is starting to waver... The only problem is that she'd been priming Erich to become the next monarch, and she has to leave the kingdom so he can build a solid political standing. Can Karen push Erich away when he's determined to stay by her side? More importantly, does she want to?

(Source: Tapas)

196498.description:
He may be from the boonies, but he's strong, he's kind, and he won't stop until you're satisfied. His name... is Kangsae the Strong.

(Source: Toomics)

196499.description:
One day, dinosaurs suddenly appeared in Shiraya Town. Although the cause is unknown, the people chose to live with the small dinosaurs. The baby-like, cute dinosaurs are adorable! We bring you "Dinosaurs Have Started," which is very popular on social media.

(Source: Lettuce Club, translated)
synonyms: The Story of People Starting a Life with Dinosaurs

196500.description:
Watt Sears has traded his glory days as a Mechsteel knight for a humble life as train station employee with a knack for showing new pilots the ropes. Problem is, the city's baron—his boss—would love nothing more than to see Watt reclaim his old mantle as a Steelrider who hunts monsters and defends the city.

Now nearing forty, the once-legendary pilot would much rather support the new generation than stand in the spotlight himself.

Peace and quiet were the last things waiting for Watt, however, as his storied past literally comes to find him. When Anna, his long-lost daughter from a bygone romance, appears before him to ask for his help in a brewing royal power struggle, Watt vows to protect her. But as assailants descend on the city from all sides, keeping his promise proves to be no simple task. With turmoil rattling the kingdom, can this old knight survive his new post and keep his daughter safe?

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: The retired man lives a peaceful life, becoming the sword of her majesty the queen.

title.english: Old Knight, New Post: From Retiree to Her Majesty's Blade
title.native: 隠居暮らしのおっさん、女王陛下の剣となる
title.romaji: Inkyo-gurashi no Ossan, Joou Heika no Tsurugi to Naru

196501.description:
Haunted by past events, Tatsumi suffers from deep-seated trauma surrounding his beloved dolls. When his shining role model Tsukimi-senpai invites him to work part-time at a doll shop, he finally gets the chance to face his fears. But before he can even settle in, a mysterious curse suddenly turns Tsukimi-senpai into an actual doll!

The only way to return her back to normal is for him to “cherish her”…?! Can a guy who buries his love for dolls give his pure-hearted crush the care she needs to become human again?

(Source: Manga UP!)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.native: 古都古書祓いの陰陽師

196503.description:
Mitsu Hikawa, a second-year high school student, and her best friend Rui Majima secretly love BL, and Mitsu spends her days fantasizing about the boys in her class. One day, one of the people she is observing, Shou Kagomiya, asks Mitsu, "Hikawa, you like Rui Majima don't you?" and Mitsu is shocked――!?

A chaotic love triangle (?) between a fujoshi gyaru and a handsome himedanshi!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 欲求不満の社長夫人は温泉旅館で牝々しく交尾狂う
title.romaji: Yokkyu Fuman no Shachou Fujin wa Onsen Ryokan de Mesu Mesushiku Koubi Kuruu

synonyms: A Dragon Living in His Library Never Blows the Fire

title.native: 図書館ドラゴンは火を吹かない
title.romaji: Toshokan Dragon wa Hi wo Fukanai

196507.description:
Junka, trying to distance herself from her clingy childhood friend, decides to take on her first summertime job! Since it was a sudden decision, she has trouble finding job openings. However, when she takes a break at a cafe, she decides to ask if they need any part-timers, and she receives a surprising response...!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)
synonyms: If You Fall in Love in Our Cafe

title.native: 恋をするなら僕らのカフェで
title.romaji: Koi wo Surunara Bokura no Cafe de

196509.description:
There will be happy and joyful days, but there will also be sad, regretful, and disappointing days. Still, if you don’t give up and put in a little effort, sometimes you’ll be able to meet a ‘today, day’ that you really like.”

Every night, a secret operation by Heart and Gummies for their beloved day begins! A cheeky and warm nighttime problem-solving growth project by the bedside attachment doll ‘Heart’ and colorful Gummi friends! A super cute and super deep, heart-healing adventure that unfolds every night. We invite you to the secret counseling.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

196510.description:
Sick and tired of her mother's ruinous debts, Richelle accepts a post as tutor to the illustrious Otis family. But upon finding a letter with strict, eerie rules on how to survive within the manor of roses, Richelle senses that something sinister is lurking. Now, she must pay the price for her choice.

(Source: Manta)

196511.description:
One day, an uninvited guest suddenly appears! She is none other than the Demon Lord Karin! Jeong-Ha's daily life begins to fall apart due to the tyranny of this nuisance. Why did Karin come to see Jeong-Ha? Will Jeong-Ha's daily life ever be peaceful again?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
synonyms: The Demon King's Conquest of the World was Doomed from the Start

196512.description:
Yoon-Jung, who shouldn't fall in love, falls in love with Cupid?!

Yoon-jung, who has been able to see Cupid since she was young, begins to think that 'love is a false emotion created by Cupid after her mother gets shot by Cupid's arrow and divorces due to an affair. Soon after, her father leaves home, and she dreams of a happy future with her older sister, but her older sister starts avoiding Yoon-Jung after her relationship is discovered. The person suspected of being her sister's lover is Han-Gyeol, the most popular boy in school. While watching the two, Yoon-Jung witnesses Han-Gyeol and her teacher kissing, but is suddenly chased by Cupid. Fearing that her past wounds will repeat themselves, Yoon-Jung uses the bag she was carrying to blast Cupid away, but when she comes to, the arrow is already in her chest, and she realizes belatedly that she was looking at Cupid when she was hit by the arrow. Will Yoon-Jung fall in love with Cupid...?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

196513.description:
In a world where dying is no longer a tragedy, but a privilege, the rich design their own extravagant funerals resembling weddings. Ceremonies are held not for the deceased, but for those left behind. Han Hee-Jun has lived selfishly his whole life and realizes no one will remember him if he dies. Desperate to leave behind a perfect image, he takes on death planning. But when Kang Ido, a wealthy client with the same deep emptiness, requests a quiet, meaningful death, Hee-Jun's carefully planned world shifts.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes a prologue.

synonyms: Heine in Japan: ein "Dichter der Liebe und Revolution"

title.native: ハイネ 愛と革命の詩人
title.romaji: Haine: Ai to Kakumei no Shijin

196515.description:
A collection of short stories by Gengoroh Tagame.

1. Wappa Jigoku, Oyako Jigoku (童地獄・父子地獄)
2. Der fliegende Holländer
3. Aikoku Giyuugun (哀酷義勇軍)
4. Kokuhaku (告白)

196516.description: Note: Includes the one-shot Ryuuji Eien (隆司永遠)

196517.description:
The high school girl Ayame's love of gothic lolita style is found out by Mizuno Hiro, a boy known as the school's biggest delinquent. Ayame fears that her hobby will become exposed at school, or suffer some other terrible consequence, but for some reason, Hiro invites her on a date instead. As they spend time together, Ayame begins to feel that he is not as bad as he is rumored to be.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: ゴスロリちゃんと問題児くん

196518.description:
In a world where only Guides can stabilize Espers, Wonwoo, a soldier and Purifier, is swept into a parallel world through a mysterious fog, where he faces his dying self and gets a second chance at life. As he starts anew, he encounters the ruler of the North, Yoon, who seems strangely familiar...

(Source: Manta)

196519.description:
Yi-Eon, the eldest son of the Lee family, who was exterminated for treason, runs away with his nephew Yeon-O, the only heir to the family. While traveling to a distant land, they stay at a mountain lodge to warm their cold bodies. However, their relief is short-lived, as the lodge owner, who has discovered their true identities, offers to make a deal and not report them, but hands them a piece of paper...

Yi-Eon is shocked when he sees the five rules, or "five rules," written on the paper.

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

Note: Part of Peanutoon's Geosi, Girong Danpyeonseon (거시,기록 단편선) Collection.

196520.description:
Nina Lindra is a gifted student and skilled magic user, but she has a secret that no one can find out. She often disguises herself as her adoptive sister, Lilia Lust, even taking her exams in her place, at the request of the Lust family. When the kingdom’s queen requests Lilia to heal her ailing son, Nina once again steps into her role, using her powers to ease Prince Erland’s pain. As Nina tends to him, she discovers the warmth hidden beneath Erland’s icy facade. But as feelings grow and a charming foreign prince enters her life, Nina must face the hardest choice. Will she continue living a lie, or risk everything to be herself?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: The Substitute Adopted Daughter is Finally Free!

title.english: The Stand-in Daughter Wants to Be Free
title.native: 替え玉養女は自由になります！
title.romaji: Kaedama Youjo wa Jiyuu ni Narimasu!

196521.description:
Minseok loses his daughter again and again in a world overrun by zombies. He’s been mysteriously given 100 lives to save her and has watched her die in 99 of them. On his final one, he dies before they even make it out the front door–except this time, he wakes as a zombie. But a zombie papa still has a father’s heart. Now stronger than ever, he’s ready to take on the world to protect his baby girl.

(Source: WEBTOON)

synonyms: I Became a Slave to the Man I Abandoned

196524.description:
Cheon Soo-Ji, a fresh graduate of society, living a hard life day after day, exhausted from working overtime and hiking on weekends. Her older brother’s friend Seo Jae-Hyun appears in front of her for the first time in a long time. The handsome and affectionate Seo Jae-Hyun, who has loved Soo-Ji, who is 10 years younger than her, since she was young.

Is it because she is drunk? Soo-Ji impulsively kisses Jae-Hyun while he is sleeping and gets caught. However, Jae-Hyun, who seemed to despise Soo-Ji and accuse her of being a sexual harasser, says something unexpected!

“Who kisses without opening their mouths?”
“Then how do you do it…?”
“Open your mouth.”

In that moment, Soo-Ji is swept up in desire, and words she could never have imagined pour out of him. Her first love of 25 years turned out to be a pervert! However, rather than disliking him, Soo-Ji begins to open her eyes to her own tastes that she had never known about. She thinks she should push Jae-Hyun away, but she starts to get more and more drawn into him because of his persistence…

After nine thousand years in the demon realm, Horang Baek returns to Earth as the Demon Lord and reunites with her only surviving family member. Time amongst demons taught her to act swiftly without mercy, but looking monstrous to her brother scares her more than death. As Horang reacquaints herself with earthly customs, she finds one thing hasn’t changed–random guys throwing themselves at her. And if she thinks any left behind in the demon realm are history, she’s in for a surprise.

One fateful day, unknown blacksmith Lutz accidentally forges a truly exceptional katana: his life’s magnum opus.

However, a certain incident forces him to give up the blade. To make matters worse, he forgot to stamp his maker's mark on it, making it impossible to prove that he crafted it.

Meanwhile, the katana falls into the hands of Gerhardt, the local lord's personal spellforger. The moment he picks it up, he is enchanted by its beauty...

In this sword-making tale, an obscure blacksmith and a nameless katana move the hearts and fates of people!

The year is 2039. The world has been taken over by AI and rewritten into an environment like an RPG game. While people have become players of this "real fantasy," Ji-san, a middle-aged man who was resurrected by the influence of AI control, spends his days diving deep into dungeons in despair. One day, Ji-san obtains a weapon called the Taming Sword, which allows him to capture monsters... After a lonely death from overworking, Selia Welfe finds herself reincarnated into another world... but not into a romance fantasy novel like she had hoped. Instead, she is the chief of a detective agency that specializes in tracking down runaway female leads! Immediately, she gets right to work, hunting for clues and risking her life to reunite couples and solve relationship issues. But when Selia rescues the life of a mysterious male lead, can she keep from getting too entangled in his story?

Kneeling before the isolated princess, he pledges his unyielding loyalty...

However, with the belief that "it's out of the question to be recognized by my favorite!", she just enjoys the videos. Shirota lives in a village that is stuck in an eternal winter. One day, he meets an injured beastman, Haiji, and the three children he has along with him. According to the laws of the village, Shirota isn't supposed to approach any beastmen or go anywhere near them, but he can't bring himself to abandon someone who's hurt. So, he invites them to stay with him until Haiji's injuries are healed.
The three beast-children are very cute, while Haiji seems like a kind gentleman. The time the four of them spend together brings them comfort, with delicious food, a cozy home, and more.
Although Haiji is planning to leave one day and go far away, Shirota feels more and more like he wants to do anything to stop him...

The supposed oasis is, in fact, Minato Tsukamoto, a college student who exudes perverted human pheromones! Theo begs him to hook up so that he can survive. Minato is hesitant at first, but gradually gives in to his curiosity...!

An exciting romcom about a clumsy newbie incubus and a kind-hearted college student!

Kwon Si-Hyun. I met him on a bitterly cold and chilly winter day.

A man suddenly appeared in front of Seo-Kyung, who had no family, teacher, or piano to lean on. He was indifferent and cold about everything, but he rarely smiled and was affectionate. Wouldn't this person be able to help me escape this terrible place someday?

That's why Seo-Kyung didn't want to miss this opportunity. Even if it meant deceiving you and me.

But is this really a dream? Why does it keep feeling real?

Irae wakes up in the hospital, married but with no memory of the wedding or her husband. To everyone else, he’s the perfect man, but to her, he’s a tentacled cosmic horror! Bewildered by the gap between memory and reality, she wonders... Is this really just an aftereffect of her accident?

196546.description:
Helltham is a crime-ridden city ruled by the Golden Bite Family, whose boss dies in a mysterious accident. When Seven, the family's degenerate third-in-command, is named as a promising candidate for the next boss, he plans to use his power to live it up even more. However, he gets stabbed in the back by his long-time partner, Felix, who turns out to be a spy working with the city's only law enforcement agency. Shannon, a girl who has been raised in secret in a villa, is to marry into the Altimia Empire as a symbol of peace after the end of the Cold War. Not knowing the face or name of her fiancé, she is anxiously heading to the other country when Shannon and her companions are attacked by a powerful magical beast. She prepares herself for death, but when she wakes up, she finds herself being protected by the now extinct divine beast, Lycaon... After nearly dying once, Shannon decides to live positively.

Princess Roxiana of Cantar seems destined for a life of happiness as she departs to wed her childhood fiancé, Prince Lucas. Branded a slave and stripped of her royal title, all hope appears lost…Until she is rescued by Grand Duke Floyd Lathean of Torcan. 196614.description:
When Sahui’s quiet life at Yeonghwadang, a secluded shaman house where she spent her whole life, is disrupted by imposing CEO Tae-eon Jeong, she wants nothing more than to keep her distance. Scarred by abandonment and a childhood accident, she has no interest in love. Yet Tae-eon’s arrogance, charm, and relentless attention begin to break through her defenses, stirring emotions she thought she had buried for good.

196616.description:
"Dan Mitsu " is a non-fiction work that depicts the daily life of Seino and Dan Mitsu, the celebrity he married in 2019. It tells the "truth" about the two, including how Seino and Dan Mitsu started dating, the episodes leading up to their marriage, and their married life afterwards, and explains why a famous celebrity known to everyone and a subculture manga artist known only to a few are a "couple."

(Source: Natalie, translated)

196617.description:
According to the morning's fortune, Park Mu-Woon was destined for a fated encounter. Instead, the universe delivers Na Yeon-Taek, the childhood tormentor he spent nine years trying to forget. What was supposed to be a "lucky" day quickly turns into a nightmare as the architect of Mu-Woon's past misery resurfaces. Now, forced back into each other's lives, Mu-Woon must confront a complicated history and the lingering shadows of a man he never wanted to see again.

(Source: Lezhin US)

In a small town called Leo. Ruben, the wizard who isn’t just known for his title as the ‘Rising Star’ or for his powerful potions. He’s also beloved by the ladies in town for his gentle nature, charming looks, and single status. But one day, a rare creature suddenly rolls into his life. Ruben, thrilled by the thought of wealth and fame, even gives it a cute nickname: Squishy. But the next morning…

What he finds in his bed isn't squishy, but a beauty?!

"From now on, I’m calling you Squishy. If you don’t like it, remember your real name."

Takase Tsubaki, a 29-year-old saleswoman based in Sapporo. She's cautious when it comes to love and still holds onto her virginity. Tsubaki finds herself developing feelings for her co-worker, Azuma Ryuhei. While Azuma has a reputation as a playboy, they manage to maintain their friendship. In a moment of impatience, Tsubaki unintentionally invites Azuma to a hotel, hoping for a deeper connection. However, things don't go as expected, and Azuma doesn't embrace her as she had hoped.

(Source: Mangamo)

196624.description:
For years, Saint Evelyn has protected her country with her powerful healing magic, earning her the love of the people. But then, the first prince breaks off their engagement and strips her of her title, only to name her incompetent half sister as the new saint. Cast out from the only life she's ever known, Evelyn is forced to find her place in a world that suddenly feels all too vast.

Fate smiles upon her when she stumbles upon a young boy from the streets who shows her a new path: making a living with her healing magic. The next thing she knows, she's earned her first commission—and a handsome count is proposing to her?!

With discontent growing in the royal family over the prince's folly and adoring fans flocking to her side, Evelyn must navigate political intrigue, newly realized fame, and unexpected romance in the air. Now if only she would realize just how much everyone adores her!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

"I've waited so long for this day..."

Leila Ferry was born to a noble family, but lived her life without any healing abilities that other nobles normally have. One day, a man Allen Stanley came to her house wearing a mask concealing a terrible curse. The two begin to talk to one another and grow friendly. As feelings develop, Leila begins to think, "If I had healing abilities I could help you...!" Suddenly, in the heat of a moment, a bright light shines forth...!

After my father passed away and I was sorting through his belongings, I was transported to another world along with my beloved dog and the house!? What's more, I just couldn't remember, but it seemed like I was born "this way"...? I cultivated the fields, cooked food, and developed the area around my house. 196627.description:
A message board for all things anal! welcome to the Proctology Anonymous Board. Here, some things are just too painful to share without anonymity.

Case 1: Hands-on Game (마사지 男)

I applied for a sports massage position, thinking it was a normal job. But when I showed up, they gave me a scrap of fabric that couldn’t even pass for a uniform… and told me to massage between someone’s legs. Can a famous soccer player really get away with this kind of behavior? And what’s up with the three-person session when I was told it’d be one-on-one? Isn’t that false advertising?

Case 2: Bros Before Holes (구멍의 의리)

My best friend is perfect, handsome, smart, the whole package. Can you believe someone like that even wants to be friends with me? He’s always looking out for me, teaching me things, and guiding me like a true friend. And of course, like all best friends do, he opened me up on the night of my sexual awakening. I’ll never forget how special it was. What? You’re saying best friends don’t do that sort of thing?

Case 3: Booty Call of Duty (국가의 부름을 받고)

Everyone’s always whining about how hard it is... but honestly, getting fucked from behind is the best. As soon as I got some seniority in the army, I started hooking up with my juniors. It took some effort, sure, but I made it work. There was one guy in particular who tasted amazing. I told him a snake bit me on the dick... and that the venom had to be sucked out with his mouth.

Case 4: Justice Is Blindfolded (정의의 여신은 눈을 가리고 있다)

Has anyone here ever done it with a future in-law at the first family meeting? It wasn’t my intention at all, but somehow we ended up hooking up in the bathroom. And now, I can’t stop thinking about his face. I ended up showing up at his place with a bouquet. Seeing him again made everything worse... in the best way. But he didn’t even remember me. I totally lost it and made a fool of myself... and then I crossed a line. This time, I was ready to confess my feelings and imagine a future together. But can you believe it? Turns out there’s another version of him.

(Source: Lezhin, edited)

Because of his fierce appearance, Kang Woo-Hyun has never had a girlfriend, let alone a proper friend. He confesses his crush to his club senior Chae Ji-Oh while drunk. Was it the aftereffects of the confession? After dreaming of a sweet night with senior Ji-Oh, he wakes up feeling good to find "Choi Ji-Ho" next to him instead of senior Ji-Oh?! Woo-Hyun thinks this is a dream, but Ji-Ho's one word shatters Woo-Hyun's hopes.

"You're the one who forced me to bed and touched me, right?"

Will Woo-Hyun be able to safely break up with his club senior Ji-Ho, who has a foul personality? A campus romance between a prickly handsome guy and a goldfish-like potato embroidery!

In this life, she has avoided loneliness and has successfully lived a smooth life surrounded by her family and fiancé. However, her younger sister Aria stole her fiancé and kicked her out of the house, returning her to a life of solitude. In order to attend Aria's engagement party and fight back, Leafe asks Oliver, the crown prince of a neighboring country, to be her partner. She thought this would be a one-off, but for some reason Oliver has asked her to marry him!?

They hit it off from the moment they meet, and for some reason, Kaoru asks her out with the intention of getting married. From Sena Ajisai's student council dreams to Satsuki's fangirling, see what else the crew is up to in this brand-new spinoff! While Amaori Renako panics over maintaining her image as a cool, popular girl who absolutely did not only recently stop shutting herself up in her room, the world keeps on turning. Sena Ajisai runs for the student council, Hitoe Hanatori joins the girls at the pool, and Satsuki writes a fan letter to her favorite author.
