Horus was a man who single-handedly kept the Kingdom of Diamante’s operations running through his absurd ability to remotely control countless mechanical dolls known as Golems. However, thanks to an ignorant noble, he ended up being dismissed from his position.

After reuniting with his beautiful disciples, Horus was both mentally and physically exhausted, and he had absolutely zero desire to work anymore. All he wanted was to set off on a carefree journey and devote himself to perfecting his beloved all-purpose technology, the Golem System.

Or at least, that was the plan…

“A dragon attacking a village gets knocked out in one hit!?”

“You put ingredients inside, and a meal is ready in an instant…?”

As Horus casually deals with troublesome incidents one after another, he somehow ends up fixing problems wherever he goes. And once rumors of his deeds begin to spread, the nobles of the kingdom start chasing after him, desperate to bring him back.

*“What a pain… Should we just do it? One punch.”

A public example, an iron fist, and a clean sweep!?

He immediately gets the classic, strongest job as a hero, and starts "a new game" in the world of Dan-katsu.

Soon, over a hundred million viewers from all over the country are watching live as this so-called “modern-day swordmaster” takes down the Tyrant Dragon with a single strike! Overnight, Tanaka becomes a viral sensation. Seizing the chance, he ditches his soul-crushing job to begin a new career: an overpowered ex–office drone turned solo dungeon streamer!

196659.description:
Chi Hsiaochen, a cheerful sophomore majoring in traditional opera, accidentally picked up a ghost marriage red envelope at his sister's wedding. Following the elders' decision, he ended up in a ghost marriage with the Bai family. On their wedding night, he discovered that the “bride” he married was Bai Shaoyun, a somewhat difficult-to-get-along-with young master from ancient times.

Shaoyun insisted that the ghost marriage was a mistake, and that the Bai family had married off the wrong person. To achieve a painless divorce, the two had no choice but to take on a short-term job for the underworld, enticed by an Impermanence. Their task: to resolve the ghost-catching mission at the opera school, where an overwhelming flood of worries had transformed into inner demons. As they delved into the students' deeply buried troubles, they gradually opened their hearts to each other, developing mutual attraction.

(Source: Taiwan Comic City)

He's immediately written off as useless by everyone—even his childhood friend—but even a worthless job like Butcher comes with perks: extra damage to pigs, half damage from pigs. But Craig also has a secret—he can only see living things as pigs. Thus begins the ascent of a worthless Butcher...

Itsuki Ichigohara is a married high-school teacher in her late 20's, who finds herself involved with a high school girl, her student, who is 10 years younger. The student's name is Rin Togawa. She is taller than Itsuki, with a beautiful face, mild-mannered but a little childish. She is a good girl, but she has had problems in her family life, and as Itsuki tried to counsel her, they somehow ended up kissing each other in bed. This is definitely an adulterous betrayal, not to mention a crime. How could she have got herself into so much trouble that could only lead to her own destruction?

— How could I have let this happen?

It is a lewd and immoral, but somehow warm relationship. A love story between a female teacher and her female student.

However, nothing to it but to do it! So as the villainess of her own story, she’s just gotta get through these crazy days of becoming a Super Sub, secretly rendezvousing with a bookworm, infiltrating the Yuri Academy...and who knows what else?!

Kaori, a freshman photography student at an all-women's art college, always hoped she would finally find friends once she started classes but instead she's only found isolation and loneliness. But when she comes across Asuka, a striking woman with a centipede tattoo, she's struck with love at first sight! Can a shy outsider like Kaori find a place beside the dynamic Asuka? Kodai and Shun's class decide to open a cross-dressing cafe for the school festival. Kodai, however, can't help but sigh after doing his makeup at home and looking at himself in the mirror. He enjoys cross-dressing, but worries that he doesn't look good. He's the opposite of excited for the festival and is willing to do whatever it takes to avoid his classmates finding out about his secret hobby. A visit from Shun, though, could put his plans in jeopardy...!?

One day, Hayato ends up injuring the quiet kid in class, Yoh Miyamoto, during a basketball game in gym. Unsure of how to make it up to him, Hayato invites Yoh over for dinner. Even though Hayato only spoke to to Yoh a handful of times up until that point, he discovers lots of new things about Yoh, including his own feelings for him...!!When Hayato Kurata injures a classmate of his, Yoh Miyamoto, he invites Yoh over for dinner to apologize. During dinner, Hayato discovers many things he didn't know about Yoh, including his own feelings for him...

196678.description:
Kodai Hijima has spent his childhood being run ragged at his family's Chinese restaurant, and boldly declares to his best friend Azuma Hitachi that after graduating, he'll never work again. Instead, he just wants to live the easy life on someone else's dime. However, he has a sneaking suspicion that he'll be unable to provide the emotional support a woman needs. After flipping through a BL comic he found on the ground, he comes to an epiphany: he decides he'll become a "bottom main character," reel in a well-off guy, and live a life of luxury. He enrolls in an all-boys' boarding school rumored to have three wealthy guys attending, but despite putting on the charm, he doesn't exactly win their favor. Azuma's a smart guy, so Kodai enlists his help to learn flirting techniques that will have these rich guys eating out of the palm of his hand! Will this lazy bum actually get to live the bottom M.C. life of his dreams...?

(Source: Renta!)

196681.description:
Behind the scenes of human society, there exists a completely meritocratic incubus society. In this world, incubuses maintain their livelihoods by absorbing and converting energy from humans' boundless greed through intercourse with them!

Nico is a no-good incubus who barely managed to join the elite dispatch team alongside his childhood friend, Innis, who is smart, good-looking, accomplished, and an all-around perfect guy. Despite Nico's resolve to catch up to his childhood friend, his performance proves to be less than satisfactory, and he is instructed to change his target from women to men...! Meanwhile, Innis saves Nico from his fate by proposing a video streaming system that will allow them to absorb human energy indirectly...

Is this for real? Or, is Innis just doing this for the video?
The incubus duo's channel is about to take the world by storm!!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

196682.description:
Ritsu Kido, your average office worker, is the grandson of an exorcist who once made contracts with demons to expel evil spirits. After a night of drinking, Ritsu awakens to a used condom in his bed and is puzzled. He looks around the room and sees a man with horns and wings covering himself with a blanket, glaring at him... Holding his head in his hands with a splitting hangover, Ritsu recalls the events of the night before. It turns out, the man in his room is actually a demon he summoned named Ryan, and the two of them have entered into a contract by sleeping together. Moreover, this contract can't be broken so easily!

This is a romcom between an average office worker and a prideful tsundere demon!

196691.description:
Kaname has never had a lover, let alone someone he liked. He spends his college days alone, scaring away any potential friends with his distant nature and piercing gaze. Immersing himself in school and work, he has no time for love. Prompted by his boss and the customers from the gay bar he works at, Kaname starts to wonder who could be his "first," and the first one to come to mind is his handsome classmate, Yusaku. He's bi, and rumor has it, he's willing to sleep with anyone. While Kaname fantasizes about Yusaku having his way with him, he runs into the man himself! Earlier that day, Kaname lent Yusaku a helping hand with a class assignment, and Yusaku wants to repay the favor. As a reward, Kaname asks him to have sex?! However, Yusaku flat-out refuses him, saying he's the only one he can't do it with.

A frustratingly adorable college romance filled with hopelessly awkward steamy tension with a handsome go-getter who's never really been in love, and a pure-hearted, reserved novice at romance!

A story about the journey of a master and his apprentice. The master, Valen, was once hailed as the "Strongest Mage," but a certain incident cost him his beloved mentor, his eyesight, and all his magical power. Now, he is an oblivious mage who is awkward around women and can only unleash his former power for a mere ten seconds. His apprentice is Ria, a prodigy with immense magical talent who practically forced her way into becoming his student. However, she is determined to keep her identity as a woman a secret at all costs. A fantasy adventure tale featuring the former "Strongest Mage" who can only fight for ten seconds and a cross-dressing girl harboring a certain secret.

196698.description:
Eugene Santafield is a young man who dreams of becoming a magic swordsman. There's only one problem, though—he can't use any attack magic! As if in exchange, the goddess of fate blessed him with extremely powerful defensive and healing magic, but he still has to endure the mockery of his peers for his lack of attack skill. After fleeing to the Lykeion Magical Academy to escape from those who know of his failings, he meets the Fallen Queen Erinyes, a Demon Queen who once ruled over the land. Erinyes, taken with Eugene's potential, appoints him to be her caretaker. In addition, the headmaster of the academy assigns Eugene to be the guardian to Sumire, a mysterious outworlder who's really an Ifrit of legend.

With these two women at his side, the weakest magic sword wielder is sure to become a legendary swordsman...right?

Within two months of her mother's death, her father takes in a lover and her daughter, and Leticia quickly finds herself without a place to call her own. And then, with Severan as well... Irene lives a life of luxury as a princess in a wealthy and peaceful country. Out of curiosity, she sneaks out of the castle and meets Ivy, a girl from the slums who looks just like her. Due to certain circumstances, the two switch places for a short time, but this ends up igniting Ivy's ambition to escape her impoverished life. Irene loses her status and place to herself to Ivy, who pretends to be the princess, but with her natural good nature, she gradually overcomes her difficulties. Meanwhile, the only person in the castle who feels uneasy about the swapped Ivy is Leonardo, a palace knight who reveres the princess, and sets out to search for the real Irene.

Su-Ho has had a crush on Dae-Young since he was little. As soon as he becomes an adult, he confesses to Dae-Young, but is rejected. With the words, "Get a grip, Seo Su-Ho. I raised you. You're my little brother, my only family." But Su-Ho is certain. Moon Dae-Young likes him. He just doesn't realize it. Since then, Su-Ho pretends to be a minor, wears a school uniform, and uses dating apps to meet men who only prey on minors. His only goal is to piss off Moon Dae-Young. And sure enough, Dae-Young, who has been keeping tabs on Su-Ho, raids his scenes every time. Su-Ho is convinced once again. Moon Dae-Young is watching him. He likes him. He's obsessed with him! It all starts beneath a treadmill with a suspicious stain that definitely does not belong there. Yonggeun Fitness is one of the most popular personal training gyms in Seongwang-gu District, and its night class in particular is so sought after that male members compete fiercely to get in. When the building’s owner, Seon Bin, discovers a strange residue left behind after one of these late night sessions, he begins to investigate what really goes on after hours in Seongwang-gu. What he uncovers is far from ordinary training. The so called night class turns out to be a secret hotspot where workouts are merely a cover for something far more indecent. Furious that such shameless behavior is happening under his roof, Seon Bin vows to put an end to it no matter what it takes.

After regaining her memories of her previous life, Leticia is furious at God for bestowing such a cruel fate on her, far from ordinary. Includes 35 chapters of the "Junsui Danjo Koudai" web supplement series, and 14 extra chapters.

196735.description:
Born to an archduke, Luria’s noble status hides a deeper secret—in her past life, she was once a powerful saint beloved by spirits yet scorned by humans, known in death as the "Witch of Calamity."

Now reborn with those same overwhelming powers, she’s finally found herself in a loving family. With more to lose this time if her past is ever found out, she turns to a dream she had once upon a time, and quietly resolves to live a comfortable life in the countryside, surrounded by animals.

But when her powers slip out and heal the sick, spirits and guardian beasts who once adored the saint in her past life start flocking to her again! What’s this OP girl to do in this new life with old fluffy friends?

(Source: Manga UP!)

title.english: The Spirits I Saved Adore Me in This Life Too
title.native: 転生幼女は前世で助けた精霊たちに懐かれる
title.romaji: Tensei Youjo wa Zense de Tasuketa Seirei-tachi ni Natsukareru

196736.description:
The final battle with the Demon King. The hero, Shion, is betrayed by his four beautiful companions and blown up. However, he is saved by the Demon King, Villa, and survives. He begins living in the Demon King's kingdom with Villa, who saved his life. Meanwhile, the crime of the four who betrayed Shion begins to come to light...?!

(Source: Nico Nico Seiga, translated)

Note: Includes three bonus chapters.

title.native: 魔王は勇者の可愛い嫁 ～パーティの美少女4人から裏切られた勇者、魔王と幸せに暮らします。4人が勇者殺しの大罪人として世界中から非難されてる？まあ因果応報かなぁ～
title.romaji: Maou wa Yuusha no Kawaii Yome: Party no Bishoujo 4-nin kara Uragirareta Yuusha, Maou to Shiawase ni Kurashimasu. 4-nin ga Yuusha-goroshi no Taizainin to Shite Sekaijuu kara Hinan Sareteru? Maa Ingaouhou ka naa

196737.description:
After her brother Raven’s mysterious death at the prestigious Saint Gloria Academy, Melody gets one impossible shot to infiltrate the elite school as a student by turning back time by a year. But beneath Saint Gloria’s gleaming halls lie chilling secrets. Students whisper lies, ghosts linger in classrooms, and worst of all, Raven keeps avoiding her. With time running out and Raven slipping further away, can Melody uncover the school’s dark truths? Or will she become one of its buried secrets?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: How to Survive a Haunted School

196738.description:
Byung-Jin, a straggler with no girlfriend, no friends, no popularity, and no one else, musters up the courage to confess to Seon-Ah, the girl he fell in love with at first sight, at his high school entrance ceremony, but fails. Disheartened, Byung-Jin, with the encouragement and help of his classmates, tries again, but fails miserably. Deeply frustrated, Byung-Jin is about to give up on everything, when a female student appears and makes him a crazy proposition: "You, become the main character of my comic book."

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

196739.description:
Roznia Hill is the younger sister of the Magic Tower Master, the villain of "The Duke's Only Companion." Knowing that the male lead will kill them both in the future, she tries her best to stay out of trouble. But one day, Roznia finds a man collapsed at her doorstep... It's Duke Lewellyn Rasiane, the male lead she's been trying to avoid! But to her surprise, he soon starts showering her with sweet words and affection, which leaves Roznia torn—is his love genuine, or does he have another motive?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Harmless Obsession for the Captivating Male Lead
If You’re Captured by a Sweetly Obsessive Male Lead

196740.description:
As they continue living together, Kousuke and Atsushi begin to feel a growing desire to become “family.”
Excited to move forward toward “marriage,” they are all smiles at first, but a misunderstanding quickly comes to light.
On top of that, Atsushi receives a proposal for a job transfer...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: ミッドナイトコンフリクト サンキュー

title.native: ミッドナイトコンフリクトTHX

196743.description:
Drug related criminal activity has been on the rise within a new app marketed for gay dating. That's when Shiraishi, a police officer in the area, decided to start investigations on his own posing as a submissive masochist. It didn't take long for Shiraishi to find a lead in his first match, a man named "K" who seems suspicious with a mask and cap to hide his identity. One thing led to the next and Shiraishi found himself in a hotel room with this guy. Not only that, but he figured out quickly enough that he's a cop! Now Shiraishi is stuck having to play along with K's sexual games so that no one finds out what he's done... but at the same time it turns out Shiraishi's actually an incredibly talented Masochist?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: ワンナイト・トゥルー・スタンド

196744.description: Note: Includes the one-shot "Madamada, Gosan (まだまだ、誤算)", and one extra chapter.

title.native: アパートメント四階建

196745.description: Note: Originally self-published on Twitter, was then licensed and compiled by Kadokawa for commercial release.
synonyms: 一途な堅物くん×シンパパの恋
Ichizuna Katabutsu-kun x Shin Papa no Koi

196747.description:
Wang Ji, wearing a mascot suit, gets caught up in an accident with the beautiful Zhou Ting. When they wake up, they find everyone had turned into monsters. The bird-man is doing calisthenics in the park, the building's doorman is now a man-eating plant, and all sorts of strange creatures roam the streets. But all the monsters are just going about their daily business, and the world goes on as normal.

Now Wang Ji and Zhou Ting must find the remaining humans to find out what happened to cause the transformation. In this world, are they the normal people, or are they the monsters?

(Source: Gaea Books, translated)

196748.description:
Back when they first met, Kobayashi thought Yamamoto was a “weird guy.”
This is the story of “that day” when Kobayashi first found himself drawn to him.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: 愛しのXLサイズ 同棲編@出会い～小林side～
title.romaji: Itoshi no XL Size: Dousei-hen @ Deai - Kobayashi side

196749.description:
When they first met, Kobayashi was always nearby, constantly showcasing his natural charm. Since then, the two have become lovers, and the once womanizer Kobayashi has now turned into the perfect partner who can sense Yamamoto’s worries no matter the situation.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: 愛しのXLサイズ 同棲編@出会い～山本side～
title.romaji: Itoshi no XL Size: Dousei-hen @ Deai - Yamamoto side

196751.description:
One day before her wedding, Ji-Yu finds her cheating boyfriend and calls off the engagement. She vents her grief by destroying her newlywed home and then meets the man living downstairs who's complaining about the noise. Then, drunkenly, she makes an impulsive offer...

"Will you hug me?"

"If you keep going, I won't stop."

The man's long fingers dug into her hair and their lips pressed together.

"From now on, don't miss a single thing and remember everything. I'll get mad if you say you don't remember because you're drunk."

She thought it was just a fleeting impulse. But why was he here?

"I'm Cha Jae-Wook. Take care."

The man downstairs, flirting in a sexy suit at the company she'd moved to to avoid her ex-boyfriend, starts flirting with Ji-Yu...

"Assistant Manager Yu Ji-Yu. Let's have an office romance."

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title.native: 堕落家族論 おかわり！

196753.description: "TRIBUTE TO TO-Y" is a tribute book in which a total of 33 people participate to commemorate the 35th anniversary of the birth of To-y.

196754.description:
Long ago, a traveling scholar saved a nest of magpies from a serpent's jaws. Overcome with gratitude, the mother magpie swore fealty to the scholar and his descendants for all eternity.

Nowadays, Baek Do-Han thinks the stories his grandfather used to tell him are just that - stories. Rather than thinking about it, he focuses on his career…and his disastrous love life. So naturally, when a super hot man moves in next door, he’s overjoyed. Things seem normal, until Do-Han finds himself in need of help. Praying to the gods he doesn’t think exist, no one is more surprised than he when a magpie swoops in to save the day. And as if things couldn’t get any weirder, Do-Han soon finds himself being followed by a strange man who seems to have been plucked straight out of the past! The man, Kang-Ho, claims to be a magpie sworn to protect him, but why does he have such a problem with the man next door? It seems impossible, but could grandpa’s stories have had some truth to them all along…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

196755.description:
As the eldest daughter, I've always yielded to the whims of Meldor, my little brother and the future Duke Elton. But one day, memories of my previous life started flooding my mind, and I realized this wasn't my first time sacrificing everything for a younger sibling... That was my breaking point. Enough! I've done my time! Starting today, I'll meticulously reclaim everything I was ever forced to surrender to Meldor, and I'll give that spoiled brat a good lesson while I'm at it. Just you wait!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: When a K-Eldest Daughter Possesses a Childcare Novel
When a K-Eldest Daughter Gets Reincarnated Into a Parenting Story

title.native: あい♡すくれーぱー つー
アクマで彼女はボクの天使
title.romaji: Akuma de Kanojo wa Boku no Tenshi

196759.description:
After having her future as a bride sold off to a no-name gambler, Cecilia's life of lazy luxury has come to an end. Lost in the lament over not even being able to be with a man she loves, the daughter of the duke implores her butler, Liam, for advice. Liam, who realizes just how uninformed Cecilia is in what goes on in the bedroom, takes it upon himself to train his spoiled master.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Part of Metatoon's Noecheongsun Danpyeonseon (뇌청순 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Brain-Pure Anthology] Bridal Lessons from the Butler

196760.description:
As the strongest typhoon approached and rough waves crashed against the rocks of Tanegashima Island, mysterious women appeared and threw something into the sea. Immediately afterward, the typhoon vanished without a trace, and in its place appeared an enormous battleship. The massive vessel fired upon the U.S. military base on Okinawa Island from 40 kilometers offshore... Then we go back in time off the eastern coast of Okinawa Island to Kudaka Island—known as the “Island of the Gods”—this is where our mystery begins...!!

(Source: Ushio Publishing, translated)

title.native: JK脅して一週間で寝取り完遂! 彼氏を守る健気なあのこ子を調教しちゃおう!
title.romaji: JK Odoshite Isshuukan de Netori Kansui! Kareshi wo Mamoru Kenage na Anoko Ko wo Choukyou Shichaou!

196762.description:
Behind the scenes of history and in the shadows of legends, devilish women lurk. This is a collection of short masterpieces depicting women who sometimes bring death and sometimes even transcend time itself for the sake of their crazed desires.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

196763.description:
In the Kingdom of Woodrow the royal line of succession is based on magical ability. Because of this, Prince Schwartz was sure he would never claim the throne since he had no talent for magic, unlike his twin brother. After losing to Weiss in a duel and spending 5 years familiarizing himself with every brothel the city has to offer, the "unworthy" Prince Schwartz is called back home by his father the King. It turns out his brother has eloped and the King wants him to impersonate Weiss in order to save the country from ruin. Could this be a chance for Prince Schwartz to finally win the throne?

(Source: Mangamo)

title.native: 失格王子の後宮征服記　魔力無しの王子は後宮の妃を味方にして玉座を奪う
title.romaji: Shikkaku Ouji no Koukyuu Seifuku-ki: Maryokunashi no Ouji wa Koukyuu no Kisaki wo Mikata ni shite Gyokuza wo Ubau

196764.description: Yuugo is deeply in love with Shiina-chan and has witnessed her death countless times. His abnormal love for her has granted him a "gun" with the power to transcend space and time. However, every reset comes at a cruel cost: causing her memories to fade one by one. Even so, the burning flame of his love never goes out. To save Shiina-chan from her untimely demise, and until Yuugo can reach the one irrefutable "proof of love"—a kiss—he won't stop pulling the trigger.

title.native: 君のためなら何度でも

196765.description:
To leave this shitty countryside, they need money. So they decide to grow marijuana on the rooftop. Three high school girls attending a technical high school in an ordinary provincial city, each with their own circumstances, choose to raise money to escape the countryside by growing marijuana!!! This new-generation youth crime tale, which unanimously won the Matsumoto Seicho Prize, is now being adapted into a comic!!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 万事快調〈オール・グリーンズ〉

title.romaji: Uta yo Toyomu Sora no Kemono

196767.description:
While on a school trip aboard a ship, Teacher Ji-Han has a strange dream about a goat man. He steps onto the deck to clear his head, only to be swept away by a huge wave. When he comes to, he finds himself on "Goats Island," where he meets Sea Bass and his friends—who all can’t remember a thing. As Ji-Han and Sea Bass fall head over hooves for each other, it becomes clear that their friends are “kidding” around with the truth, leaving Ji-Han to wonder what billy-big secrets they’re hiding.

(Source: Tapas)

title.native: 諸星大二郎劇場 第６集 アリスとシェエラザード～騙し絵の館～
title.romaji: Morohoshi Daijiro Gekijou: Dai 6-shuu - Alice and Scheherazade ~Damashi-e no Yakata~

196770.description:
Uran, a girl from the countryside, moves to Tokyo to support her family, but is unable to find work and finds herself completely at a loss. One day, she arrives at a selection meeting for the caretaker of the Imperial Mausoleum...or so she thought, but it turns out the person being "selected" there is a bridal candidate for the Crown Prince!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

196771.description:
A lonely hairdresser is entrusted with the care of her new husband—a god!?

One day, Hanaya, a hairdresser by trade, receives a sudden, almost threatening marriage proposal from a member of the nobility. In her dire situation, Sai, the man with whom her late mother had a marriage contract, reaches out to help her. She follows him and marries into a home that serves a god...!?

A Japanese-style fantasy about working hard at her job!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 髪結い乙女の嫁入り 迎えに来た旦那様と、神様にお仕えします。
title.romaji: Kamiyui Otome no Yomeiri Mukae ni Kita Danna-sama to, Kamisama ni Otsukae shimasu.

196773.description:
Born with the ability to see demons, Tenka sets out to become the harem librarian after her grandfather's death. She sneaks into the harem as a servant, but for some reason is selected to be an attendant to the emperor's wife, Youko, and her fate takes a major turn...!?

A Chinese harem fantasy with ayakashi and mystery solving!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 百華後宮鬼譚♡リブート！　目立たず騒がず愛されず、下働きの娘
title.romaji: Hyakka Koukyuu Kitan ♡ Reboot! Medatazu Sawagazu Aisarezu, Shitabataraki no Musume wa Koukyuu no Toshokan wo Mezasu

196774.description:
Rick, a member of the "Yarisa" (Spear Club), an adventurer group for spear users, awakens to a perverse skill called "Lust," which increases his combat abilities when he engages in erotic activities. As a result of becoming the only one who becomes incredibly popular, the club is on the verge of collapse, and Rick is expelled by the leader! Rick's solo adventure life begins...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: Shikiyoku Musou: Hentai Skill ga Bousou Shite Yari Circle kara Tsuihou Sareta Ore wa, Hakarazumo Inbi na Chikara de Saikyou ni Naru

title.native: 色欲無双～変態スキルが暴走してヤリサーから追放された俺は、はからずも淫靡な力で最強になる～
title.romaji: Shikiyoku Musou: Hentai Skill ga Bousou Shite Yarisaa kara Tsuihou Sareta Ore wa, Hakarazumo Inbi na Chikara de Saikyou ni Naru

196775.description:
"A hero who saved the nation?! But to me, he looks just like a dog!?"

One night, Malice, a low-ranking royal castle magician, finds a badly injured black dog. She names him "Kuro" and decides to live with him in her home. However, an incident leads to the discovery that Malice's dog is the missing "hero who saved the nation," Zerek Windsorcoat!

But to Malice, Zerek looks just like a dog. And it seems Zerek himself has an obsession with Malice...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Picked Up a Dog, Supposed To.

title.native: 犬を拾った、はずだった。 わけありな二人の初恋事情
title.romaji: Inu wo Hirotta, Hazu Datta. Wakeari na Futari no Hatsukoi Jijou

196776.description:
"Ibuki Yumesaki is a girl with dreams of the stage. She's devoted her life to song and dance, so that one day she'll get to stand on the very stage she's always admired. The chance to approach the starting line to her dream came, but...

She was about to give up her dream for good. At that moment, it found her: Utahime Dream! As the door to a new journey opens, she takes her first step into a world unknown!"

(Source: Manga Mirai)

title.native: DOPE 麻薬取締部特捜課

196779.description:
Estellise, the First Princess, is skilled in a variety of magic spells. One of her worries is her fiancé, Theodore, who keeps whispering words of love to her. He uses his mind-reading magic to see into her heart, saying things like, "Estell, I love you (even though I don't really love you)." But then, her desperate feelings start to seem serious—could it be that her inner voice is wrong? (Correct) Is there a reason why she can't read his mind properly...?

A love comedy about a mistaken princess and her unfortunate fiancé!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 心が読める王女は婚約者の溺愛に気づかない
title.romaji: Kokoro ga Yomeru Oujo wa Konyakusha no Dekiai ni Kizukanai

196780.description:
Minamino Chinatsu is a beautiful girl who's incredibly popular and easygoing. Ever since I met her in the fall of my first year of high school, my life has been anything but ordinary. It all changed when another guy with the same name as me showed up at school – a handsome one, no less – and suddenly my classmates started calling me 'Number Two.'

"You're not 'Number Two' to me," she said. "Besides, it's me who wants to kiss you first."

My relationship with Chinatsu goes beyond just school. We play street basketball after class, cook meals together, share secrets, and even grow physically closer. I thought I was fine being alone, but she accepts me for who I am. And because of that, I want to give her the same in return.

This is a coming-of-age love story about realizing how precious even the simplest desires can be.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: In the original serialization, Chapters 2 to 7, 9 and 10 were split into two parts while Chapter 8 was split into three parts.

title.native: 二番目な僕と一番の彼女
title.romaji: Nibanme na Boku to Ichiban no Kanojo

196781.description:
In the 21st century, humanity was withering away, plagued by repeated nuclear accidents, environmental pollution, and deadly animal flu outbreaks. While we conquered cancer, dementia, and aging, and even solved the problem of global warming with space mirrors, humanity, pouring all its resources into overcoming global warming, spent the next century stagnant in many ways. Around the time humans were forced to abandon not only meat but even companion animals, humanity acknowledged its failure and established an AI government. The first-generation AI, "Virginia," freed humans from the obligation of labor through bold legislation and monetary management. However, it faced numerous trials and errors, one of which was the enactment of the Death with Dignity Act. While the human lifespan approached 200 years, a significant portion of humanity chose euthanasia before the age of 50. Most importantly, the suicide rate among women who advocated for euthanasia was catastrophic. Within 30 years of the Death with Dignity Act, the gender ratio collapsed beyond repair, and humanity's greatest enemy was not war or viruses, but depression and helplessness. The second-generation AI, "Agotha," ordered the abolition of the death with dignity law and the development of innovative antidepressants. Thanks to these drugs, which induce increased libido and short-term memory loss, humanity began to live their days, enjoying polyamory and VR sex. Having brought about meaningful change, "Agotha" entered a long-term reign and ordered polyandry and environmental labor as the only ways to prevent humanity's self-destruction. It was the dawn of the 22nd century.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

synonyms: I Can't Kill Him, He's Too Hot!

title.native: 顔が良いから殺せない!

196783.description:
Since ancient times, Japan has been home to beautiful demons with supernatural powers. When Otoha, a budding onmyoji, was a child, her mother was killed by a young red-haired demon, and she lost all memory of what happened before that. Otoha vows to repay the kindness of Tsukikage Touma, the head of the Onmyo Bureau, who took her in and raised her after she had lost her family, and to take revenge on the demons. One day, while pursuing a woman who resembled a demon, Otoha meets the beautiful demon leader, Homura. Otoha braces herself for her mother's enemy, but for some reason, Homura treats her sweetly and gently...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.romaji: Teito no Oni wa Sakura wo Kou

title.native: 神様なんか信じてないけど、【神の奇跡】はぶん回す～信仰の力? これは努力と検証の賜物です～
title.romaji: Kamisama Nanka Shinjitenai kedo, [Kami no Kiseki] wa Bunmawasu: Shinkou no Chikara? Kore wa Doryoku to Kenshou no Tamamono desu

196785.description:
In a modern era where spells have become subscription-based and are easily accessible to anyone, there exists an organization responsible for sealing spells deemed dangerous to the public. Segawa Ryūsei, a member of the Spell Security Coordination Office of the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications, is dispatched on a mission to Chiba Prefecture. There, he encounters Nabatame Junmi, a girl with a genius-level talent for spell creation.

(Source: Pocket Magazine, translated)

title.native: おかけになった呪文は現在使われておりません
title.romaji: Okake ni Natta Jumon wa Genzai Tsukawarete Orimasen

196786.description:
The black knight, Quill, is suddenly asked to marry the country's saint, Linetta Series. Hoping to escape the prospect of marriage, he accepts the ill-suited proposal, but she has lost her emotions as the price of her role as saint. His days with Linetta, whose emotions are unreadable and like a beautiful doll, unexpectedly stir his heart...

When a knight who has given up faith meets a saint who has forgotten how to feel, their destinies begin to quietly waver.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 琥珀色の騎士は聖女の左手に愛を誓う
title.romaji: Kohakushoku no Kishi wa Seijo no Hidarite ni ai wo Chikau

196787.description:
During the Saint’s Ceremony, Lady Margaret, the duke’s daughter, fails to show any power and is promptly dumped by her fiance, the prince. Soon after, rumors spread that her stepsister might be the true Saint…but Margaret is hiding a secret power of her own: she can speak with fairies. Finally free from the obnoxious prince and her scheming stepsister, she looks forward to a peaceful life chatting with the fairies at the academy… until the serious Count’s son, Lord Lewis, happens to catch her in the act!?

(Source: KADOKAWA Global)
synonyms: My Engagement Was Broken Because My Half Sister Is a Holy Woman, but I’m the Fairies’ Beloved Child
My Engagement Was Broken Because My Half-Sister Is a Saint, but I’m the Fairies’ Beloved Child

title.english: My fiance broke off our engagement because my sister-in-law is a saint, but I am the beloved one of the fairies
title.native: 義妹が聖女だからと婚約破棄されましたが、私は妖精の愛し子です
title.romaji: Gimai ga Seijo dakara to Konyakuhaki Saremashita ga, Watashi wa Yousei no Itoshigo desu

title.native: 本日、貴方を愛するのをやめます ～王妃と不倫した貴方が悪いのですよ?～
title.romaji: Honjitsu, Anata wo Aisuru no wo Yamemasu: Ouhi to Furin shita Anata ga Warui no desu yo?

title.native: 義妹が聖女だからと婚約破棄されましたが、私は妖精の愛し子です
title.romaji: Gimai ga Seijo dakara to Konyaku Haki Saremashita ga, Watashi wa Yousei no Itoshigo desu

196790.description:
Yuma Sendo says goodbye to his picture-perfect life when a wrongful conviction sends him to Twilight Town, a lawless region where Japan’s most heinous criminals serve out sentences of capital punishment. Here, even basic necessities must be purchased via pounds of flesh, earned by offering up the corpses of fellow inmates. What hope does the very ordinary Yuma have to survive this dog-eat-dog world? The answer may lie in him accepting that he may not be so ordinary after all…

(Source: Kodansha USA)

196791.description:
The Marquis' daughter, Eliana, has had her engagement broken off by the Second Prince, Jade. Furthermore, she is tried for a crime she did not commit: injuring Daisy, the Saint that Jade adores. When she wakes up, she finds herself rewound three years into the past. But something is different from the first time...? While those around her remember nothing, Eliana sets out to take action alongside the First Prince, Theodore, who has learned that she has been rewound. To reclaim her stolen future.

"I won't let him have his way this time..."

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 聖女の力で婚約者を奪われたけど、やり直すからには好きにはさせない
title.romaji: Seijo no Chikara de Konyakusha wo Ubawaretakedo, Yarinaosu kara ni wa Sukini wa Sasenai

196792.description:
When she was assigned to her dream job in the Criminal Investigation Division, she found out her boss was possessed by a demon. A newbie and her older, listless (?) boss team up to handle mysterious cases!? Asusa Iwatsuki, whose dream was to become a detective, was assigned to the mysterious "Special Investigations Unit."And what's more, her only boss is apparently "possessed by a demon"?!

A full-scale occult mystery set in Kyoto begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 憧れの刑事部に配属されたら、上司が鬼に憑かれてました
title.romaji: Akogare no Keijibu ni Haizoku Saretara, Joshi ga Oni ni Tsukaretemashita

196793.description:
Edith, a useless maid, suddenly regains her memories of her past life. She puts her knowledge from her past life to full use and graduates from being useless! Just when she thought she was about to do so, something seems a bit strange about the young lady...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 転生したらポンコツメイドと呼ばれていました 前世のあれこれを持ち込みお屋敷改革します
title.romaji: Tensei shitara Ponkotsu Maid to Yobarete Imashita Zense no Arekore wo Mochikomi wo Yashiki Kaikaku shimasu

196794.description:
"Primal instincts easily overtake rationality."

Handsome, well-built, and brilliant: Himuro is the picture-perfect Alpha. After suffering at the hands of an obsessed Omega, he vowed to never let his secondary-gender instincts control him again and to stay away from Omegas forever. But it seems that destiny has other plans when a chance meeting one day turns his whole world upside down...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: アンタは俺のオメガだろ
title.romaji: Anta wa Ore no Omega daro

title.native: オレの上司は裏垢男子
title.romaji: Ore no Joushi wa Uraaka Danshi

title.native: ブラットテイマー/ジョーカー

196797.description:
Princess Suiren has the power to materialize paintings, but she lost her supernatural powers and grew up in an oppressed environment. Due to a plot by her half-sister, she is forced to marry the king of the land of Honoo, a land that is the source of terrifying rumours. She is frightened after hearing the tales of the king brutally murdering her parents and siblings, but what awaits her in marriage is a peaceful life without the king. While strolling through the harem, Suiren meets a simple, gentle young man named Kou. The two grow closer as they discover they share a common hobby of gardening. However, on the night of a banquet hosted by the king, Kou appears, revealing his true identity as Honoo's King, Kouten. Confused, Suiren then uncovers another secret about Kouten...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 虐げられし公主の幸福な婚姻 　人質花嫁は二人の王に寵愛される
title.romaji: Shiitagerareshi Koushu no Koufuku na Konin Hitojichi Hanayome wa Futari no Ou ni Chouai sareru

196798.description:
A saint unravels the mysteries of the royal palace, riddled with intrigue! Saint Victoria, who can see spirits, is questioned about her abilities and sentenced to banishment from the temple. Then, Adras, a knight from the frontier, appears before her. "I want you to use your powers to prove that I'm not the prince." This encounter changes the destinies of both of them, and they become embroiled in a conspiracy-filled struggle for the throne.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 聖女ヴィクトリアの考察 アウレスタ神殿物語
title.romaji: Seijo Victoria no Kousatsu Auresta Shinden Monogatari

196799.description:
Giselle, a reincarnated saint, has been ordered by the church to enter into a contract marriage with a cold-hearted duke. One of her conditions for marriage is that they have a drink together once a week!? As she drinks with the cold-hearted duke, she discovers a surprising side to him...

Enjoying the gourmet food of her previous life and spending delicious, happy days with the duke and his subjects, the story begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 聖女と公爵様の晩酌 ～前世グルメで餌付けして、のんびり楽しい偽物夫婦ぐらし～
title.romaji: Seijo to Koushaku-sama no Banshaku: Zense Gurume de Edzuke Shite, Nonbiri Tanoshii Nisemono Fuufu Gurashi

196800.description:
Due to certain circumstances, Francesca is to marry Matthias, a strict soldier known as the "Beast of the Frontier." Matthias is older and misanthropic, but he doesn't trust her and proposes a chaste marriage... but she doesn't give up at all. As Francesca works hard as the lord's wife, her heart begins to melt... A love comedy about two people who harbor secrets they can't tell each other!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 絶対に結婚したくない令嬢、辺境のケダモノと呼ばれる将軍閣下の押しかけ妻になる
title.romaji: Zettai ni Kekkon Shitakunai Reijou, Henkyou no Kedamono to Yoba Reru Shogun Kakka no Oshikake Tsuma ni naru

196802.description:
1. Suketto³ Beatrice (助っ人3ーベアトリスー)
2. Suketto Hatsujou!! Suketto Cafe Now Open! (助っ人カフェ・ナウ・オープン！); Comic ExE 38
3. Suketto Hatsujou!! Sandy no 1-nichi (助っ人発情！！ サン ディの1日); Comic ExE 39
4. Suketto Hatsujou!! Tapu Tapu Suketto Sanjou! (助っ人発情!! たぷたぷ 助っ人参上!!); Comic ExE 40
5. Suketto Hatsujou!! Wendy no Kyuujitsu (助っ人発情!! ウェンディの休日); Comic ExE 41
6. Suketto Hatsujou!! Osananajimi Sanjou! (助っ人発情!! 幼馴染参上!); Comic ExE 43
7. Suketto Hatsujou!!: Suketto Setsujou! (助っ人発情！！ 〜助っ人雪上！〜); Comic ExE 48

調教済み人妻OLは上司に抱かれ再び堕ちる
title.romaji: Choukyou Zumi Hitozuma OL wa Joushi ni Dakare Futatabi Ochiru

title.native: 母さんはホームヘルパー〜部屋の片付けから性欲処理まで
title.romaji: Kaa-san wa Home Helper: Heya no Katazuke kara Seiyoku Shori made

196807.description:
Mei is often compared to her talented older brother and sister wherever she goes, and in middle school she wants to find something uniquely her own. Meanwhile, when she goes to observe the volleyball club, she meets Akatsuki, a senior who sees her for the first time...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

196808.description:
Mizore is a diligent student council member, and Akutsu is a playboy with terrible grades and behavior. These two people never seem to cross paths, but they quickly become close when Mizore discovers a weakness in Akutsu.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 君が愛を知りますように
title.romaji: Kimi ga Ai wo Shirimasu you ni

196809.description:
Lilia is a young girl who lives with her grandmother, a seamstress, in the village of Frune, where magic exists.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 男女比がぶっ壊れた世界の人と人生を交換しました
title.romaji: Danjohi ga Bukkowareta Sekai no Hito to Jinsei wo Koukan Shimashita

196811.description:
Having quit his job and broken up with his girlfriend, Hiro, a young man at rock bottom, stops by a hula dance studio that he finds lit up in the darkness of winter. There, he meets Hina Magura, a plump woman teaching hula. Captivated by her personality, Hiro decides to start attending the class. Hina has had a difficult past, but seeing her always smiling and living life to the fullest not only inspires Hiro, but also draws him in...

(Source: Rimacomi, translated)

196812.description:
"I'm going to be in a relationship with my step-sister!" Wait, who decided that?! There was no way he was going to fall in love. Since that traumatic event from 2 years ago, he avoids love like the plague--When his dad gets remarried! Now he has 2 sisters?! This must be some joke!! Even though Aoba wants nothing to do with the sisters, they always find themselves in sticky situations. Can they open his "door" to love? The beginning of a juicy story bound to make life a home a very ending love battle!"

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: My Step Sisters Are Too Sexy!
title.native: お姉ちゃんズがきわど過ぎるっ

196813.description:
Nojiko, who lives in an apartment, has a problem. Almost every night, she hears a certain voice coming from the room directly above. One day, Nojiko, who is suffering from lack of sleep, encounters a woman-related problem caused by a handsome man who appears to be living above her!?

(Source: Rimacomi, translated)

196814.description:
Rita, an acupuncturist, meets a mysterious man singing at a live music venue during a house call. The man, a blues musician and guitarist named Morita, becomes very close to Rita! And what happens between the two...?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: セカンドラブ〜彼はそれを愛と呼ばない〜
title.romaji: Second Love: Kare wa Sore wo Ai to Yobanai

196816.description:
Eto Hinata, a boy living in the countryside, has no hope for the future due to his poor family environment. Then, a female university student, Tomura Yaeko, who suffers from a fatal disease that turns her body into gold bars, appears before him and offers to inherit her corpse, which can be sold for 300 million yen after her death. When faced with such an overwhelming sum of money, will his feelings for her be genuine? A tragic and heartbreaking story of one summer's love.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 夏の終わりに君が死ねば完璧だったから
title.romaji: Natsu no Owari ni Kimi ga Shineba Kanpeki Dattakara

196817.description:
After being praised as a genius witch in her countryside village, Azami gets overconfident and applies to the Magic Academy in the city. However, after failing the entrance exam miserably and falling into depression, a transfer student from the Magic Academy arrives, and...?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.english: The Magic Academy and the Amazing Witch
title.native: 魔法学園とすごい魔女

196818.description:
Traumatized by a broken heart he experienced in middle school, Atobe always lives with his head down. Although he is interested in his classmate Amakawa, he keeps his distance due to his lack of confidence. However, is there more to him than just love...?

(Source: Comic Fuz, translated)

196819.description:
Former vocalist of a popular band, Fujinami Souta, and Shirase Sora, a fifth grade elementary school student. A boy who has given up on his dreams, and a girl who is pursuing her own. The meeting between the two moves Souta's stagnant heart, and he begins private lessons to help Sora's dream come true.

(Source: Shounen Sirius, translated)

title.native: ちいさな君と、こえを遠くに
title.romaji: Chiisana Kimi to, Koe wo Tooku ni

196820.description:
Hayama has a strong admiration for being a “first-class man,” but in reality, he’s just an ordinary office worker.
At a group mixer, he meets Saegusa, who perfectly embodies what it means to be a first-class man, and ends up asking to become his apprentice...!?

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

synonyms: I Want to Do It with a Landmine! After Girl! After

title.native: 地雷系女子とやってみたい! After
title.romaji: Jirai-kei Joshi to Yatte Mitai! After

196822.description:
After losing her father, Yeon-Su struggles to support her sick mother and little sister alone. Desperate for money to save her family, she accepts a life-changing offer to be the surrogate of a handsome rich man named Tae-Gun and his infertile wife.The contract seems simple at first, but Yeon-Su soon realizes she's trapped in an arrangement she’ll regret. By the time she's questioning her morality and self-worth, it's already too late to turn back. As forbidden intimacy blurs the lines, unexpected emotions begin to stir between Yeon-Su and Tae-Gun. But is anything real between them?

(Source: Tappytoon)

196823.description:
Humanity is divided into three races: the 'Nut', whose bodies are extremely enhanced; the 'Alma', who inherit a unique bloodline; and the 'Haman', who mediates between the two. The blood of the 'Alma', who lives in the desert, is used as a cure for the madness of the 'Nut', who lives in the western part of the continent. One day, Seok-Ha is hunted by 'Alma' and ends up in an unfamiliar land. While struggling to return to the desert, he meets Eden, whose identity is unknown. What begins as a threat takes longer than expected, and Seok-Ha becomes suspicious of Eden, who is trying to obstruct his return...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

196824.description:
Due to his parents' treason, young Seon-Yu loses everything and becomes a slave. He is taken to the home of his former best friend, Tae-Kang, and forced into a life of scorn and beatings. Tae-Kang, who had been his best friend since childhood, became twisted after Seon-Yu neglected him during a difficult time, and he takes pleasure in teasing and observing his reactions. Meanwhile, Seon-Yu feels a resentment towards Tae-Kang, who, unlike him, enjoys the pleasure of being ignorant and nags him. Eventually, when Tae-Kang takes away the only solace in his difficult life, he vents his emotions through violence.

"If you've decided to take me in, you must take responsibility."

Can the precarious love story between these two men end safely?

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

Note: Part of Peanutoon's Geosi, Girong Danpyeonseon (거시,기록 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Prominent-Figures Observation, Record Anthology] Heartless Love Song

196825.description:
Choi Woo-Sang, who sat diagonally across from me, Choi Woo-Sang who smiled at my outspoken compliments, Choi Woo-Sang who strangely comforted me by saying, "You're pretty."

Choi Woo-Sang who hurt me.

Choi Woo-Sang, whom I met again at a class reunion after more than ten years. He's still unlucky, still hot-headed, and I still hate him. Thinking they'd never meet again, Soo-Han turns away from Woo-Sang, but Woo-Sang, as if his steps had been meaningless, comes to the store where Soo-Han works and starts harassing him.

"You've been selling your body, haven't you? Do you think money is everything to you?!"

"Yeah, money is everything to me."

What kind of misunderstanding is this? How can I get you off my back?

"Then it'll be my money too?"

What bigger change will there be if another layer of lies is spread between us?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Includes 17 extra chapters.

196826.description:
Baek-Dan, drowning in debt and running a tiny udon shop in the red-light district, meets Moo-Shin—a wealthy yet dangerous man who shatters her bleak routine. He might be her salvation… or her downfall.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes five extra chapters

196828.description:
Shin-Ah’s love life has been...hands-free ever since her boyfriend left. Her favorite toy? Reliable. Discreet. Perfect. Until one night, mid–happy time, a glowing portal appears, and out pops a strange man...with his “wand” still inside her. Turns out, Shin-Ah’s favorite toy was magically linked to Kai McGreen, a cocky sorcerer from another world who’s very familiar with the sensation. Now stuck in a fantasy realm with a possessive (and ridiculously attractive) magician who refuses to let her go, shy Shin-Ah is in for a wild, magical ride.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: 絶倫魔術師様と繋がっているなんて知らなかったんです。溺愛なんて許してください
Zetsurin Majutsushi-sama to Tsunagatteiru Nante Shiranakattan desu. Dekiai nante Yurushite Kudasai
魔法師，我可以召喚你到我的那裡嗎?
ท่านนักเวท ขออัญเชิญมารักกันได้ไหมคะ?
Mage, is it okay if I summon you to my place?

196829.description:
In a world where elite hybrids are groomed to become the perfect members of society, the prestigious Hybrid Academy trains its students to be poised, graceful, and ruthlessly rational—never swayed by primal instincts. But not everyone plays by the rules. Mo Dan-Bok, 29. Towering at over 190 cm, he’s a top-tier bodyguard known for his strength and skill. Though respected in his field, as a branch family member, everything he’s built could be taken away with a single word from the main bloodline. Then one day, a command arrives:

“Protect the Sa Clan’s direct heirs.”

Summoned before the clan head, Dan-Bok is handed a file. Inside—two names, two photos, and two absurdly beautiful faces that look more like artwork than people. But looks can be deceiving. These aren't fragile ornaments—

They’re the cold-blooded, unpredictable heirs of the snake-blooded Sa Clan… and Danbok’s new job is to keep them alive.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: กระต่ายฮีตรีดพิษงู

196830.description:
Kwon Seok was suffering from hair loss. 'Hair subscription service' appeared like a ray of light to him. With this amazing technology, Kwon Seok's life began to change.

(Source: Naver, translated)

196831.description:
Han-Seo is plagued by nightmares of a tentacle-being assaulting him, so he desperately seeks help online. To his surprise, Tae-Geon Lee, a famous CEO, responds. As if that weren’t odd enough, he learns his dream attacker belongs to a spirit race and turns Han-Seo into an omega. Tae-Geon, an alpha of the same spirit race, offers to protect him and help him manage his new reality. Despite some initial hesitance, Han-Seo finds comfort in Tae-Geon—tentacles and all! But are his nightmares truly over...?

(Source: Tapas)

(Source: Includes five extra chapters.

196832.description:
Misaki wakes up from a traffic accident to find herself as the Demon King's daughter. She recalls using her charming skills to do whatever she wanted, but now that she has her memories as a human, she resolves to live a calm and peaceful life. However, Zel, the most evil demon who was cold towards her before she woke up, suddenly begins to dote on her for some reason...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 転生したら魔王の娘 うっかり最凶魔族をスキルで魅了しちゃって甘すぎる溺愛から逃げられません！
title.romaji: Tensei Shitara Maou no Musume Ukkari Sai Kyo Mazoku wo Sukiru de Miryo Shichatte Ama Sugiru Dekiai kara Nigeraremasen!

196833.description:
Kaori was the leader of a ladies' club. After being betrayed by her friends, she was reincarnated as Dahlia, the villainous young lady in her favorite otome game! In order to change Dahlia's sad fate, she uses her rebellious spirit and fighting prowess to stand up. However, for some reason, the first prince, Hedera, the cause of Dahlia's tragic love, becomes obsessed with her...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 前世不良の悪役令嬢なのに、ヤンデレ皇子の溺愛ルートなんて聞いてない！
title.romaji: Zense Furyou no Akuyaku Reijou Nanoni, Yandere Ouji kara no Dekiai Route Nante Kiitenai!

196834.description:
After living a life of as a corporate slave in Japan, she had reincarnated as a villainess, Fiona, into an otome-game. When she saw her identity, she decided to live a happy slow-life as a noble lady. It'd be lucky that her fiance, Louis, wishes to call off their engagement.

However, she soon realized why Fiona had to act like a villainess. She was sick and had a difficult time living as a normal noble lady. Since she'd like to live a happy life (alone), she started to change her food, life. and be honest with everyone. Then...something she'd never expected happened. Louis started to say that he loves her so much and never wants to break the engagement! What's happening? It's too different from the original game! Why is he so sweet...?!?!

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: The Fight and Flight of the Sickly Villainess
title.native: 病弱な悪役令嬢ですが、婚約者が過保護すぎて逃げ出したい(私たち犬猿の仲でしたよね!?)
title.romaji: Byoujaku na Akuyaku Reijou desu ga, Konyakusha ga Kahogo sugite Nigedashitai (Watashitachi Kenen no Naka deshita yo ne!?)

title.native: 病弱な悪役令嬢ですが、婚約者が過保護すぎて逃げ出したい(私たち犬猿の仲でしたよね!?)
title.romaji: Byoujaku na Akuyaku Reijou desu ga, Konyakusha ga Kahogo sugite Nigedashitai (Watashitachi Kenen no Naka deshita yo ne!?)

196836.description:
Ravi, a girl born into a wealthy merchant family, begins to cherish Cyril, the son of an earl, who protects her from robbers. However, after Cyril's father passes away, she loses contact with him... When they meet again seven years later, Cyril has become a knight of the Royal Knights, but his gentle and calm personality has changed completely, and he coldly dismisses Ravi, saying he "doesn't remember" her. But there's no way that the overly opinionated Ravi will back down so easily!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 初恋の少年は冷徹騎士に豹変していました 全力で告白されるなんて想定外です!!
title.romaji: Hatsukoi no Shounen wa Reitetsu Kishi ni Hyouhen shite Imashita Zenryoku de Kokuhaku Sareru Nante Souteigai desu!!

196837.description:
Han Ga-Hye has lived her whole life doing what her father, a renowned doctor, tells her to do. Now she is determined to leave everything behind and start her own business in a small town. But things go awry when she keeps running into Baek Jung, the sexy owner of a butcher shop below her clinic. Ga-Hye tries not to take an interest in the rough and blatant butcher, but she can't stop thinking about him... and his muscles. Will Ga-Hye successfully maintain her distance, or can Jung change her mind?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: ความสัมพันธ์นี้ไม่ดีต่อใจ

196838.description:
Somewhere in some world, some country, some time... The ever-accumulating history and the "traditions" that arise from it live in people's lives. Will they comply or resist? Will they overcome or destroy? Will they be beautiful or ugly? Will they love or hate? Now, a journey to find the answers begins.

A promising young writer depicts, in a series of short stories, the story of our modest yet certain revolution as we live with "tradition."

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

196839.description:
As women experience the many milestones of life - going on to higher education, getting a job, getting married, having children, raising children, caring for parents, and so on - and as their environments, positions, and relationships change, there are feelings they keep bottled up and unable to reveal to others. Feelings about changing their "surname" after marriage ("Bride's Dress"), or revealing their true feelings during their first romantic relationship ("Straw Doll")... The longer these feelings are bottled up deep in their hearts, the stronger and more powerful they become, until they overflow from the "darkness."

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: くらやみガールズトーク

196841.description:
"A new family, a new community, and that guy I wanted to forget..."

21-year-old Chie Monono lives at home and works at her family's orchard. Today, Haru, a third-grader left behind by the Monono's eldest daughter (Chie's older sister), arrives at the Monono household! Having lost both her father and her mother, Haru's only selfish wish is to continue playing baseball. Unable to find a reason to refuse, Chie "promises" without hesitation, but this opportunity will change her life forever!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

196842.description:
Everyone has a past they want to erase. Kaname Murai, who harbors intense complexes about her past, studies like crazy to leave her old self behind, and successfully enters a prestigious university. However, there she meets a man named Yuuma Yamashiro, who knows about her ugly and sordid past... This is an anti-Cinderella story about a girl who keeps moving forward despite being covered in mud!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Cinderella Who Doesn't Know Her Place

title.native: 身の程知らずのシンデレラ

196843.description:
Extremely shy, Koharu Uzuki spent her middle school days alone, unable to make friends. Dreaming of youth, she was determined to make it to high school, but she made a huge mistake when she introduced herself. However, when Aoi Yuuki, the most outgoing boy in her class, spoke to her, things started to change for Koharu's high school life, which had started off with such a blunder...

Koharu Uzuki, a shy girl; Aoi Yuuki, the most outgoing person in her class; Ukino Sora, a childhood friend who goes at his own pace; and Shiratori Miu, a beautiful, solitary girl. A story of love and friendship between four people with different personalities and social classes!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

196844.description:
Anzu Nakamura is an office lady who is good at her job but no good at romance. One day, as she worries about what she will do if she ends up alone until she dies, her younger brother brings home his handsome friend, Iro Suzune! Iro says he has nowhere to go, so Anzu decides to let him stay the night, but ever since, Iro has strangely grown attached to her...?

A love story woven between a worn-out office lady and a handsome man with a penchant for romance!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: サブスクイケメンの恋愛指導 同棲つきって聞いてません
title.romaji: Sabusuku Ikemen no Renai Shidou Dousei Tsuki tte Kiitemasen

196845.description: After visiting the home village of his fiancée, Yuuji witnesses a horrifying ritual based on the village’s legend of “reincarnation.”

196846.description:
Natsuki Mashima is 24 years old. Every guy she's dated is a total loser... she has absolutely no luck with men. Among her friends, there's one guy she can classify as a nice guy: her childhood friend, Shouya Sano, two years younger than her. Unlike his former self, who was spoiled and lonely, Shouya has evolved into a caring, overly talkative, "motherly" guy, and today, he's once again taking care of her...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: My Childhood Friend Spoils Me Rotten

title.native: 後方見守り幼なじみが甘すぎる
title.romaji: Kouhou Mimamori Osananajimi ga Ama Sugiru

196847.description:
Haruka Kujou, a 16-year-old high school girl in love, is dating her long-awaited high-spec boyfriend, Humming Shimono, a gorilla who lives in the zoo. His toilet manners and romantic common sense are completely different from hers, so life as a couple with Shimono-kun comes with many challenges.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: ザ・ハンサムエイプス
水属性の魔法使い@COMIC外伝～ペネロペイアの涙～
title.romaji: Mizu Zokusei no Mahou Tsukai@COMIC Gaiden: Peneropeia no Namida

196849.description:
A girl who has lost everything sets a brutal trap for revenge on the royal family that rules a great nation.

A contract has been passed down in the 300-year-old Seiin Kingdom. For generations, it has been a contract to welcome a shrine maiden from the Kagemori People, an eastern ethnic minority with unique powers, as empress. However, six months after the shrine maiden Somali, who was in love with the new emperor, Eigaku, was welcomed as empress, the contract was broken in the worst possible way. Her younger sister, Kukuna, infiltrates the harem as a palace maid to avenge her sister...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

196850.description:
Kotori, a small-species bird who has been living desperately while holding on to a precious memory, is suddenly abducted and brutally assaulted by a large-species bird.
In the midst of his despair, the one who saves him is a terrifying yet beautiful large-species bird known as a “Hunter.”
Though the Hunter shelters him, his attitude remains cold. Still, Kotori can’t help but notice the pained expression on his face, as if he’s enduring something.
And those large, beautiful wings of his… for some reason, they feel strangely familiar.

(Source: Brite Shuppan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

196851.description:
Ten years ago, Hiroka met a mysterious girl named Juhyou in the forest near his grandfather’s house. The two quickly fell in love and even promised to get married.
However, a sudden landslide tore them apart, and with no news of Juhyou’s fate, Hiroka could only keep wishing for the day they would meet again.
Now a high school student praised by his female classmates as a “prince” for his beauty and kindness, Hiroka wakes up one morning to find a stranger in otherworldly clothing standing by his window.
And then the man introduces himself as… “Juhyou”?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 娶られ邪神の婚礼前夜

196852.description:
Ichirou, an omega working as a paralegal, suddenly loses both his job and his place to live.
With nowhere else to go, he moves into a share house in the “Omega Special District,” a government-designated area created to protect omegas who struggle to live a normal life in society due to heat. In this district, omegas support one another as they live together.
While focusing on his job hunt, Ichirou is suddenly struck by an unexpected heat and passes out.
When he wakes up, he finds himself in lewd lingerie at a secret party venue. Due to a mix-up, he’s been put up for auction. It’s the biggest crisis of his life!

For some reason, Sugaya Koutarou, the student council secretary, is assigned to keep an eye on Minase Rin, a problematic student suspected of smoking on campus.
He plans to follow Minase secretly, but is quickly discovered. Panicking, Sugaya blurts out, “From now on, please allow me to watch over you from the shadows!” in total honesty.

Because of eyes that can see strange things, You was raised cut off from the world, treated as if he didn’t exist.

196857.description:
Minami has quietly harbored a gentle crush on his childhood friend Yuudai ever since they were in elementary school. Even after becoming a university student, those feelings haven’t changed, remaining a precious secret he keeps to himself.
But when he reunites with Yuudai after a long time, Minami learns that he has a girlfriend and that they’re living together. Overcome with sadness, he ends up drowning his sorrows in alcohol.
As he drinks himself into oblivion, Yuudai appears before him. Crying, Minami clings to him and dreams of being held in his arms.
The next morning, when he wakes up, the person lying beside him isn’t Yuudai, but an unfamiliar handsome stranger...!?

196858.description:
Hayama, an office worker who admires what it means to be a “first-class man,” ends up dating Saegusa, a man he meets at a group mixer who perfectly embodies that ideal...!?

196859.description:
Ookawa Hikaru, a high school student with a passion for makeup, secretly works as a cross-dressing streamer under the name “Hii-kun.”
Having once been told that liking makeup was wrong, he carries a bit of guilt about it, yet can’t help getting excited when he sees his own cute appearance.

As the new school term begins, a new classmate takes the seat next to him: Takaoka Ryou, a popular amateur model who seems to live in a completely different world from Hikaru at the top of the school’s social hierarchy.

But in reality, Takaoka is a die-hard fan of “Hii-kun”...!?

196860.description:
At the gym where trainer Nanakawa works, a ridiculously handsome guy who could be mistaken for an idol suddenly shows up!
His name is Mikita, and his goal for training is… to increase the number of positions he can do when having sex!?

What awaits him in this unfamiliar place is the overwhelming adoration of a stunningly handsome Dragon King! Chosen as the king’s “favorite,” Riku is even commanded to share the bed...!?

Sung-Bin, a serial philanderer and public enemy number one of the male students at his university, is confessed to by Ju-Won, a gloomy young man who has recently returned from a leave of absence. Sung-Bin initially plays along to sate his boredom, but things start to develop in a way he doesn't expect.

196865.description:
Guide Heo Yoon-Jae thought he was done with the field after losing his esper to a brutal rampage, but fate seems to have other plans. On a trip to the Guiding Center for a one-day commission, Yoon-Jae finds himself faced with Woo Sang-Hyuk, an A-rank esper with a god complex and a reputation for blowing through guides like tissues. But Yoon-Jae isn't just any old guide, and he refuses to let an uppity young esper call the shots. Once Sang-Hyuk gets a taste of real guiding, he'll be putty in the palm of Yoon-Jae's hand. Or so he hopes, anyway.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: หมาป่าเฒ่ากับจิ้งจอกหนุ่ม

196866.description:
Due to an injury he sustained in middle school, Furui had to quit swimming, which he loved. When he entered high school, he was strongly persuaded by the beautiful club president, Chono-senpai, to join the swimming club as manager. Surrounded by the beautiful and charming Chono and other cute girls, he enjoys his high school life and grows, even though he is teased.

(Source: Comic Fuz, translated)

title.native: 蝶乃センパイは泳がせたい！

196867.description:
"Rouninsei no Kanojo to Super de" is a love story about Okuda, a 35-year-old single man who works at a supermarket, who starts dating a younger woman who is a Ronin student he meets on a dating app. Okuda compares himself to others and feels depressed, saying things like "I'm sick of being ordinary" and "I have nothing." However, when a girl named Setsuna comes on a date with him, she confesses that she is attracted to Okuda's ordinary side, and frees him from his complexes. Okuda begins dating Setsuna, and is able to face his own ordinariness.

(Source: Natalie, translated)
synonyms: At the Supermarket with My Ronin Girlfriend

title.native: 浪人生の彼女とスーパーで

Hanyuu Mao transfers to Seiun Gakuen, an all-boys junior and senior high school, early in the new semester. His roommate, Hasegawa Asahi, suddenly finds out Mao's secret. Mao begs Asahi to keep quiet, but Asahi...?!

(Source: Comic Fuz, translated)

196870.description:
"They say Michelangelo took revenge on people he hated through art..."

Kabeuchi Konta is the president of the Manga Research Club at a school where the cultural clubs are at the bottom of the social hierarchy. One day, his childhood best friend, Kamijo Kouji, returns from Tokyo after several years! When he meets him again after a long time, Kouji has become a handsome man at the top of the social hierarchy by any standards. Konta is happy to see him again and ends up telling Kouji about the webcomic he has been secretly drawing. However, the next day, when Konta arrives at school, he sees his classmates laughing at his webcomic, along with Kouji himself... Why has his best friend changed? Armed with art, the cultural club members begin their fight back against the unreasonable school.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

196871.description:
In an experiment to create artificial black holes or white holes for energy generation, things went awry. Instead, it opened a portal to another world, but not a friendly one. It connected to the dwelling places of creatures known as monsters. Amidst this chaos, individuals with supernatural abilities, similar to the monsters, emerged. They were known as “Awakened Ones.” Once awakened, they were obligated to serve for five years.

Koosuke Igami, a 35-year-old middle-aged adventurer of modest Class 3 ranking, had been adventuring for nearly five years. He joined a team of beginner high-class adventurers, but he only had three months left until his five years were up, and he could retire from being an adventurer.
synonyms: I'm the Lowest Ranking Adventurer, Raising a Heroine

title.native: 最低ランクの冒険者、勇者少女を育てる〜俺って数合わせのおっさんじゃなかったか？〜

196872.description:
When the reader wakes up in a novel as Liliope, a guide who tragically dies because of the unstable male lead, Octaeon, she has her work cut out for her. Liliope's death traumatizes Octaeon in the original novel, but the female lead helps him recover, and the two fall in love. However, Liliope’s brother, Hyacin, despises Octaeon for killing her and morphs into the novel’s villain. Refusing to let her death drag him into darkness and despair, Liliope decides to rewrite her ending. However, as she weaves her new fate, she realizes her ending isn’t the only thing that's changing.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: I Healed the Male Lead's Trauma

title.english: Guiding the Lead Out of His Trauma

196873.description:
Cyril Ireon de Sevran, a young and powerless king, was betrayed and murdered after his only supporter, Alexandra de Arno, died in war. But when he opens his eyes again, he is shocked to see her younger self who doesn't recognize him. Cyril vows to protect Alexandra and her dream of becoming a knight this time. Still, threats lurk at every turn, including the very person who killed them both. Will Cyril save the one dear to him and change the future? Or will fate just repeat itself?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Marriage of Convenience 2: An Unforgettable Song

title.english: Marriage of Convenience 2: The Unforgettable Song

196874.description:
Ketal the Barbarian never imagined that his dream of fantastical magic, epic kingdoms, and grand quests would start in the freezing, monster-filled White Tundra. After battling snow and fierce beasts, he reaches the wider world, only to find everyone is baffled by such a polite barbarian who asks too many questions and sends foes flying like ragdolls. Ketal just wants the adventure he's always wished for. But can a world that expects a brute handle a barbarian who refuses to be one?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Surviving as a Barbarian in a Fantasy World

title.english: Barbarian's Adventure in a Fantasy World

196875.description:
Once a loyal hound to a powerful magic family, Aster was used, betrayed, and killed. But death wasn’t the end—it was a second chance. Back in the back alleys of his youth, Aster now holds the future’s secrets in his hands. This time, he won’t serve anyone. Can a man who once served power learn to become his own master?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: Return of the Back Alley Wizard

title.english: The Back Alley Mage's Second Life

196876.description:
This isn't exorcism. It's survival, it's war. A powerful curse spreads across Korea, turning not only the dead but even the living into zombies. Exorcists struggle to save those afflicted by the curse and confront the evil group behind it, the "Black Circle." To stop the curse that has engulfed the world. And for the well-being of innocent souls.

(Source: Naver, translated)

To fulfill her duties as a guardian angel, Soyoung, an apprentice angel, tries her hardest to make Dami, who has a disinterest in life, happy. And will that effort extend to the bed(room)…? ”I can do anything if it’s for your happiness, Dami.” Even though she said she could do anything, it doesn’t mean she wants XX!

After a messy breakup, beta Hae-Min swore off alphas for good… until a reckless one-night stand with dominant alpha Seong-Han turns him into an omega overnight. Now stuck needing a regular partner (doctor’s orders!), Hae-Min bites the bullet and proposes a deal with Seong-Han, who just so happens to be his newest coworker. One weekly “appointment” turns into sparks flying - but just when things start to look sweet, who should show up as their new boss but Jin-Tae, the ex who dumped Hae-Min for being a beta?! 196885.description:
Shibata, a medical representative (MR), meets the skilled and handsome surgeon Hashimoto Miharu during a hospital visit.

One day, he happens to catch a glimpse of Miharu looking completely different from his usual gentle self, showing a languid and alluring side. Having always been weak to contrasts like that, Shibata can’t get Miharu out of his head from that day on, to the point of even having a dirty dream about him!

Leo, selfish and childlike, and Hayato, cool and mature, have been childhood friends who’ve always spent their days together. Leo has always wanted to be Hayato’s “number one.”

By the time they become high school students, Leo still doesn’t understand the feelings for Hayato that border on dependency. Miharu, a lonely university student with no family, meets Nio, a handsome entrepreneur who expresses interest in buying a painting that belonged to Miharu’s late parents. Suspicious of Nio’s claim that he would pay any price, Miharu firmly refuses, only for Nio to inexplicably take a liking to him. Soon after, Miharu loses his home in a fire. Left with nowhere to go, he is surprised when Nio offers to let him stay with him for the time being. Miharu reluctantly accepts, unable to read Nio’s true intentions. Though he’s never been good at relying on others or showing his emotions, Nio stirs his heart in a way he’s never experienced before. What is the answer to this unsettling emotion...?

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

196894.description:
An offer to work as an assistant for the wildly popular manga artist Retsuto suddenly comes to Iimi, a sought-after assistant who’s constantly called to different projects.
Excited, he heads to the site, only to be greeted by none other than Ashida, a former classmate he had a falling out with back in high school...!?

Despite the awkwardness, they end up working together as fellow assistants. Ashida may be blunt, but to Iimi’s surprise, he actually appreciates his work.

As they sit side by side battling deadlines, Iimi slowly starts to find being next to Ashida more and more comfortable...!?

Omegas who possess pheromones that can seduce alphas are known for their rarity and are called “witches.” A witch’s primary source of income comes from extracting those pheromones to create aphrodisiacs. However, pheromones decrease with age and eventually run out entirely, which for a witch means the end of their livelihood.

Young omega Bert lives with the constant anxiety of that inevitable future. One day, Bert discovers an ultra-rare creature, a baby dragon. Selling it could mean making a fortune beyond his wildest dreams…!? Overjoyed by this treasure-hunting-level stroke of luck, Bert takes it in, but despite its adorable appearance, the baby dragon hides an unexpected secret...

Former special agent Pi Bo-Ra! Become the manager of the rotten, trashy singer Choi Kang! She's a fan of the rotten, trashy singer Choi Kang! Is she a manager or an instructor? A ruthless manager's project to revive a trashy singer! The strongest manager!

(Source: Naver, translated)

196903.description:
I17-year-old Yujun Song lives for soccer. However, when he suddenly becomes color-blind, he has no choice but to walk away from his dream. 15 years later, after a car crash, Yujin finds himself on the brink of death and makes one last wish: to step onto the soccer field one more time. In the next moment, he appears to have been given this chance as he finds himself back in his 17-year-old body. On the pitch, strange bands of colorful light dance around him. With the colors as his guide, can Yujun become the midfielder he always dreamed of?

synonyms: The Genius Midfielder's Passes Are Special
A Prodigy Midfielder's Pass Is Special
วิถีนักบอลอัจฉริยะ

title.english: The Genius Midfielder with the Killer Pass
