A miraculous encounter with her oshi at her favorite cat cafe! But her oshi is terrible at touching cats...!! When she tries to help, an unexpected situation occurs!?

The "legendary spiritual medium" he was ordered to visit turns out to be his ex-girlfriend who dumped him years ago! Sakura, who works as a secretary at a large company, is approached by her high-spec boss, whom she has had a crush on for a long time, and he sweetly advances on her, suggesting an arranged marriage. Sakura is confused by this sudden turn of events, but she can't contain her feelings of love!?

Oh Sun-Hui wins a chance to attend her favorite actor, Yoo-Il's, autograph session by donating her bankbook. To think she'd actually get to meet her favorite, with his perfect voice and face, in person! But when it's finally Sun-Hui's turn to get his autograph, Yoo Il reacts coldly...

The oppa she was a fan of turns out to be her middle school classmate?!

Fiene, the daughter of a count, was neglected by her family. But she secretly leads a double life as a living legend, the most powerful witch in the kingdom! She marries the beautiful future duke, Sion, as a political move, but he declares that ""he will never love her."" While she was initially happy that neither of them would get in the other's way, she later learns that the one he actually loves is her witch form?!

(Source: Manga UP!)

title.english: The Ice Mage's Unrequited Love was Me in Disguise
title.native: 「君を愛することはない」と言った氷の魔術師様の片思い相手が、変装した私だった
title.romaji: "Kimi wo Aisuru koto wa Nai" to Itta Koori no Majutsushi-sama no Kataomoi Aite ga, Hensou Shita Watashi datta

196910.description:
Christina, the daughter of a duke, falls into the trap of her half-sister Muriel, who desires everything she has, and one night she tragically dies. However, when Christina, who was supposed to be dead, wakes up, she finds herself in the morning three years before she was killed. Until then, Christina had listened to Muriel's whims and tried to be a model modest lady, but in her regressed life she has resolved to survive by being mean. She then joins forces with her fiancé, Iril, who is working to solve mysterious incidents occurring near the border, and begins her counterattack...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 淑女の鑑やめました。時を逆行した公爵令嬢は、わがままな妹に振り回されないよう性格悪く生き延びます！
title.romaji: Shukujo no Kagami Yamemashita. Toki wo Gyakkou shita Koushaku Reijou wa, Wagamama na Imouto ni Furimawasarenai you Seikaku Waruku Ikinobimasu!

196911.description:
Ace Lampard has it all- looks, charm, grades, and the attention of the entire school. He sits at the top of every social and academic ladder. That is, until a new transfer student, Colin McCarthy, unexpectedly takes the top academic spot and turns everything upside down. Colin is shy, awkward, and completely out of place. After Ace steps in to protect him from bullies, Colin becomes infatuated and starts following him in secret. When Ace catches on, Colin prepares himself for rejection. Instead, he hears something completely unexpected.

“Be my Secret lover, Colin...”

What begins as a strange proposal slowly unravels into something much more dangerous. He isn’t just an ordinary student with a crush. He has a reason for being here, and Ace is only the beginning.

(Source: Lezhin US)

196912.description:
In a world of brutal politics and deadly curses, one woman's touch is the ultimate solution. When the reader wakes up as Lianna, a villainess in a fantasy novel, she discovers that she’s the only person who can touch the tyrannical Emperor Enoch without activating his fatal ice curse. As his only cure, she must heal him while surviving the imperial court and the schemes of her cruel family. But as she peels back the layers of Enoch’s cold facade, she finds a lonely man, and soon their roles as the cursed and the cure blossom into a world-altering romance.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: I Became the Cure for the Tyrant in the Waste Novel

title.english: How to Melt the Tyrant's Heart

196913.description:
After discovering the count she served is half demon, Sera is kicked out and lands a new job at the “Abhuman Protection Bureau.” Tasked with recovering a heirloom stolen from the vampire Vlad family, she juggles day missions and night caretaking—all the while a rather suspicious prince draws near.

(Source: Manta)

title.english: Welcome to the Abhuman Protection Bureau

196914.description:
Neri is a witch living alone in the depths of the Blue Forest. She lives quietly, carrying with her sad memories of her mother being taken away as an "evil witch" when she was a child. One day, a young lady visits her, hoping to escape a political marriage. Neri is unsure whether to accede to the request, but as she listens to her story, her heart freezes. The young lady's marriage partner is Erwin, the man who had once abducted her mother. In order to find her mother's whereabouts, Neri uses the only magic she has to transform into a young lady, and decides to marry Erwin as a "fake bride." And so, married life between the ruthless Erwin and the masked witch was supposed to begin, but...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 魔女の婚姻　偽花嫁と冷酷騎士の初恋
title.romaji: Majo no Konin Nise Hanayome to Reikoku Kishi no Hatsukoi

196915.description:
“You are under arrest as a suspect in the murder of Han Jong-In.”

I just went to see my grandfather, but why? Before the shock could even subside, Seo-Hui found out about her husband and cousin’s affair.

“From now on, I’m going to take what I want. Everything, including yours.”

Everything felt unreal, and the moment her eyes closed… she was transported back to 10 years in the past!? When Seo-Hui woke up again, she saw a college classroom. As she watched her cousin speaking to her in a hateful manner, Seo-Hui made a resolution.

“I won’t let you do whatever you want.”

She was going to live a different life. To do that, she had to delete her ex-husband first.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

title.native: 魔女の婚姻　偽花嫁と冷酷騎士の初恋
title.romaji: Majo no Konin Nise Hanayome to Reikoku Kishi no Hatsukoi

196917.description:
Kang Yeon-Woo, a mechanic on the Apollo team, is brutally rejected by fellow team member and celebrity racer Seo Beom-Min, leading to his resignation. Later, desperate for rent money, he joins the Carmine team as a mechanic. Rumors of him flirting with drivers circulate, leading to verbal abuse from Kim Tae-Heung, a veteran member of the team. Fortunately, thanks to Choi Ha-Yoon's intervention, the situation is resolved quietly, and this incident sparks a series of fateful encounters between the two...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Note: Includes two side story chapters.

196918.description:
Ji-in Yang is just an average otaku until a boy who looks exactly like her favorite anime character transfers to her class. Mireu Shin is overly friendly from the start, and she eats up the attention, much to the dismay of her longtime friend, Bongjun Choi, who begins expressing his feelings more openly. Even Dongsu Mun, her quiet academy comrade, wants to spend more time with her. To complicate things further, swimming sensation Hyeonu Gwon appears, acting like they’ve known each other for years. Suddenly, it feels like every guy in Ji-in’s life wants to keep her all to himself!

(Source: WEBTOON)

196920.description:
With her territory facing a crisis, Countess Estelle is on the brink of collapse. She resolves to overcome the current situation and rebuild her territory, no matter what. To get the funds she needs, she takes a gamble and heads to a casino with her eccentric friends, but things take an unexpected turn— before she realizes it, she's become the prince's fiancée!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 崖っぷち令嬢が4人の仲間と共に王妃になるまで
title.romaji: Gakeppuchi Reijou ga 4-ri no Nakama to Tomoni Ouhi ni naru made

196922.description:
Maria, a pure-hearted girl who loves God, endures extreme bullying every day. One day, however, she is forced to jump off a building and hits her head hard, after which she hears the "voice of God." She then realizes that the bullies are possessed by a "demon." Defeat the demon and "save" everyone! This is the ultimate revenge story, full of eroticism, gore, and everything else!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title.native: イジメは悪魔の所業です！～マリアの断罪黙示録～
title.romaji: Ijime wa Akuma no Shogyou Desu! Maria no Danzai Mokushiroku

196923.description:
High school student Touko has lost her grandmother, one of her few allies. Oppressed by her aunt and in despair, Touko is confronted by a relative of her missing mother. The Kamisaka family, who make a living by "hunting demons," welcome the "power" that Touko herself has always hated. Feeling accepted for who she is for the first time, Touko decides to live at the Kamisaka shrine. What awaits her is a life shared with Chihiro, a boy her own age, and Chiei, a talented sorcerer. Touko comes into contact with the anguish of Chihiro, who was born in Kamisaka but lacked powers, and the two polar opposites begin to bond.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

196925.description:
Mei, the daughter of a family that exterminates vicious monsters, was raised in a cold environment, lacking the power to exorcise demons. Meanwhile, her arrogant younger brother violates a taboo and awakens Ryouga, the king of another world! Mei is left behind... Mei is in danger, but Ryouga is actually a gentle, intelligent, and handsome young man. He teaches her the value of the rare "healing power" she possesses, and invites her to "become my princess."

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 夜叉王の最愛 ～虐げられた治癒の乙女は溺愛される～
title.romaji: Yasha Ou no Saiai: Shiitagerareta Chiyu no Otome wa Dekiai Sareru

196926.description:
Unpopular manga artist Rikka is troubled by the fact that she can't draw an attractive man to save her life -- or her livelihood. This is rooted in a childhood trauma that resulted in her developing a fear of men. "I seriously need to get a series picked up...!" With her career as a cartoonist hanging by a thread, she decides to take kickboxing lessons in order to get back a life where she doesn't fear the opposite sex. While learning how to fight from Goromaru, her coach at the gym, she is touched by his awkward but sincere kindness, and falls for him hard, but....?!

(Source: Manga Plaza)

synonyms: Divorce with Her Husband For 1 Billion Yen

196928.description:
Hana Kazama is an office worker who loves 2D. She's obsessed with the manga "Prince! Hikaru-kun," based on the Tale of Genji, and has vowed to herself that she won't die until she sees the series' completion. However, one day, she finds herself transformed into Lady Aoi, Hikaru Genji's legal wife, whose pride prevents her from being completely honest... Learning that Lady Aoi will one day be cursed to death, Hana struggles to refuse his nighttime visits to prevent her from having a child with Hikaru Genji, which are the cause of this curse.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 光る君の妻に転生したのですが呪われないために夜伽を拒否しています【心恋】
title.romaji: Hikaru Kimi no Tsuma ni Tensei shita no desu ga Noro wa Renai Tame ni Yotogi wo Kyohi Shite Imasu [Kokoro Koi]

title.native: ヤングガン ボーダーズ
ニセモノの恋を射抜く
侯爵家の次女は姿を隠す　～家族に忘れられた元令嬢は、薬師となってスローライフを謳歌する～
title.romaji: Koushakuya no Jijo wa Sugata wo Kakusu: Kazoku ni Wasurerareta Moto Reijou wa, Kusushi to Natte Slow Life wo Ouka Suru

title.native: 侯爵家の次女は姿を隠す
title.romaji: Koushakuya no Jijo wa Sugata wo Kakusu

title.native: 本日、貴方を愛するのをやめます ～王妃と不倫した貴方が悪いのですよ?～
title.romaji: Honjitsu, Anata wo Aisuru no wo Yamemasu: Ouhi to Furin shita Anata ga Warui no desu yo?

196934.description:
Notes:
- Chapter 1 was originally self-published on Twitter. It was then licensed by Hakusensha and Kadokawa for serialization.
- Chapters 2 to 8 were split into multiple parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume releases.
- Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: パラスティック狂騒曲

196937.description:
Lately, Shoutarou has been plagued by “nightmares,” leaving him sleep-deprived day after day. During P.E. class, he accidentally takes a ball straight to the head and collapses. The one who rushes to his side is Taisei, his childhood friend with whom he used to be close, though distance has grown between them in recent years. Concerned, Taisei walks Shoutarou home, and on the way, Shoutarou tells him about the dreams. In response, Taisei lends him a charm, saying, “So you won’t have any more bad dreams.”

That night, the nightmare returns...or so Shoutarou thinks. But this time, Taisei appears in the dream, and they end up talking and laughing together like they used to. He even lets Shoutarou rest his head on his lap, and it feels like he might finally fall asleep peacefully... until he notices Taisei is suddenly hard!? Before he knew it, Shoutarou gets hard too, and thinking maybe release will help him sleep, he’s startled when Taisei begins to touch him in a far more indecent way...!!?

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

Notes:
- Originally serialized under the title “Yume Mitai ni Shitara? (夢みたいにシたら)”.
- Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: If It's Dream, Can I Make Love With You?

title.native: 夢で会えたらシてもいい？
title.romaji: Yume de Aetara Shite mo Ii?

196938.description:
Azuma Shuu, 26 years old and never had a girlfriend, is suddenly pushed down in the storeroom of the supermarket where he works by a beautiful young man he’s never seen before, who pleads, “Please bear my child.” The young man, who hit his head, introduces himself as Yamamoto Sharaku and claims to have come from the future, though most of his memories are missing. Thinking he’s a complete nutcase, Azuma still ends up taking him home...!?

(Source: Julian Publishing, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

196939.description:
Every night when he comes home, system engineer Ioka finds himself getting hassled by his next-door neighbor, Kuga, a rough-looking guy who keeps insisting, “C’mon, let me hang out at your place!” Ioka has maintained his peace of mind by simply ignoring him, but one day, Kuga unexpectedly apologizes, saying, “Sorry... you’re probably tired and I’ve been too loud.” The glimpse of his straightforward side leaves Ioka surprised. Later, through the course of conversation, Ioka ends up going over to Kuga’s apartment, where he stumbles upon a secret of his...!?

(Source: Cmoa, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 怖がり男子を暴きたい

196940.description:
The boy with the secret social media account can't resist his innocent classmate's advances...! This is a story of (surprisingly naughty) puppy love between an honor student who's starved for affection and a popular guy who likes taking care of people!

Aito, the top student in his year, has a secret. That is, he's secretly popular on social media, with 100,000 followers. Every night, he uploads racy pictures of himself and fills the void in his heart with likes from strangers. In the new school semester, he ends up in the same class as Kyosuke, who's very popular. The pair strike up a friendship, and before they know it, they're having dinner together every day. As he spends time with the warm and sincere Kyosuke, Aito starts to discover thrills his secret account could never provide. Eventually, he's taking photos for his account one night when he starts imagining Kyosuke touching him...!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: The Boy With The Secret Account Wants The Innocent Boy's Love
title.native: 裏アカくんは純情くんにあいされたい

196941.description:
Behind the glamorous image lies the harsh reality of Yamashita, a trading company employee constantly battling an intense workload. Recently appointed as the leader of a major project, he’s been struggling to keep up with the unfamiliar responsibilities. The one who often reaches out to him is his teammate and fellow hire, Asakura. With the trust of their clients and the respect of everyone around him, Asakura seems far more suited to be the leader.

One day, a minor misunderstanding between them escalates into a heated argument, and to make things worse, Asakura already knows Yamashita was recently dumped by his girlfriend!? “If you’re that lonely, want me to kiss you instead?” Asakura teases. Yamashita snaps back at the provocation, only to find Asakura actually leaning in and kissing him...!?

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Nidome no Asa wa Kimi ni Ikkyoku
Songs For You on The Second Morning

title.romaji: Nidome no Asa wa Kimi ni 1-kyoku

196942.description:
Hard-headed delinquent Kuga is asked by his beloved little sister to find out what kind of girl her crush, Hachisuka, likes. But Hachisuka turns out to be the biggest playboy in school, constantly hitting on girls! There’s no way Kuga’s letting someone like that near his adorable sister. Shaking with rage, he confronts Hachisuka, only to have his lips stolen, his virgin and most sensitive thing grabbed, and get fucked in the process…!?

(Source: Mobile Media Research, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Doutei Yankee, Torotoro H ni Saretemasu

title.native: 童貞ヤンキー、トロトロえっちにされてます
title.romaji: Doutei Yankee, Torotoro Ecchi ni Saretemasu

196943.description:
Kazuki, who works at a photo studio, often gets caught up in trouble because of his handsome looks. Because of that, he gave up on his dream of becoming a photographer and started living with his heart closed off from others.

One night, he’s attacked by a stalker, only to be saved by a beautiful stranger. The man introduces himself as Subaru, the new part-time worker at the photo studio. Subaru clings to Kazuki with playful affection, but Kazuki brushes him off coolly. Still, as Subaru’s charm as a model begins to shine through, Kazuki finds himself unable to look away...

(Source: Overlap, translated)
synonyms: You're All I See, and You're All Mine
눈동자에 비치는 넌, 전부 내 것

title.native: 瞳に映るキミは、全部オレのもの
title.romaji: Hitomi ni Utsuru Kimi wa, Zenbu Ore no Mono

196944.description:
Former delinquent girl Janome earned the nickname “Medusa” because of her fierce gaze. Her goal is to become a cute high school girl, but that's nothing but a pipe dream. So she decides to get “special training to become cute” from the popular, calculating guy, Kuwabara-kun. But Kuwabara-kun isn't just a calculating guy—he seems to have some kind of secret...!? A hidden-secret romantic comedy about a determined, earnest former delinquent girl striving to become cute and a calculating, charming boy with a secret!

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

title.native: 蛇目さんはほほえみたい！

196945.description:
Haru Youichi is on a business trip to Hakata when he steps into a udon shop run by manager Yabuki Shuu. The udon Yabuki makes is so delicious that Haru makes sure to visit again during his next trip to Kyushu. Later, Yabuki's shop expands to Tokyo and quickly becomes a popular spot. Even during busy hours, Yabuki always greets Haru with a warm smile whenever he visits.

Then one day, Yabuki suddenly confesses, saying, "I really like ya, Haru-san." Caught off guard, Haru, who hasn’t been in a relationship for a long time, doesn’t know how to respond to the feelings of someone twelve years younger.

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

title.native: 東京さん、好きっちゃけど

196947.description:
Iris, a candidate for sainthood, is scheduled to be "discarded." In fact, she possesses special powers. Along the way, she meets Giuornos, a handsome young knight, and her fate changes dramatically in this Cinderella story of dramatic reversals!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 廃棄巫女の私が聖女!? でも騎士様に溺愛されているので、教会には戻れません!
title.romaji: Haiki Miko no Watashi ga Seijo!? Demo Kishi-sama ni Dekiai sareteiru node, Kyoukai ni wa Modoremasen!

196948.description:
One day, Iris, a shrine maiden at a church who is a candidate for sainthood, learns that once the saint selection ceremony is over, she will be branded as a discarded shrine maiden and sold off as a concubine to an upstart baron.

Thinking that she won't be chosen as a saint anyway, Iris runs away from the church, and on the way, she spots a sickly young man in a carriage and inadvertently heals him with her shrine maiden powers. However, the young man she saved turns out to be a titled knight, and he finds out that she has run away from the church...!

(Source: PASH! Books, translated)

title.native: 廃棄巫女の私が聖女！？　でも騎士様に溺愛されているので、教会には戻れません！
title.romaji: Haiki Miko no Watashi ga Seijo!? Demo Kishi-sama ni Dekiai sareteiru node, Kyoukai ni wa Modoremasen!

196949.description:
After her younger sister stole her fiancé and broke off the engagement, Saint Lana was forced to marry into the Beastman Kingdom as a sort of hostage. Marrying into a country that doesn't view humans kindly, she braced herself for a life of cold treatment, but what awaited her was a comfortable life!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 追放聖女は獣人の国で楽しく暮らしています ～自作の薬と美味しいご飯で人質生活も快適です!?～
title.romaji: Tsuihou Seijo wa Juujin no Kuni de Tanoshiku Kurashiteimasu: Jisaku no Kusuri to Oishii Gohan de Hitojichi Seikatsu mo Kaiteki desu!?

196950.description:
Lizelka works at a church as a saint who heals people with the highest level of magical power. One day, she suddenly loses her magical powers. Unable to figure out the cause, she begins to panic. Then, an old friend and notorious playboy, Shannon, a royal mage, shows up and forcibly drags Lizelka away, telling her to follow him if she wants her magical powers back. While researching how to get her magical powers back, she discovers that making a "promise" with Shannon might restore Lizelka's powers...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 贄の聖女と救済の契り 不良魔法士と綴る二度目の恋
title.romaji: Nie no Seijo to Kyuusai no Chigiri Furyou Mahoushi to Tsuzuru Nidome no Koi

196951.description:
Joju, the first princess of the powerful nation of Dolman, lost the battle for the throne and was branded with the stigma of murdering her stepmother. Her punishment was de facto banishment, in the form of marriage to Emilion, the king of the small, remote country of Ronino. Although Joju was rumored to be a villain, her natural intelligence endeared her to the people of Ronino, and Emilion gradually began to accept her. A Cinderella romance that carves out destiny begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 国外追放された王女は、敵国の氷の王に溺愛される
title.romaji: Kokugai Tsuihou sareta Oujo wa, Tekikoku no Koori no Ou ni Dekiai sareru

196952.description:
Joju, the first princess of the great nation of Dolman, loses the battle for the throne and is branded as a villain who plotted to kill her stepmother. She is then exiled from the country and forced to marry into the small border country of Ronino. In her despair, Joju is greeted by King Emilion, who is rumored to be cruel and merciless.

Emilion told her not to seek love, but unlike his homeland full of enemies, he treated Joju fairly. Joju regains his innate intelligence and gains more allies in a palace rife with conspiracies by those who oppose the young king. His dignified appearance changes the stubborn Emilion, and the two gradually begin to bond, but then a former noblewoman who was a candidate for queen appears...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 国外追放された王女は、敵国の氷の王に溺愛される
title.romaji: Kokugai Tsuihou sareta Oujo wa, Tekikoku no Koori no Ou ni Dekiai sareru

196953.description:
Giselle, the older sister of a villainous young lady, faces downfall or death at every turn. After remembering her memories from her past life, she begins re-educating her younger sister, Odile, the source of all evil, to prevent her from becoming a villainous young lady! What's more, Giselle's future fiancé is also a troublesome man who is certain to fall into the dark side...!? Giselle's struggle to live a peaceful life begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 悪役令嬢の姉ですがモブでいいので死にたくない
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou no Ane desu ga Mob de Ii node Shinitakunai

196954.description:
Ayame, the daughter of the Umezaki family, falls in love at first sight with Ritsuka of the Sakurakoji family in Kyoto. Having been devoted to her fiance Ritsuka since childhood, Ayame travels from Tokyo to the Sakurakoji family to prepare for her wedding. Ayame's heart flutters when she meets Ritsuka for the first time in five years, but Ritsuka coldly rejects her...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 京都 梅咲菖蒲の嫁ぎ先

196955.description: A story about being worshipped like a god by a popular idol who happens to be an old friend.

title.native: #崇拝型病み系アイドル翠くん

synonyms: The Spy Who Ravished Me ~Reborn as a Mafia Princess in a Deadly Game~ 2
Shi ni Game ni Tensei Shita Mafia Jou wa Henai Spy ni Tekome ni Sareru 2

title.native: 死にゲーに転生したマフィア嬢は偏愛スパイに手籠めにされる2
title.romaji: Shinigee ni Tensei Shita Mafia Jou wa Henai Spy ni Tekome ni Sareru 2

196957.description: A story about being obsessed over by a hitman who does not know of love...
synonyms: Treasured Pet Cannot Resist The Hitman's Precarious Blind Love

title.native: 殺し屋さんの危うい盲愛に愛玩ペットは抗えない
title.romaji: Koroshiya-san no Ayaui Mouai ni Aigan Pet wa Aragaenai

196958.description:
While exploring her masochism fetish by reading hardcore r18 manga, her neighbour Haru discovers her secret.

“You've given me some wild fetishes, and now you're acting innocent. I can't tolerate that.”

Her masochism drove him insane, and his obsessive love made her learn who he truly is.

(Source: DLsite, translated)
synonyms: You're Cutest When You're Pathetic ~Obsessed Golden Retriever Boy Haru's Disciplinary Sex~

title.native: かわいそうなキミがいちばんカワイイ-犬系執着男子ハルくんのしつけ交尾-
title.romaji: Kawaisou na Kimi ga Ichiban Kawaii: Inukei Shuuchaku Danshi Haru-kun no Shitsuke Koubi

196959.description:
Yeoreum is just a normal high school girl determined to find a cute boyfriend. But everything changes when she stumbles across a constellation shard and transforms into one of the Quprids -- warriors with magical powers. How is she supposed to date Gowon, the hottest boy at school, on top of protecting the galaxy? And why does her childhood friend Doyun seem to know more about the shards than he should?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

196960.description:
“You told me to remember your scent wherever I go, so I did. You still smell sweet."

In childhood, Hee-Won had treated Gun-Woo like a pet dog. Now after years of separation, Gun-Woo has reappeared as a subordinate in Hee-Won's company. But no matter how fiercely he's pushed away, Gun-Woo lingers like a puppy with gentle eyes.

(Source: Manta)

196961.description:
Sakuraba Moeka, an office worker, has come to believe that "men only care about the body" due to a major heartbreak in the past. Every day, she posts provocative selfies on her secret social media account, luring and toying with men, but one day, her secret account is discovered by a super-famous lingerie designer at her workplace...!? A cunning girl with a secret account x a brazen lingerie designer = the start of an adult, borderline love game♥

(Source: Gangan Online, translated)

title.native: ブラ恋～よせてあげてもズレてる二人～
title.romaji: Bra Koi: Yosete Agete mo Zureteru Futari

196962.description:
Aspiring stylist Aoi, insecure about his short stature and cute looks, is tasked by his grandmother with a unique challenge: help Maju, a former elite wrestler insecure about her tall, muscular frame, choose an outfit for a matchmaking party. Polar opposites in looks and personality, this unlikely pair must team up to find Maju a life partner...

Sparks fly in this romantic "boy-meets-girl" story of transforming insecurity into confidence!

(Source: Manga UP! Global)

title.english: Aoi-kun Wants This Muscular Girl to Flex!
title.native: 葵くんはムキムキ彼女を肯定したい
title.romaji: Aoi-kun wa Mukimuki Kanojo wo Koutei shitai

196964.description:
"Houkago Basket" is a four-panel coming-of-age story that begins with the meeting of Kei, a high school girl who is a member of the after-school club, and Tsubasa, a basketball girl. Kei, who calls herself "incombustible" because she can't get excited about anything, has no desire to join a club, and spends her spare time after school exploring her way home. When Kei gets lost, she meets Tsubasa, who has just moved to the town and doesn't know anyone. Kei starts playing basketball at Tsubasa's invitation, and Tsubasa's presence changes Kei's boring daily life.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

While he is lost and unable to keep up with the fast-changing Tokyo, he inadvertently gets involved with a scary older man, when he is suddenly approached by a beautiful “cross-dressing boy” who is a bit of a minefield. He lightly accepts and tries to go about his business to make up for the number of nominations, but later on, he comes to the store with a large sum of money!

One day, she goes to Morisaki-san's house to deliver something to him when he is absent due to illness!? Morisaki-san is weak from a cold and looks lonely and sad... Wishing for as quiet and inconspicuous an existence as possible, he tries to keep his head down.

However, on his very first day at his new school, he catches the eye of Tenju, the “child of God” and son of the city’s spiritual leader. Despite his beautiful, alluring appearance, Tenju’s warm and friendly smile gradually draws Manato in.
